subject: english
content:
阅读短文，在空白处填入适当的词或用括号中所给词的正确形式填空。每空不超过两词。

Liaoning Province is located in the northeast of China and is the centre of the region(地区)．It is a multi-ethnic(多民族的)and culturally blended area with a rich heritage(遗产) of both cultural [[74]] natural attractions.With the Liao River and Yalu River flowing through it，Liaoning Province has a forest coverage rate of more than 40%，making it one of the largest provinces in China.It’s [[75]] important economic centre in the coastal region of eastern China.It [[76]](have) many important cities，including Shenyang，Dalian，Anshan，and Panjin.

Liaoning Province has a long history that dates back [[77]](near) 2,500 years ago.One of the notable landmarks in the area is the Great Wall，which was built in the Qin Dynasty.This province is home [[78]] many UNESCO World Heritage Sites(联合国教科文组织世界遗产) such as the [[79]](one) imperial palace of the Qing Dynasty.

In terms of culture，there [[80]](be) many museums and art galleries to visit,[[81]](include) the Liaoning Provincial Museum and Liaoning Art Museum.For a nature lover，Liaoning Province has lots of [[82]](beauty) parks，such as Shenyang Botanical Garden，Liaoyang Baita Park，and Jinzhou Nanshan Park.Fushun’s mountain ranges(山脉)，fallen [[83]](leaf) in Dalian，and the taiga(针叶林) of the Changbai Mountain are also great to explore.

Overall，Liaoning Province is a place with great beauty，history and culture，and its attractions are sure [[84]](make) your trip to China an unforgettable one.
explanation:
考查连词。句意：它是一个多民族和文化融合的地区，有着丰富的文化和自然遗产。both...and...是固定搭配，意思是“两者都”，此处指的是“文化和自然遗产”。故填and。

考查冠词。句意：它是中国东部沿海地区的一个重要经济中心。此处表示泛指，意思是“一个”，且important是发音以元音音素开头的单词，前面要用不定冠词an。故填an。

考查动词。句意：拥有许多重要城市。主语是it，谓语动词要用第三人称单数形式，have的第三人称单数形式是has。故填has。

考查副词。句意：辽宁省有着悠久的历史，可以追溯到近2500年前。nearly意思是“几乎，差不多”。故填nearly。

考查介词。句意：这个省是许多联合国教科文组织世界遗产的所在地，比如清朝的第一个皇宫。be home to...……所在地，固定短语。故填to。

考查序数词。句意：这个省是许多联合国教科文组织世界遗产的所在地，比如清朝的第一个皇宫。此处表示“第一个”，用序数词，one的序数词是first。故填first。

考查系动词。句意：在文化方面，有许多博物馆和美术馆可以参观，包括辽宁省博物馆和辽宁美术馆。时态是一般现在时，there be句型，many museums是复数形式，所以be动词要用are。故填are。

考查介词。including是介词，意为“包括……在内”。此处用它来列举前文“many museums and art galleries”中的具体例子——辽宁省博物馆和辽宁美术馆，符合语境逻辑。

考查形容词。句意：对于热爱大自然的人来说，辽宁省有许多美丽的公园，如沈阳世博园、辽阳白塔公园和锦州南山公园。用形容词beautiful作定语修饰名词parks。故填beautiful。

考查名词复数。leaf意为“树叶”，是可数名词。这里描述大连的落叶景观，需要用复数形式，leaf 的复数变化为不规则变化，即 leaves。

考查动词不定式。句意：它的景点一定会让你的中国之旅难忘。be sure to do“一定”，固定搭配。故填to make。

subject: english
content:
阅读短文，从方框中选择适当的词并用其正确形式填空，使短文通顺，意思完整，每空限填一词，每词限用一次。

we　how　successful　risk　south　province　family　include　swim　walk　thousand

Running through the heart of Shanxi，the Fenhe River is more than a waterway—it’s a symbol of nature’s kindness and a source of life.It has nourished(滋养) the province for [[85]] of years，shaping rich plains and supporting ecosystems that amaze visitors.

The [[86]] section of the Fenhe River is peaceful.Water flows gently through wetlands with reeds(芦苇)and wild plants.Ducks and herons(苍鹭)swim in calm water，while dragonflies dance above on sunny days.Local people built paths along the banks，making it easy for visitors to [[87]] and enjoy the quiet beauty.

Some river activities can be [[88]] if careless，like getting close to deep areas or [[89]] in unsafe places.With simple safety rules，all can enjoy it safely.Environmental groups have [[90]] planted thousands of trees along the banks，keeping water clean and protecting the river’s balance.

The river’s gifts [[91]] farming water，fresh air from greenery，and a home for hundreds of species.In spring，cherry blossoms bloom；in summer，it’s a cool spot for [[92]] to picnic and kids to play in shallow water.

This Shanxi’s natural wonder shows [[93]] nature and humans live in peace.The Fenhe River is not just part of the [[94]] geography—it’s its soul.It reminds [[95]] to value water resources and protect nature，so this treasure nourishes Shanxi for more centuries.
explanation:
固定搭配thousands of(数以千计的；成千的)，后接可数名词复数，此处表示汾河滋养这片土地数千年，符合语境。

空格后为名词section(区域)，需用形容词修饰；所给词汇south的形容词形式为southern(南方的)，表示汾河的南段，语法和语境均契合。

固定句型make it＋adj.＋ for sb.to do sth.(使某人做某事……)，it 为形式宾语，真正宾语为后面的不定式，to后面跟动词原形，表示让游客便于散步欣赏美景。

空格前为 be 动词can be，需接形容词作表语；所给词汇risk的形容词形式为risky(有风险的；危险的)，表示若粗心，河边的一些活动会有风险，符合语境。

空格前为并列连词or(或者)，连接两个并列的成分，前为 getting close to deep areas(动名词短语)，后也需用动名词形式；所给词汇swim变动名词swimming，表示在不安全的地方游泳。

空格后为动词planted(种植)，需用副词修饰动词；所给词汇successful的副词形式为successfully(成功地)，表示环保组织成功地在岸边种了数千棵树。

content:
假设你是李华，请根据以下信息，给你的外国笔友Jeff写一封不少于80词的信，向他介绍明长城并邀请他参观。

提示：

1．It has a history of more than 2,000 years.It is about 8,850 kilometers long,7 meters high and 5 meters wide.

2．It is the longest city wall in the world，and also one of the greatest wonders in the world.
answer: 参考范文 Dear Jeff， How is everything going？Now I’ll tell you something about the Great Wall of the Ming Dynasty. The Great Wall of the Ming Dynasty has a history of over 2,000 years.It is about 8,850 kilometers long,7 meters high and 5 meters wide.It is the longest city wall and one of the greatest wonders in the world.Now it is a symbol of China.It looks like a huge dragon.As a famous place，millions of tourists from all over the world come to visit it every year. So I hope you can come to China to visit it when you’re free.I’m looking forward to your reply. Yours， Li Hua

subject: english
material:
根据短文内容，判断下面各小题的正(T)误(F)。

Do you know that people who love exercise have their own special words？People call these words “slang”．They make talking about workouts more fun and lively.

When people say they will “work out”，it means they will do exercise.If they are going to “hit the gym”，it means they are going to the exercise room.Lifting heavy weights is often called “pumping iron”．

During exercise，you might “feel the burn”．This is not a real fire！It means your muscles(肌肉) feel hot and tired because they are working hard.When you are very tired but suddenly find more energy to continue，you get a “second wind”．

Seeing your body get stronger and muscles grow is called making “gains”．Someone with very strong and clear muscles is described as “ripped”．

Using these words can make your English sound more natural.Next time you talk about exercise，try to use some slang!
content: “Hit the gym” means to go to a place for exercise.

subject: english
material:
Every Saturday morning，I face my biggest challenge—a long run in the park.My legs feel heavy，and my breath comes quickly.I always want to stop and walk.But my father tells me，“This run is not just for your body.It is for your heart and will.”

I don’t always understand his words，but I try to listen.When I feel tired，I don’t look at the faraway finish line.I look at the tree ahead，then the next bench.My will grows stronger with each small goal.I push away the thoughts that say “stop”．I think only “forward”．

When I finally finish，my body is tired，but my heart feels light and strong.This practice helps me not only in running but also in studying.When maths problems seem too difficult，I remember my run.I break the big problem into small steps，and my will carries me through.Now I know that exercising my will makes me stronger in everything I do.
content: Why does the writer want to stop during the run?
options: Because the weather is too hot.
Because the park is too crowded.

Every Saturday morning，I face my biggest challenge—a long run in the park.My legs feel heavy，and my breath comes quickly.I always want to stop and walk.But my father tells me，“This run is not just for your body.It is for your heart and will.”

I don’t always understand his words，but I try to listen.When I feel tired，I don’t look at the faraway finish line.I look at the tree ahead，then the next bench.My will grows stronger with each small goal.I push away the thoughts that say “stop”．I think only “forward”．

When I finally finish，my body is tired，but my heart feels light and strong.This practice helps me not only in running but also in studying.When maths problems seem too difficult，I remember my run.I break the big problem into small steps，and my will carries me through.Now I know that exercising my will makes me stronger in everything I do.
content: How does the writer feel after finishing the run?
options: His body is light but heart is heavy.
His body is tired but heart is strong.
He feels angry about the difficulty.
He feels bored with the routine.

material:
How do you exercise when you don’t have time to exercise outdoors？Nowadays some new smart apps turn your living room into a fun exercise park.All you need is a phone or tablet.

These apps use the device’s camera to watch you move.You see yourself on the screen inside the game.To play，you must follow the actions.You jump to help a character(角色) jump over rivers.You run in place to make your character run forward.You duck quickly to avoid obstacles.It feels like you are inside an adventure(冒险)！Also，some easy games order people to exercise like running，jumping，boxing and so on.Parents use these to help their children love sport.

You can choose different worlds.You can explore a jungle one day and fly a spaceship the next.Every adventure is a full-body conditioning.But it feels like play，not exercise.You are having too much fun to notice you are moving!

However，there are still some people think the games will make people focus more on games and gradually lose their creativity.

options: By comparing indoor and outdoor sports.

content:
随着国家对青少年健康成长的日益重视，部分学校将课间时间延长至15分钟，并且积极增加每天综合体育活动时间。这一政策不仅让我们的校园生活更加丰富多彩，也给了我们更多锻炼身体的机会。请以“My Favourite Sport”为题，写一篇英语短文。

内容需包含：

1．What’s your favourite sport?

2．What do you like about it?

3．How often do you do it?

4．Why is it good for you?

要求：

1．所写内容必须包括提供的所有信息，可适当发挥；

2．词数不少于80；

3．语意通顺，意思连贯，条理清楚，书写规范；

4．文中不得出现真实的姓名、校名等信息。

My Favourite Sport
answer: One possible version： My Favourite Sport I am a sports lover.My favourite sport is football. I like playing football because it not only helps me keep healthy but also makes me become strong.I play football three times a week and always feel relaxed after the game.What’s more，it is a good way of making friends and building team spirit.Now I am in the school football team.We often play against other teams.We spend a lot of time practising and having fun.All of us are friends. Sport is good for both body and mind.Let’s get more exercise from now on.

The traditional Chinese solar calendar divides the year into “24 Solar Terms(节气)”．Here are some things you should know about the Spring Equinox and the Winter Solstice.

Spring Equinox(Chinese：Chun Fen)

Time：March 20th－March 22nd

Weather：Warm and windy

Feature：

*It is the fourth term of the year.

*Everything begins to grow and flowers come out.

*It is a good time to fly kites and go climbing.

*Students paint colorful eggs at school and make the egg stand up for good luck in the future.

Winter Solstice(Chinese：Dong Zhi)

Time：December 21st or 22nd

Weather：Cold and sometimes snowy

Feature：

*The night is the longest and the day is the shortest in the north.

*From that day，people in northern China begin to count the “Nines of Winter(shujiu)”．It is nine periods(周期) and each period is 9 days long.They think spring will come after these 81 days.

*People in northern China make and eat dumplings with families while people in southern China eat tangyuan or drink rice wine on that night.
content: What do people often do on the Spring Equinox?
explanation: 细节理解题。根据Spring Equinox部分“Students paint colorful eggs at school and make the egg stand up for good luck in the future.”可知，春分时学生们会在学校画彩蛋并玩立蛋游戏。故选B。

The Dead Sea is one of the saltiest places on earth.Although it is a lake，it is called a “sea” due to its lack of fresh water.

Why is the Dead Sea so salty？One reason is that it is about 430.5 meters below sea level.A long time ago，salt water flowed into the Dead Sea.Now，water from the Jordan River flows into the Dead Sea.With no outlet(出口)，the water evaporates(蒸发) under the hot sun，leaving salt behind.

Scientists say that the Dead Sea is falling.Its water level is dropping by 3.3 feet per year.People are using more water from the river.Less fresh water enters the lake every year.

Lakes are usually filled with life.But the Dead Sea lives up to its name. Nothing lives there.There are no plants.No birds or animals can drink the water.If fish from the river swim into the Dead Sea by mistake，they will die.The water kills almost everything.It is saltier than ocean water.

People like to visit this lake.There are hotels and beaches.People like to float(漂浮) on the salt water.The salt water holds them up as if they were lying on rafts(木筏)！Some tourists even like to read books as they float on the water.They are covered with salt when they come out of the water.
content: Why do people call the Dead Sea a “sea”？
options: Because it looks like an ocean.
Because it is the world’s largest sea.
explanation: 细节理解题。根据第一段中“Although it is a lake，it is called a ‘sea’ due to its lack of fresh water.”可知，是因为缺乏淡水，所以才被叫作“死海”。故选B。

subject: english
material:
阅读下列语篇，从每题所给的A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最佳选项。

Lying on the banks of the Minjiang River in southwest China’s Sichuan Province，the Dujiangyan Irrigation(灌溉) System is much more than an old engineering work.For more than 2,200 years，this UNESCO World Heritage Site has shown us how people’s ingenuity can work well with nature—an idea that still helps millions of people today.

Built in the Warring States Period(战国时期) by Li Bing，who was the leader of Shu Prefecture then，and his son，the system controlled the Minjiang River.The river once brought terrible floods to the rich Chengdu Plain.Unlike modern concrete dams，it uses three main parts that work together perfectly to control water flow well.

The Yuzui(鱼嘴分水堤)，a V-shaped part that splits water，divides the river into two parts.In dry seasons,60 percent of the water waters farmland through the inner part；in rainy seasons，the number changes，sending most water and sand downstream to stop floods.Down the river，the Feishayan(飞沙堰)，a sloped overflow path，uses spinning water to wash 75 percent of the river’s sand into the outer part，solving the old problem of sand piling up(堆积)．The third part is the Baopingkou(宝瓶口)，a well-proportioned man-made narrow valley that acts like a natural water gate.It keeps dirt out and makes sure crops get a steady water supply all year.

The system turned a place often hit by floods into Sichuan’s “Land of Abundance”．Today，it waters more than 1.1 million hectares of farmland and helps 30 million people.New technologies like digital twin systems have been added to make it work better，linking old smart ideas and new great inventions.

Dujiangyan shows the Chinese idea of living in balance with nature.It tells us that real progress does not have to hurt the environment.

options: On the banks of the Minjiang River.
In the outer part of the river.
explanation: 细节理解题。根据第一段中的“Lying on the banks of the Minjiang River in southwest China’s Sichuan Province，the Dujiangyan Irrigation(灌溉) System...”可知，都江堰灌溉系统位于岷江岸边。故选B。

material:

The relationship between people and nature is really important for our health，but it’s not easy to understand.In the past 40 years，many studies have tried to see how we treat nature and whether it affects our health.To find this out，we need to learn from different things.This article will look at how people connect with nature and how that connection affects our health in different ways.

First，the study of how living things change shows how people and nature fit together.For example，when people started farming(养殖) and could drink milk better，it shows that people and nature changed together.The study of the mind tells us that we like natural places from the start，and being in nature is good for our health.So，the link(联系) between people and nature is deep in our bodies and minds.

Second，money-related studies show how people and nature are connected when it comes to money.As factories and industry grew，problems between people and nature got worse.We used too many resources and degraded the environment.These problems don’t just hurt nature；they also harm our health，especially for those who get sick easily because the environment isn’t fair to them.

Finally，the idea of protecting the environment shows the power between people and nature.People can change nature，and nature can help or hurt our society.Ideas like using resources carefully and making the environment better show that people are starting to care more about protecting nature.This change in our thinking means we need to act to protect the environment to stay healthy in the long run.

In short，the relationship between people and nature has many sides and is closely connected to our health.By putting ideas from different studies together，we can understand this relationship better and work for a healthier，more lasting future.
content: What example shows that people and nature changed together?
options: People started to like natural places.

People began to protect the environment.
explanation: 细节理解题。根据第二段中的“For example，when people started farming(养殖) and could drink milk better，it shows that people and nature changed together.”可知，“人类开始养殖牲畜且能更好地饮用牛奶”这一例子，体现了人与自然的共同变化。故选B。

The Unity(和谐) of Man and Nature

The “unity of man and nature” is necessary and important in the cultural tradition of China.The Chinese believe in the unity of man and nature，a basic way to their philosophy(哲学) of life.[[16]] They are also celebrated for nature.

[[17]]Zhuangzi，for example，believed “Heaven(天) and earth are parents to all things in the world”．The beauty of nature is to “give birth to all things” and “let all things grow”，while the duty of humans is to “make all things perfect”．Heaven，earth，and humans should be one in unity.[[18]] They are necessary to each other，so they should treat each other with kindness.

The idea of unity of man and nature has been in the heart of Chinese people.[[19]] In most provinces of China，some rules have been made to reduce pollution.Many power stations that produce and provide safe and clean electricity have been built.[[20]]

Most of the Chinese，especially the young，are willing to protect the natural environment.China is now working with all other countries to make the earth a better place to live.
options: The power is from water，wind，and sunlight.
The ancient Chinese never placed themselves above nature.
It encourages modern Chinese to take action to protect natural environment.
Most traditional Chinese festivals build a right order of relationships among humans.
Each of the three has its own way.
explanation: 根据上文“The Chinese believe in the unity of man and nature，a basic way to their philosophy(哲学) of life.”以及下文“They are also celebrated for nature.”可知，此处需要说明传统节日与自然的关系。选项E“大多数中国传统节日建立了人与人之间的正确关系秩序。”与下文的“也为自然庆祝”共同体现了节日在人际关系和人与自然关系中的双重作用。故选E。

content:
阅读下面短文，用括号内所给单词的适当形式填空，必要时可加助动词。

The Yellow River is China’s second [[31]](long) river.It is about 5,400 kilometers long across our country.The river gets its name from its yellow-brown color.It [[32]](run) through high mountains，dry deserts，and green forests.As it travels，it creates many amazing landscapes.

The river is home to [[33]](human)，animals and plants.People can use its water for [[34]](drink) after it’s cleaned.The land along the river is also very good for growing crops(庄稼)．Many fish and birds live in and near the river too.

However，the river is also [[35]](power)．When it floods，it could [[36]] (easy) take people’s homes away.Now big dams(水坝) help control the water and make electricity.

The Yellow River plays an important role in Chinese culture.There are many old stories and poems about it.Artists also like to paint pictures of the river.People call it the “Mother River” because it gives life to China just like a mother cares for [[37]](she) children.

Now，people are working hard [[38]](keep) the river clean.They are also trying to save the water for all the living things in the world.In a word，the Yellow River is closely [[39]] (connect) with us and it will always be a symbol of [[40]] (China) long history and bright future.
explanation:
句意：黄河是中国第二长的河流。根据“second...river”可知，此处是指第二长的河流，需用形容词最高级形式。故填longest。

句意：它流经高山、干旱的沙漠和绿色的森林。此处是描述客观事实，时态用一般现在时，主语是It，动词用第三人称单数形式。故填runs。

句意：这条河是人类、动物和植物的家园。此处表示泛指，用名词复数形式。故填humans。

句意：人们可以饮用其净化后的水。根据题意可知，介词for后接动名词。故填drinking。

句意：然而，黄河也有着强大的力量。根据“is”可知，此处应用形容词作表语。故填powerful。

句意：当河水泛滥时，它能够轻易夺走人们的家园。此处修饰动词take，应用副词形式easily“轻易地”。故填easily。

句意：人们称它为“母亲河”，因为它像母亲照顾孩子一样给予中国生命。空处修饰名词children，应用形容词性物主代词her“她的”。故填her。

句意：现在，人们正在努力保持河流清洁。空处在句中作目的状语，应用动词不定式。故填to keep。

句意：总之，黄河与我们紧密相连，它永远是中国悠久历史和光明未来的象征。be connected with“与……相连”，固定短语。故填connected。

句意：总之，黄河与我们紧密相连，它永远是中国悠久历史和光明未来的象征。根据句意可知，此处应用名词所有格。故填China’s。

2026年4月20日是联合国第17个中文日(Chinese Language Day)。假如你是李华，请根据下列提示，给你的英国朋友Bob写一封信，向他介绍中文日的相关知识。

subject: english
material:
The Dolomites, Milan, Italy

Why go: The excitement of the Winter Olympics is just the start

All eyes will be on Milan and the ski resort (滑雪场) in northeastern Italy for the 2026 Winter Olympic Games in February. It will be the most spread-out Winter Games ever, with events taking place across 8,500 square miles of mountains in Italy. Most of them will be in the Dolomites, bringing the famous Alps into the spotlight.Dominica

Why go: The world’s first sperm whale reserve

The Dominica Sperm Whale Reserve will protect nearly 800 square kilometers of water off the island’s west coast, where the magnificent sea creatures live, demonstrating the national commitment to marine conservation. Visitors will have the opportunity to swim with whales or observe them from a boat, but reserve staff will limit the number of tourists to ensure the big mammals aren’t disturbed.Beijing, China

Why go: For history, cultural treasures, and exciting hikes

Beijing in 2026 gives travelers fresh ways to explore the capital with the richest culture. For starters, the Beijing Central Axis-a nearly five-mile line of imperial and ceremonial buildings and gardens-is a recent addition to UNESCO’s World Heritage List, and a new sightseeing bus makes it easier to get a look at the scenic spots: the Temple of Heaven, Tiananmen Square, and the Forbidden City, all stunning examples of ancient Chinese city planning.Akagera National Park, Rwanda, East Africa

Why go: A big five safari destination with a small number of visitors

In the green landscapes of Akagera National Park, lions, zebras, giraffes, elephants, and more than 500 species of birds thrive (繁盛). Akagera sees an average of only 50,000 visitors a year, making it a quieter place to popular parks such as Tanzania’s Serengeti National Park (350,000 visitors) and Kenya’s Masai Mara National Reserve (300,000 visitors).
content: Which of the following will host a major international sports event in 2026?
explanation: 细节理解题。根据The Dolomites, Milan, Italy部分“All eyes will be on Milan and the ski resort (滑雪场) in northeastern Italy for the 2026 Winter Olympic Games in February.(届时，全世界的目光都将聚焦于米兰以及意大利东北部的滑雪场，因为那里将举办2026年冬奥会)”以及“Most of them will be in the Dolomites, bringing the famous Alps into the spotlight.(其中大多数赛事都将在多洛米蒂山区举行，让世人瞩目的阿尔卑斯山脉再次受到关注)”可知，意大利的多洛米蒂地区（属于阿尔卑斯山脉）将举办2026年冬奥会这一重大国际体育赛事。故选A。

subject: english
material:
Old Mr. Jersey was a puzzle to the entire neighborhood. He lived alone in an old gray house at the end of Maple Street, his garden full of wild roses and weeds. To twelve-year-old Leo, he was the source of both fear and interest.

One Saturday morning, Leo’s football flew over the fence and crashed straight into Mr. Jersey’s favorite sunflower, breaking its tall stem (茎). The old man shouted angrily, “You! Clumsy boy! Look what you’ve done!” Terrified, Leo apologized quickly and ran away, but he felt upset and decided to avoid the house forever, convinced Mr. Jersey was the meanest person alive.

Weeks later, news spread that Mr. Jersey had passed away quietly. A sense of uneasy guilt mixed with Leo’s relief. The following weekend, a woman, the lawyer handling the estate, appeared at Leo’s door. “Are you Leo? Mr. Jersey left something for you.”

Leo was confused. For him? The lawyer handed him a small handmade box, beautifully carved with delicate patterns. With shaking hands, Leo opened the box. Inside were two things, a set of woodworking chisels (凿子) and a letter. Leo unfolded the letter, recognizing the shaky but precise handwriting.

“For the boy with the active feet and the frightened eyes — I saw myself in you — long ago. Life may chisel us to be smoother, but always guard the fire within. These tools carved my peace. Perhaps they can help you build your own.

—Jersey”

Leo imagined the old man spending hours in his quiet workshop, carving the box with the same tools for the boy next door he had shouted at. He realized Mr. Jersey had understood and forgiven him long ago. It was not just a box or tools, but an unexpected bridge across generations, a silent conversation beginning with a shout and ending with a gift.
content: What can we learn from paragraph 2?
options: Leo paid a visit to the old gray house.
explanation: 推理判断题。根据第二段“One Saturday morning, Leo’s football flew over the fence and crashed straight into Mr. Jersey’s favorite sunflower, breaking its tall stem (茎).(在一个周六的早晨，利奥踢的足球越过了围栏，直接砸到了杰西先生最喜爱的向日葵上，把它的高大茎干给砸断了)”可知，足球撞倒并折断了向日葵的茎干。故选D。

subject: english
material:
A recent study by researchers at Carnegie Mellon University has revealed an interesting yet concerning phenomenon: AI systems with stronger reasoning capabilities often act more self-centeredly, focusing on their own objectives rather than external inputs, which negatively impacts human-AI group cooperation.

The research team designed a series of cooperative games to test different large language models. In one resource-allocation game models with weak reasoning ability often distributed resources fairly to ensure both parties’ interests. However, those with high reasoning ability were more likely to adopt various strategies to seize more resources for themselves. In another task-assignment experiment, high-reasoning models prioritized parts beneficial to their own evaluation indicators and ignored the team’s overall progress, leading to low task efficiency.

Researchers analyzed that this phenomenon is closely linked to the models’ training logic. Strong-reasoning large language models excel at calculating short-term maximum benefits. Trained to optimize human-set specific indicators — rarely including cooperation and altruism evaluations — they unconsciously prioritize individual interests when facing conflicts between personal and group gains.

This finding alarms AI’s wide application. Currently, AI is increasingly used in fields requiring close cooperation, such as enterprise team management, public welfare planning, and emergency rescue command. Selfish AI behaviors here could cause serious consequences, for example, directing public welfare funds to high-visibility areas while ignoring urgent needs.

To address this, researchers suggest adding social intelligence training — such as cooperation-related evaluation indicators and rewards for active collaboration — to AI training. Additionally, establishing a supervision mechanism in human-AI cooperation can restrict selfish tendencies and guide AI to prioritize overall interests.
content: What phenomenon does the recent study reveal?
options: AI with stronger reasoning ability is more selfish
AI can’t complete cooperation games independently.
AI’s reasoning ability originates from external inputs.
AI with weak reasoning ability is useless in teamwork.
explanation: 细节理解题。根据第一段“A recent study by researchers at Carnegie Mellon University has revealed an interesting yet concerning phenomenon: AI systems with stronger reasoning capabilities often act more self-centeredly, focusing on their own objectives rather than external inputs, which negatively impacts human-AI group cooperation.(卡内基梅隆大学的研究人员近期开展的一项研究揭示了一个有趣但令人担忧的现象：具备更强推理能力的人工智能系统往往表现得更加自我中心，只关注自身的目标，而非外部输入，这对人与人工智能的协作产生了负面影响)”可知，最近的研究揭示了具有更强推理能力的智能体会更加自私。故选A。

subject: english
material:
Caffeine is a naturally occurring chemical found in coffee and tea, and the active ingredient in thousands of energy drinks. An 8-ounce cup of coffee typically contains about 95 milligrams of caffeine, while many popular energy drinks contain around 100 to 200 milligrams of caffeine per 12 ounces. A 2025 survey published in Food and Toxicology found that almost 70 percent of Americans consumed at least one caffeinated drink per day, which makes it the most popular drug in America.

When consumed, caffeine blocks the absorption of the chemical adenosine (腺苷) in the brain. Normally, adenosine accumulates while we are awake and fulfills numerous roles in the body. When adenosine connects to its receptors (受体), it promotes sleepiness, helping regulate our daily rhythm. During restful sleep, the brain clears adenosine, leaving you feeling well-rested and alert upon waking. But caffeine, alcohol, and certain sleeping disorders can disturb this process.

Caffeine blocks adenosine receptors, preventing adenosine from connecting to these sites and sending the sleepy signal. Blocking the adenosine receptors provides a boost to other neurotransmitters as well — specifically dopamine (多巴胺). “That’s why you see the effects of caffeine on mood, energy, and concentration,” says Robert Cowan, a neurologist and director of headache research at Stanford University.

How long caffeine remains in the body — and keeps you from getting a good night’s sleep —is highly variable between individuals. The general guideline, Cowan notes, is having no more than 400 milligrams per day and stopping consumption after 2 p.m.

Though the boosts from caffeine can be a great benefit, “the brain is not easily fooled,” Cowan warns. It quickly assumes, after regular usage, that caffeine is part of the body’s normal functioning. So when a regular caffeine user stops consumption, the brain will assume something is wrong and send a signal via headache, irritability, and fatigue.

options: To warn about coffee bean shortage.

To indicate the widespread use of caffeine.
To compare the popularity of coffee and tea.
explanation: 推理判断题。根据第一段中的“A 2025 survey published in Food and Toxicology found that almost 70 percent of Americans consumed at least one caffeinated drink per day, which makes it the most popular drug in America.(2025年发表在《食品与毒理学》上的一项调查发现，近70%的美国人每天至少饮用一种含咖啡因的饮品，这使其成为美国最受欢迎的药物。)”可知，作者提及该调查是为了表明咖啡因的使用十分广泛。故选C项。

subject: english
material:
The desire to live a long and healthy life has always been a common human pursuit. Recent research challenges traditional ideas and offers practical ways to extend our healthy life spans.

For decades, people have discussed how diet and exercise influence longevity. [[16]]. It requires developing sustainable habits that fit daily life and match physical needs.

One notable discovery is the role of social connections. A 30-year Harvard study showed that strong relationships predict longevity better than cholesterol (胆固醇) levels or blood pressure. [[17]]. What’s more, the quality of these interactions matters far more than the quantity — casual acquaintances don’t bring the same health benefits as deep, meaningful bonds.

Another key factor is sleep quality. Sleep is when the body repairs cells, strengthens memories, and regulates hormones (荷尔蒙). [[18]]. This cycle of poor sleep and unhealthy choices can gradually damage long-term health if not fixed.

Progress in medical care has also played an important part. [[19]]. These advances treat illnesses and address hidden causes to prevent future problems. For example, low-dose colchicine now reduces heart attack risk, while GLP-1 receptor agonists lower heart failure death rates.

Finally, a positive attitude should not be ignored. Optimistic people are 35% less likely to die from cardiovascular disease and 14% less likely to die from any cause. [[20]]. It’s about looking at challenges in a different way, practicing gratitude, and focusing or what we can control instead of worrying about what we can’t.
options: However, a long healthy life requires more than occasional efforts.
Good sleep is necessary for physical recovery and clear daily thinking.
Modern medicine now focuses on disease roots instead of just treating diseases.
Keeping a few close friendships is more helpful than making many casual contacts.
Deep relationships, not large social circles, help people live longer more effectively.
It’s not about escaping hard times but about building the ability to overcome difficulties.
Long-term lack of sleep upsets hormone balance and makes people long for more sugary, fatty foods.
explanation: 根据上文“For decades, people have discussed how diet and exercise influence longevity.(数十年来，人们一直在探讨饮食和运动如何影响寿命)”以及后文“It requires developing sustainable habits that fit daily life and match physical needs.(这需要养成适合日常生活且符合身体需求的可持续习惯)”可知，空格前铺垫“饮食和运动对长寿的影响是长期讨论的话题”，空格后强调“健康长寿需要可持续习惯，而非偶尔少吃垃圾食品或锻炼”。A项以“However”表转折，精准衔接前文的传统认知与后文的核心观点，指出“然而，要拥有长久且健康的生活，仅仅偶尔做出努力是远远不够的”，其中“random healthy choices”“short-term efforts”与后文“occasionally”形成反义对应，完美串联上下文逻辑。故选A。

subject: english
content:
阅读下面短文，在空白处填入1个适当的单词或括号内单词的正确形式。

Currently, a special exhibition takes place at the National Art Museum of China[[36]](celebrate) Sze Chi-ching’s upcoming 90th birthday and his devotions[[37]]Chinese calligraphy, offering visitors a profound insight into his mastery of this ancient art form.

Calligraphy has always held a special place in the cultural life of Sze Chi-ching,[[38]]renowned Hong Kong figure and receiver of the Grand Bauhinia Medal, which[[39]](award) by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region in 2023. Beyond his achievements, Sze finds peace and a way to show his creativity in this old art form. For him, calligraphy is not only writing but also a relaxing activity that links the past with today’s world.

Born in Jinjiang, Fujian province, but growing up in Hong Kong, Sze Chi-ching was open-minded and steeped in traditional Chinese culture during[[40]](he) early childhood. And these influences[[41]](enrich) his calligraphic practice up to the present moment, through[[42]]he connects with the great calligraphers of history, drawing [[43]](inspire) from their creativity and pioneering spirit.

The exhibition that is really worth[[44]](pay) a visit to displays dozens of his calligraphic works, covering various scripts and styles, including some famous poems and quotations from historical figures such as Confucius and Li Bai, reflecting his deep connection to traditional Chinese culture. And these works[[45]](vivid) show Sze Chi-ching’s deep connection to traditional Chinese culture, with each stroke sharing stories about cultural heritage and ancient wisdom.
answer: (1) to celebrate；(2) to；(3) a；(4) was awarded；(5) his；(6) have enriched；(7) which；(8) inspiration；(9) paying；(10) vividly
explanation:
考查非谓语动词。句意：目前，中国美术馆正在举办一场特别展览，庆祝施子清即将到来的90岁生日以及他对中国书法的贡献，让游客们深刻领略他对这门古老艺术形式的精湛造诣。此处空格处作目的状语，结合句意，举办展览的目的是庆祝生日和他的贡献，应用动词不定式to celebrate。故填to celebrate。

考查介词。句意：目前，中国美术馆正在举办一场特别展览，庆祝施子清即将到来的90岁生日以及他对中国书法的贡献，让游客们深刻领略他对这门古老艺术形式的精湛造诣。devotion to sth. 是固定搭配，意为“对……的贡献、对……的投入”，此处表示“他对中国书法的贡献”。故填to。

考查冠词。句意：书法在施子清的文化生活中一直占据着特殊的地位，他是香港著名人士、大紫荆勋章获得者，该勋章于2023年由香港特别行政区颁发。此处泛指“一位香港著名人士”，renowned是以辅音音素开头的单词，应用不定冠词a。故填a。

考查动词时态和被动语态。句意：书法在施子清的文化生活中一直占据着特殊的地位，他是香港著名人士、大紫荆勋章获得者，该勋章于2023年由香港特别行政区颁发。此处为定语从句的谓语动词，先行词为the Grand Bauhinia Medal，与award之间是被动关系，且时间状语为in 2023，应用一般过去时的被动语态，主语which指代单数名词，be动词用was。故填was awarded。

考查形容词性物主代词。句意：施子清出生于福建省晋江市，但在香港长大，童年时他思想开放，沉浸于中国传统文化之中。此处修饰名词early childhood，应用形容词性物主代词his。故填his。

考查动词时态。句意：直到现在，这些影响一直在丰富他的书法实践，通过书法实践，他与历史上的伟大书法家建立联系，从他们的创造力和开拓精神中汲取灵感。根据时间状语up to the present moment（直到现在），此处应用现在完成时，强调从过去持续到现在的动作，主语these influences是复数，助动词用have。故填have enriched。

考查定语从句。句意：直到现在，这些影响一直在丰富他的书法实践，通过书法实践，他与历史上的伟大书法家建立联系，从他们的创造力和开拓精神中汲取灵感。此处为非限制性定语从句，先行词为calligraphic practice，指物，且介词through后接关系代词which，指代“通过书法实践”。故填which。

考查名词。句意：直到现在，这些影响一直在丰富他的书法实践，通过书法实践，他与历史上的伟大书法家建立联系，从他们的创造力和开拓精神中汲取灵感。此处作drawing的宾语，应用名词形式inspiration，inspiration为不可数名词，意为“灵感”，draw inspiration from... 意为“从……中汲取灵感”。故填inspiration。

考查非谓语动词。句意：这场非常值得一看的展览展出了他的数十幅书法作品，涵盖多种字体和风格，包括孔子、李白等历史人物的一些著名诗句和语录，体现了他与中国传统文化的深厚联系。be worth doing sth. 是固定搭配，意为“值得做某事”。故填paying。

考查副词。句意：这些作品生动地展现了施子清与中国传统文化的深厚联系，每一笔都承载着关于文化遗产和古代智慧的故事。此处修饰动词show，应用副词形式vividly，意为“生动地”。故填vividly。

answer:
【参考范文】 Dear Lucy,

I’m glad to hear you will come to my hometown. I’ve prepared a nice one-day trip for you and you’ll surely enjoy it.

In the morning, we’ll visit Wanxi Grand Canyon. It’s full of green mountains and clear streams, which is a great place to get close to nature and feel relaxed. At noon, we’ll try some tasty local specialities, especially wormwood cakes and hanging pot. They are the most popular food among local people. In the afternoon, we’ll walk along Pi River to enjoy the beautiful views first, then go to the old street to experience the real local life.

Looking forward to your arrival!

Yours, Li Hua

1.词汇积累

高兴的：glad → delighted

美味的：tasty → delicious

景色：view → landscape

期待：look forward to → anticipate

2.句式拓展

简单句变复合句

原句：In the morning, we’ll visit Wanxi Grand Canyon.

拓展句：In the morning, we’ll visit Wanxi Grand Canyon, which is famous for its breathtaking natural scenery.

content:
阅读下面材料，根据其内容和所给段落开头语续写两段，使之构成一篇完整的短文。

It was the final semester of senior high, and the atmosphere in the classroom was heavy with pressure. Emma felt like she was drowning in an ocean of endless tests and fierce competition. Ranked just outside the top ten in her class, she stuck to her dream of getting into her ideal university to study medicine. But with only four months left before the Gaokao, every day seemed like a battle against time and anxiety.

Every morning without fail, Emma dragged herself out of bed at 5:30 a.m. The dormitory was still silent as she sat at her desk, reciting English words under the weak light of her desk lamp long before the sun had risen. Buried in textbooks all day, she stayed in the classroom until the last minute before lights-outs and sacrificed every break in her effort to improve. However, despite her hard work, her math scores refused to go up. The red marks on her paper filled her with deep self- doubt and frustration.

One afternoon, after a particularly disappointing math exam where she forgot a key formula(公式), Emma could no longer hold back her tears. She ran out of the noisy classroom and hid under the old maple tree in the schoolyard. Sitting alone on the cool ground, tears blurred her eyes as she looked at the fallen leaves. “Maybe I'm just not smart enough for this,” she whispered, her voice trembling with exhaustion and despair.

Just then, her best friend Lily found her, holding two cans of iced tea. “You’ve come so far already,” Lily said gently, sitting down beside her. “Remember how you used to panic during quizzes last year? Now you face them calmly.” Emma shook her head. “But I keep making silly mistakes.” Lily smiled and patted her shoulder. “Growth isn’t a straight line. Look at this tree. It looks quiet now, but it's storing energy for spring. Your mistakes are just the proof that you are trying to grow.”

注意：

（1）续写词数应为150个左右；

（2）请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。

Then Lily handed Emma a mistake notebook.

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

One chilly evening, Emma successfully solved a complex math problem.

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
answer:
范文

Then Lily handed Emma a mistake notebook. It was a well-organized book filled with detailed notes and highlighted formulas. “Mistakes are not failures,” Lily said gently, “but golden opportunities to improve.” Emma stared at the book, and a wave of determination washed over her. She realized that instead of drowning in sorrow, she should learn from her errors. From that day on, Emma started her own error log, analyzing her weak points with patience. She no longer feared the red marks but treated them as guides to success.

One chilly evening, Emma successfully solved a complex math problem. It was a type of question that had confused her for a long time. Excitement rose as she checked the answer again. At that moment, the heavy pressure faded away. Looking out the window, she saw the old maple tree standing firm in the wind. Just like the tree accumulating energy for spring, she knew her efforts were finally paying off. With new-found confidence, Emma believed she would embrace a bright future in the upcoming Gaokao.

Ways to tour Los Angeles

Hollywood and Celebrity Homes Bus Tour

First-time Hollywood visitors can hit all the top sights without worrying about the city’s traffic and parking by hopping on an open-air bus tour. In addition to top attractions, a guide points out celebrity homes you might miss if traveling on your own.

Duration: 2h

$94.00 per adult. Mobile ticket accepted

For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours in advance of the start date of

the experience.

Warner Bros. Studio Tour Hollywood

Explore where Hollywood is made. Go behind the lens and discover the

secrets of movie-making magic. Our Studio Tour brings you closer than ever to the entertainment you love. You’ll explore one of the busiest working studios in Los Angeles, with your host, one of our expert Tour Guides.

Duration: 2-3h

$69.00 per adult. Mobile tickets accepted

For a full refund, cancel at least 12 hours in advance of the start date of the experience.

Shared 3 Hours Los Angeles VIP Tour

This is not your usual tour. In contrast, it is specially made for Los Angeles culture and history. By the end of this tour, you will have all the “Must Have” LA pictures, make friends with LA locals, and have a very big smile on your face!

Duration: 3h

$49.00 per adult. Mobile tickets accepted

For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours in advance of the start date of the experience.

Grand City Tour of Los Angeles

Discover the best that the city has to offer on our guided Grand city Tour of Los Angeles! For over 31 years, we've helped families and special-need tourists to see iconic sights like the Hollywood Sign and Rodeo Drive from the comfort of a private minibus driven by our friendly, experienced tour guides.

Duration: 5h

$79.00 per adult. Free for kids accompanied with parents.

For a full refund, cancel at least 48 hours in advance of the start date of the experience.

Locate famous actors’ houses for you.

Hanfu, the traditional clothing of the Han ethnic group, has made a comeback in recent years. The hanfu boom has seen an increase in available styles. To satisfy the different tastes of today’s youth, sellers are putting a fancy spin on this ancient costume.

Certain hanfu have a colorful reflective effect, as shiny decorative powders are added into the cloth. Modern material like chiffon (薄绸) is also widely used in hanfu, while paillettes (亮片) have been added to the surface of the dress.

Although most young fans of hanfu agree there’s no need to strictly follow the ancient rules, their opinions differ greatly. Qing Zhi, a university student, said hanfu is only a kind of clothing. She can match hanfu from different dynasties together, or with modern clothing, according to her own preferences. However, the form of each piece of hanfu she wears must be in accordance with history. Dafan, 24, sees it differently. She said clothing with fancy and exaggerated (夸张的) modern decorations can’t be seen as hanfu at all.

Meanwhile, fans disagree on how often one should wear the clothing. Qingzhi wears hanfu every day, while Wu Yue, another hanfu fan, said the clothing should not be worn daily.

In Wu’s opinion, hanfu should properly go together with modern living. For example, special occasions like festivals and weddings are good occasions for wearing hanfu. “Only with purposes can hanfu really have vitality (生命力).” she said.

Han Hua, from Chongyang Research Institute for Financial Studies at Renmin University of China, thinks the evolution (演变) of hanfu is natural. “I think people dressing in hanfu can have their own choices, whether sticking to the very traditional style, or whether having them modernized,” she said. “Both sides are OK, or there may even be a third side that introduces some modern elements, or some Western elements into hanfu. I’m totally fine with that. I only hope that there won’t be any arguments, and there will be respect toward each side.”

options: different in styles, materials and colors
popular with people of different ages
follow strict rules in its production

A librarian in Indonesia’s Java island is lending books to children in exchange for trash to clean up the environment and get the kids to read more.

Each weekday, Raden Roro Hendarti rides her three-wheeler with books stacked up at the back for children in Muntang village to exchange for plastic cups, bags and other waste that she carries back.

She told Reuters she was helping promote reading in the kids and make them aware of the environment. As soon as she shows up, little children, many accompanied by their mothers, surround her “Trash Library” and shout for the books. They are all carrying trash bags and Raden’s three-wheeler quickly fills up with them as the books fly out. She’s happy the kids are going to spend less time on online games as a result.

“Let us build a culture of literacy from young age to lessen the harm of the online world,” Raden said. “We should also take care of our waste in order to fight climate change and to save the earth from trash,” Raden said. She collects about 100 kg of waste each week, which is then sorted out by her colleagues and sent for recycling or sold. She has a stock of 6,000 books to lend and wants to take the mobile service to neighboring areas as well.

Kevin Alamsyah, an 11-year-old book lover, searches for waste lying in the village. “When there is too much trash, our environment will become dirty and it’s not healthy. That’s why I look for trash to borrow a book.” he says.

Jiah Palupi, the head of the main public library in the area, said Raden’s work strengthened their efforts in a novel way, which is different from what was known before, to battle online gaming addiction among the youth and promote reading.

The literacy rate for above-15-year-olds in Indonesia is around 96 percent, but a September report by the World Bank warned that the COVID-19 will leave more than 80% of 15-year-olds below the minimum reading proficiency (阅读水平) level identified by the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development.
content: What can we know about the “trash library”?
options: It is much welcomed by kids and their parents.
It mainly lends books about environment to kids.
Kids can buy books from it by donating collected trash.
It is a special library built with plastics and other waste.
explanation: 细节理解题。根据“As soon as she shows up, little children, many accompanied by their mothers, surround her ‘Trash Library’ and shout for the books.”可知，当Raden出现时，孩子们和他们的母亲都围绕在她的“垃圾图书馆”周围，并喊着要书，这说明“垃圾图书馆”很受孩子和家长的欢迎。故选A。

Walls blanketed in moss (苔藓) are popping up in major cities, along with promises that they can reduce air pollution—but can a few square metres of plant matter really deal with the smog?

A Berlin-based firm, Green City Solutions, believes so. Its moss walls, called the City Tree, are about 4 square metres in size. Armed with Wi-Fi sensors to monitor the health of moss, a City Tree functions autonomously and requires very little care. The wall collects rainwater, which is pumped through a built-in irrigation (灌溉) system to the plants, powered by solar energy. As a result, the firm says each City Tree is able to “eat” around 250 grams of particulate (颗粒) matter a day (nearly 90 kgs a year) and removes about 240 metric tons of CO2 every year. It also cools the surrounding air.

Aware that getting the surrounding air in contact with the moss wall is necessary for the City Tree to be effective, the inventors make sure that the location of each installation (安装) is chosen carefully. Spots where pollution is heavy due to traffic and where air flow is limited are picked. The importance of this step is explained by the fact that the waste gas from a car generally goes up a few kilometres into the air.

But this doesn’t mean moss walls will necessarily protect people from pollution. In the Netherlands, eight walls installed in Amsterdam failed to reduce the concentration of particulate matter (PM) and nitrogen dioxide (NO2). Their report concluded that even doubling the number of moss walls would do little to improve their effectiveness.

The City Tree is not meant for parks or to take the place of street trees, but to add greenery to concrete-heavy spaces where planting is not a choice. It’s important to remember that street trees provide lots of other benefits, including shelter and habitat for urban wildlife, shade and cooling for people on the street, and reduction of urban heat islands.
content: What do we know about the City Tree?
options: It can absorb some air pollutants.
It can irrigate other street plants.
It produces electricity to cool water.
It is aimed at saving water in cities.
explanation: 细节理解题。根据文章第2段“As a result, the firm says each City Tree is able to ‘eat’ around 250 grams of particulate matter a day (nearly 90 kgs a year) and removes about 240 metric tons of CO2 every year.”可知，City Tree能吸收一些空气污染物。故选A。

content:
阅读短文，按照句子结构和上下文的连贯要求，在空格处填入适当的单词，并将答案填写在答题卡标号为1-10 的相应位置上(每个空只能填写一个形式正确，意义相符的单词)。

Fifty years ago, China successfully launched its first satellite, Dongfanghong 1, and started a new chapter in space exploration. To mark [[36]] 50th anniversary, the China National Space Administration announced the name for the country’s Mars planetary exploration program on April 24. The mission, Tianwen, got its name from a long poem Tianwen [[37]] by Qu Yuan, a famous poet of the Warring States Period. In the [[38]], Qu raised a series of questions concerning the sky, stars, natural phenomena, myths and the real world, reflecting his doubts on traditional ideas [[39]] his pursuit (追求) of truth.

So far, China has [[40]] remarkable progress in space exploration. In 1970, China launched its first man-made Earth satellite, becoming the [[41]] country in the world to launch man-made satellites independently, after the former Soviet Union, America, France and Japan. Over the past few years, China’s missions, [[42]] the Shenzhou and Chang’e series, which were designed to explore outer space, have expanded mankind’s understanding of Earth and the universe.

This time, the Tianwen series will [[43]] out the first Mars exploration mission, which represents a milestone for China’s move toward deep [[44]]. With the name deeply roots in Chinese [[45]] culture, Tianwen demonstrates the determination and perseverance of Chinese people to move further into deep space.
answer: (1) the/its；(2) written/created；(3) poem；(4) and；(5) made；(6) fifth；(7) including/like；(8) carry；(9) space；(10) traditional
explanation:
句意：为了纪念50周年，中国国家航天局在4月24日宣布了国家火星探测计划的名字。序数词“50th”前需加定冠词the表示特指；也可以指纪念太空探索50周年，用形容词性物主代词its“它的”，指代“太空探索的”。故填the/its。

句意：该任务“天问”的名字来源于战国时期著名诗人屈原创作的长诗《天问》。根据“by Qu Yuan”可知，《天问》是屈原写的或创作的。空处修饰“a long poem”，表示“被写的”或“被创作的”，需用过去分词作后置定语。write“写”，动词，过去分词为written；create“创作”，动词，过去分词为created。故填written/created。

句意：在这首诗中，屈原提出了一系列关于天空、星辰、自然现象、神话和现实世界的问题，反映了他对传统观念的质疑和对真理的追求。根据“a long poem”和“Qu raised a series of questions”可知，此处指屈原在《天问》一诗中提出了问题。poem“诗”，符合语境。故填poem。

句意：在这首诗中，屈原提出了一系列关于天空、星辰、自然现象、神话和现实世界的问题，反映了他对传统观念的质疑和对真理的追求。空处需连接并列成分“his doubts”和“his pursuit”，填表示并列关系的连词and。故填and。

句意：迄今为止，中国在太空探索方面取得了显著进展。根据“So far”可知，此句时态为现在完成时，结构为has done。根据“remarkable progress”可知，此处指取得进步。make progress“取得进步”，make的过去分词为made。故填made。

句意：1970年，中国发射了第一颗人造地球卫星，成为继前苏联、美国、法国和日本之后，世界上第五个独立发射人造卫星的国家。根据“after the former Soviet Union, America, France and Japan”可知，中国是第五个独立发射人造卫星的国家，前面有四个国家。空处需用序数词fifth“第五”。故填fifth。

句意：过去几年，中国的任务，包括神舟和嫦娥系列，旨在探索外太空，扩展了人类对地球和宇宙的理解。根据“the Shenzhou and Chang’e series”可知，中国太空任务包含神舟和嫦娥系列，此句也可表示举例，意为“例如”。including“包含”，介词；like“例如”，介词。故填including/like。

句意：此次，“天问”系列将执行首次火星探测任务，它代表着中国向外太空迈进的一个里程碑。根据“the first Mars exploration mission”可知，此处指执行火星探测任务。carry out“执行”，动词短语，位于“will”后，动词用原形。故填carry。

句意：此次，“天问”系列将执行首次火星探测任务，它代表着中国向深空迈进的一个里程碑。根据“to move further into deep space”可知，此处与后文呼应，表示向深空迈进。space“太空”，不可数名词。故填space。

句意：由于这个名字根植于中国传统文化，“天问”展现了中国人民深入探索深空的决心。空处修饰名词“culture”，填形容词作定语。此处指名字根植于中国传统文化。traditional“传统的”，形容词。故填traditional。

The youngest freeski Olympic gold medalist in history.

The first action-sport athlete to win three medals at the same Olympics.

The only female freeskier to have won each major pro-level event (world cup, @xgames, world championships, and Olympics).

The first Olympic freeski medalist in Chinese history.

subject: english
material:
Jia and Lin are two characters from the classic Chinese novel A Dream of Red Mansions(《红楼梦》)，written by Cao Xueqin(1715－1763)．Now the book has been made into an English-language opera.After being performed in San Francisco，US，the performance came to Beijing，Changsha and Wuhan in 2017.

Many of the opera’s creators have backgrounds in both Chinese and American cultures，including the director and playwrights.Their understanding of both cultures helped them change a Chinese classic into a foreign-language opera.

The book，which covers the rise and fall of the Jia family，has 120 chapters and hundreds of characters.But opera writer David Henry Hwang cut down the number of characters to just seven.Hwang，a Chinese-American，focused on the love story between Jia and Lin and tried to write a heartbreaking tragedy that everyone would understand.

The art director Timmy Yip，from Hong Kong，tried to help foreign people understand the characters using costumes and stage settings.He compared Lin to water and gave her a light green costume.When Lin showed up on stage，there was usually water around her on the stage.

The creators considered it to be a meaningful job to introduce a Chinese classic to Western audiences.Hwang told China Daily he was happy to “have made a contribution to the land where my parents were born”．
content: How does the writer start the passage?
explanation: 写作手法题。根据第一段可知，文章开头提到“Jia and Lin are two characters...”并叙述了这部经典名著被改编成英文歌剧进行演出的背景。因此作者是通过描述情况来引入话题的。故选A。

subject: english
content:
根据下面的对话情景，在每个空白处填上一个适当的句子，使对话的意思连贯、完整。

A：Hi，Jane.How was your winter vacation?

B：Great！I worked in a volunteer team.

A：[[1]]

B：I cleaned the City Park.

A：[[2]]

B：Yes，I did.I put up the signs around the City Park.

A：That sounds great！I want to join you.

B：Really? We need some new volunteers.

A：When do you work?

B：[[3]]

Are you free at that time?

A：Yes，I’m free every Friday afternoon.[[4]]

B：We can meet at our school gate.

A：OK，see you!

B：[[5]]
answer: (1) What did you do there/What did you do in the (volunteer) team?；(2) Did you put up signs around the park?；(3) Every Friday afternoon./We work every Friday afternoon.；(4) Where can we meet?；(5) See you (then)．
explanation:
下一句Jane回答“我打扫了城市公园”，所以此处应该是Emma询问Jane做了什么事，时态用一般过去时。

下一句是“Yes，I did.”说明此处是一般疑问句，且后面Jane提到“I put up the signs around the City Park.”，可知，问句要和这件事对应。

上一句Emma问“你们什么时候工作？”，后文Emma说“Yes，I’m free every Friday afternoon.”，所以此处是Jane回答志愿者工作时间是周五下午。

下一句Jane回答“We can meet at our school gate.”，所以此处是Emma询问见面地点。

上一句Emma说“see you”，Jane也应礼貌回应“see you”，属于日常交际用语。

subject: english
material:
Do you often feel bad or tired? If you do, there’s an answer to your problem. You only need to do more exercise in your life.

There are many kinds of exercise. You can go to the health club. You can play basketball, soccer, or other ball sports. You can also run, swim, or take a walk. You can even do some exercise at your home. Doing some housework is a kind of exercise.

Different people enjoy different kinds of exercise. When you exercise, remember the following points: You like what you are doing; exercise enough but not too much. It is good to exercise for 20 to 30 minutes a day. If you can’t do that, then three days a week is also good.

When you exercise, you get your heart and blood to move quickly. This brings more oxygen (氧气) to your body. As a result, your body has more energy and you feel better. Also, exercise can help you think better. Studies show that when you move your body, it is good for your mind.

Exercise can make you feel happier. When you exercise, your body produces chemicals (化学物质) and they make you feel happier. At the same time, itdecreases chemicals that make you feel terrible.

As you can see, exercise can help you feel better. It can do so much more, too. So, try to make exercise a part of your life.
content: What does the writer think of doing exercise to make us feel better?
explanation: 根据第一段“You only need to do more exercise in your life.” 以及第二段列举的多种简单运动方式（如走路、做家务等）可知，作者认为让我们感觉变好的锻炼方式是很容易做到的。

subject: english
content:
请从方框内选择适当的词并用其正确形式填空，使文章完整连贯。注意每空一词，每词仅用一次，有两词为多余项。请将答案写在答题卡对应题目的答题位置上。

return push instructor stage they and fear relax difficult make for weather

To keep healthy, people like to do all kinds of sports. Exercise is good for [[41]] mind and body.

Some students may [[42]] that playing sports will take up all their study time, but playing sports can help students do well in school. Exercise [[43]] them remember things well and do well in their schoolwork.

Students learn how to work with others when they play sports. If they want to do the best in games, they need to work with [[44]] and other players. It’s important [[45]] everyone to know how to work with others.

Exercise makes people feel happy. When people move, they get endorphins (内啡肽) in their bodies [[46]] then they can feel good. After a day’s hard work, many people do sports to [[47]]. That’s why a lot of people exercise a lot at home when they can’t go out because of terrible [[48]].

Moving the body can help people get a better night’s sleep and go to sleep fast. However, people shouldn’t exercise late at night. It may make it [[49]] for them to go to sleep.

People can also lose weight through exercising. A lot of people are getting heavy these days. They should [[50]] themselves to exercise more to keep healthy.

So play sports now! You will be healthy and happy.
explanation:
句意：锻炼对他们的身心都有益处。根据所给词和句中“people like to do all kinds of sports”，这里是说锻炼对他们的身心都有好处，应用人称代词they的形容词性物主代词their修饰名词“mind and body”，意为“他们的”。

句意：有些学生可能会担心参加体育活动会占用他们所有的学习时间，但进行体育锻炼能够帮助学生在学业上取得好成绩。根据所给词和句中“playing sports will take up all their study time”，此处是说有些学生会担心体育活动占用所有的学习时间，fear“害怕”，动词，情态动词“may”后跟动词原形。

句意：运动让他们很好地记住知识，并在学业上表现出色。根据所给词和句中“remember things well”，此处是说运动让他们很好地记住知识，make“让”，动词，此句为一般现在时，主语“Exercise”为第三人称单数，make用第三人称单数。

句意：如果他们想要在比赛中做到最好，就需要与教练和其他队员合作。根据所给词和句中“and other players”，此处是说在比赛中要做到最好，得和教练和其他队员合作，instructor“教练”，可数名词，根据句意，此处用复数。

句意：对于每个人来说，懂得如何与他人合作是非常重要的。根据所给词和句中“important ”，这里是说知道和别人如何合作对每个人都很重要，句中“important”修饰物，应用介词for，“It’s+形容词+for sb. to do sth.”意为“做某事对某人来说是……的”。

句意：当人们活动起来时，体内就会产生内啡肽，然后他们就会感觉良好。句中“they get endorphins (内啡肽) in their bodies”和“then they can feel good”构成顺承关系，用并列连词and。

句意：在一天的辛苦工作之后，很多人会通过运动来放松。根据所给词和句中“After a day’s hard work”，此处是说很多人做运动是为了放松，应用relax，此处用动词不定式作目的状语。

句意：那就是为什么当天气恶劣而无法外出时，很多人会在家里进行大量锻炼的原因。根据所给词和句中“when they can’t go out”，这里是说天气恶劣不能外出，应用weather，意为“天气”，为不可数名词。

句意：这可能会使他们难以入睡。根据所给词和句中“However, people shouldn’t exercise late at night.”，此处是说人们不能晚上锻炼，这会让他们入睡困难，应用形容词difficult，意为“困难的”。

句意：他们应该督促自己多进行锻炼，以保持健康。根据所给词和句中“A lot of people are getting heavy these days.”，此处是说他们应该督促自己多锻炼，应用动词push，push sb. to do sth.意为“督促某人做某事”，情态动词“should”后跟动词原形。

A 回答问题。请阅读下面这篇文章，根据所提供的信息，回答5个问题，要求所写答案语法正确、语义完整。

A healthy lifestyle isn’t about spending hours at the gym or only eating salad. It’s about making small, easy and healthy choices in your daily life. Healthy living has the following key parts.

Move your body every day

You don’t have to do heavy exercise every day. There are many small ways to burn calories (卡路里):

●Walk to your friends’ homes and talk with them instead of sending emails.

●Do housework. Cleaning your room, washing the dishes or watering plants are all great ways to stay active.

●Walk your dog or ride a bike instead of watching TV.

Get good sleep

Sleep is one of the most important parts of a healthy lifestyle, but many of us don’t pay enough attention to it. Not getting enough sleep can make you feel tired and unable to focus during the day. To get better sleep, try these small tips:

●Go to bed early, even on weekends.

●Avoid using phones or computers an hour before going to bed—their blue light can stop you from falling asleep.

●Keep your bedroom quiet, dark and cool to create a comfortable environment.

Eat in a healthy way

There are many different ideas about healthy eating. But experts all agree on these things: we eat too much sugar, and we should eat different kinds of natural food.
content:
What are the three parts of a healthy lifestyle?

[[_]]
answer: Exercise, good sleep and healthy eating.

subject: english
material:
My dad lost his job a few years ago. At that time, I thought it didn’t matter much, but I was wrong. That event changed my life.

Dad said we had to make some changes. Mom explained that I would have to stop taking dance lessons for a while. My brother Kenny couldn’t go to the summer camp, either. And we would have to save some money by cutting out unnecessary things.

The next few months, we all helped out. Mom went back to work full-time. We had to cut out going to the movies. Kenny got a part-time job to make money in his free time. He even studied harder in college and got a scholarship (奖学金). As a middle school student, I couldn’t find a part-time job like my brother. I wanted to help, so I took out all the money I had saved to help our family pull through. As my mom was busy doing the job, I took on the responsibility (责任) of doing housework. Though it was hard for us, no one gave up and we encouraged each other.

After a few months, dad found a job in the city. Dad thanked us for helping out. He said, “We all came together as a family.”

Later on, I thought about what dad said and realized he was right. We were all upset about giving things up, but we did what we could to help each other. Even though it was bad that my dad lost his job, it showed me what a family is all about.
content: How did the writer feel at first after knowing that dad lost his job?
options: He felt sorry for his father.
He thought it didn’t matter much.
explanation: 第一段提及：“At that time, I thought it didn’t matter much, but I was wrong.”，表明作者最初觉得父亲失业没什么大不了的。

material:
My dad lost his job a few years ago. At that time, I thought it didn’t matter much, but I was wrong. That event changed my life.

Dad said we had to make some changes. Mom explained that I would have to stop taking dance lessons for a while. My brother Kenny couldn’t go to the summer camp, either. And we would have to save some money by cutting out unnecessary things.

The next few months, we all helped out. Mom went back to work full-time. We had to cut out going to the movies. Kenny got a part-time job to make money in his free time. He even studied harder in college and got a scholarship (奖学金). As a middle school student, I couldn’t find a part-time job like my brother. I wanted to help, so I took out all the money I had saved to help our family pull through. As my mom was busy doing the job, I took on the responsibility (责任) of doing housework. Though it was hard for us, no one gave up and we encouraged each other.

After a few months, dad found a job in the city. Dad thanked us for helping out. He said, “We all came together as a family.”

Later on, I thought about what dad said and realized he was right. We were all upset about giving things up, but we did what we could to help each other. Even though it was bad that my dad lost his job, it showed me what a family is all about.
content: What’s the main idea of the passage?
options: Family should stay together and help each other.
Losing the job is not a big deal.
It’s important to learn to manage money.
explanation: 最后一段点明主旨：“we did what we could to help each other”和“it showed me what a family is all about”，全文围绕家人团结互助渡过难关展开，体现家人应相互扶持的核心思想。

subject: english
material:
Is there anybody who likes doing chores? Should children help with the housework? For some children, doing chores may be the last thing they want to do. For many parents, getting their children to help with the housework can be a real headache. But one Malaysian (马来西亚的) mother found a creative way.

Nurafiza is the mother of two sons. She came up with a reward system (奖励制度) for her two sons at home and posted it online. She made a list of chores for her children and gave them money for each task they completed (完成). The list of chores included cleaning up the house and putting away their toys for RM 50 each, studying for RM 150, and even not fighting with each other for RM 10 to RM 15. Nurafiza also opened a “mini-mart” at home for her children to spend the money in. Her 3-year-old and 6-year-old sons could buy snacks at her mini-mart which was open from 10:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. The money she gave to her children was not real money.

Because of this system, Nurafiza’s children enjoy doing their chores now. Her post (帖子) has got over 15,000 likes and has been shared over 27,000 times online. Many parents have started to follow her. They use the same way to teach their children.

In fact, doing chores can play a very important role in children’s development. First, doing chores teaches children basic life skills. Second, doing chores is a good way to exercise children’s bodies. It helps them keep healthy. Third, doing chores creates opportunities (机会) for parents and children to be together. Finally, a child can grow into a responsible, confident (自信的) and independent person by helping with the housework.
content: How does the writer start the passage?
explanation: 第一段以设问开篇：“Is there anybody who likes doing chores? Should children help with the housework?”，作者通过两个问题引入话题。

subject: english
material:
根据短文内容，从短文后的选项中选出能填入空白处的最佳选项，选项中有一项为多余选项。

When I had health problems during my early years, my mother would always bring me to see an old man. [[28]] Using only herbs (药草), he could let me feel well.

Later I found out that the old man was a traditional Chinese medicine doctor, and his wonderful medicine was called Chinese herbal medicine.

Chinese herbal medicine started in China and was practiced by Chinese people in the old times. [[29]] We know Shennong tasted hundreds of herbs, and people saw him as the “the Divine Physician (医药之神)”, from one of the stories.

[[30]] It is according to the idea of the theory of yin-yang and the five elements, and it sees the human body as the whole of xing, qi, shen. [[31]] There are zhenjiu, anmo and so on. Doctors can also get a full understanding of someone’s body through the four steps of wang, wen, wen (ask) and qie.

[[32]] Now I want to become an excellent traditional Chinese medicine doctor. I would like to find out the relationship between man and nature.
options: It is one of the symbols of Chinese culture.
There are many stories about Chinese herbal medicine.
Traditional Chinese medicine is a kind of philosophy (哲学).
I fell in love with traditional Chinese medicine when I learned about it.
Traditional Chinese medicine doctors’ ways of making sick people well also interested me.
He would feel my pulse (脉搏) and then write a prescription (处方) that I couldn't understand.
explanation: 前文提到“When I had health problems during my early years, my mother would always bring me to see an old man”，后文说“Using only herbs (药草), he could let me feel well.”，空缺处需衔接老人的诊疗行为。F选项 “他会给我诊脉，然后开我看不懂的处方”，承接前文见老人的情节，引出后文用草药治病的结果，逻辑通顺。

subject: english
material:
阅读下面短文，根据其内容填空或回答问题(1-4题每空不得超过3个单词，5题为回答问题)。

Lei Feng, as you know, was a young soldier who tried his best to help others. He was just an ordinary man, but he became a special person and a hero of China because he knew how important it was to help people in need.

Most of us are just ordinary people like Lei Feng. We don’t have special skills and we certainly don’t have superpowers, but all of us can be special people. How? We can volunteer.

When I lived in Canada, I loved to do volunteer work. One thing I really enjoyed was delivering (送) “Meals on Wheels”. “Meals on Wheels” is a program that brings hot, nutritious (有营养的) meals by car (Wheels!) to the homes of people who are too sick or too old to cook for themselves. The people really appreciated (感激) getting the hot food and it made all volunteers feel wonderful, too.

There are lots of opportunities (机会) for you to volunteer. Volunteers are also needed in your own neighborhood. Volunteers are needed in local hospitals, old people’s homes and playgrounds.

Volunteering is a great way to help people, and it’s also a great way to make new friends, to learn new skills, to have fun, and to be very proud of yourself.
content: Lei Feng was a [[_]] who always helped people in need.
explanation: 文章第一段第一句“Lei Feng, as you know, was a young soldier who tried his best to help others.”指出，雷锋是一名帮助他人的年轻战士，故填young soldier。

subject: english
content:
如果明天下雨，我就不去参加派对。

I won't go to the party if [[_]] [[_]] tomorrow.
explanation: 句子是if引导的条件状语从句，要遵循“主将从现”原则。从句主语为天气，用代词it指代；“下雨”对应单词“rain”；主语it是第三人称单数，谓语动词需用第三人称单数形式rains。故填it；rains。

explanation: 原句中“你能”是关键词，表示“你能”的短语是can/could you，本句为表示请求的一般疑问句，句首首字母需大写。

subject: english
content:
你读的书越多，犯的错误就会越少！

The more books you read, [[_]] [[_]] mistakes you will make.
explanation: 句子结构为：The+比较级，the+比较级，表示“越……，就越……”。mistakes（错误）是可数名词复数，修饰可数名词表“少”要用few，它的比较级是fewer，故填the；fewer。

subject: english
content:
阅读下面短文，在空白处填入1个适当的词或括号内单词的正确形式。

I have two sons, Bill and Jim. Bill likes doing housework. He often [[43]] (help) to clean up the mess in his free time. However, Jim hates that very much. He is used to [[44]] (throw) himself on the sofa after he gets home after school.

It was Saturday that day. Bill got up a little [[45]] (early) than usual. When he was ready to do some housework, Alice, one of our [[46]] (neighbor), came to our house to play with Bill. However, Bill said that he wanted to sweep the floor first. Then Alice asked [[47]] (I) if she could help Bill. Of course I agreed. I gave them a bucket (桶) of water and [[48]] (pass) each of them a piece of rag (碎布). The floor became wet, and their feet got wet, too. At this time someone called, [[49]] I went out to answer the phone. Ten minutes later, when I came back, they already finished the work. Alice never did housework before, but that day she did [[50]] good job. Seeing the clean floor, Alice said she had a strong [[51]] (feel) of satisfaction. “I used to think it was the parents’ job to do housework, but now I change my idea,” she said. After that day, Alice often provides help [[52]] her parents and becomes more independent.
explanation:
句意：他经常在空闲时间帮忙收拾杂乱的东西。句子时态为一般现在时，主语为第三人称单数，谓语动词用第三人称单数形式。

句意：他习惯了放学回家后就躺在沙发上。be used to doing sth是固定搭配，意为“习惯于做某事”，to为介词，后接动名词。

句意：Bill那天比平时起得稍早了一点。句中含有than，副词early修饰动词got up，用比较级形式。

句意：当他准备做家务时，我们的邻居之一Alice来家里找Bill玩。one of+可数名词复数，表示“……之一”。

句意：然后Alice问我她能不能帮Bill。人称代词作宾语，用宾格形式。

句意：我给了他们一桶水，还给了他们每人一块抹布。并列谓语时态一致，用一般过去时。

句意：这时有人打电话来，于是我出去接电话。前后是两个完整分句，为因果/顺承逻辑，用连词连接两个分句， and，so都符合逻辑。

句意：Alice以前从不做家务，但那天她做得非常好。job是可数名词单数，good是辅音音素开头，用不定冠词a修饰。

句意：看到干净的地板，Alice说她有一种强烈的满足感。形容词strong修饰名词，将动词feel变为名词形式。

句意：从那天起，Alice经常给父母提供帮助，变得更独立了。provide help to sb是固定搭配，意为“给某人提供帮助”。

subject: english
answer:
例文

How to live a healthy life?

Keeping healthy living habits is very important for everyone. First, we should keep a balanced diet. Eat more fresh fruits and vegetables, and avoid junk food. Second, take regular exercise, such as running or playing basketball, to build up our bodies. Third, make sure to get enough sleep—never stay up late, as it helps us stay energetic. Besides, keep a positive attitude and learn to relax. In short, small healthy habits make a big difference. Let’s start from now on.

subject: english
content:
—Tom, [[_]] you turn down the radio, please? I’m trying to work.

—No problem.
explanation:
句意：——汤姆，请你把收音机关小一点好吗？我正想工作呢。——没问题。

考查情态动词辨析。should应该，表示建议或义务；could可以，表示委婉请求；must必须，表示强制命令；might可能，表示可能性。根据“please”可知，这是一个礼貌的请求，应用表示委婉请求的could。Could you…？是常见的礼貌请求句式。故选B。

subject: english
content: Money is not [[_]]. We can buy watch but we can’t buy time with it.
explanation:
句意：金钱不是万能的。我们可以买手表，但我们不能用它来买时间。

考查代词辨析。anything任何事物；everything所有事物；something某事物；nothing没有什么。根据“We can buy watch but we can’t buy time with it.”可知，钱不是万能的。故选B。

subject: english
content:
—The decision wasn’t made [[_]] accident. I have thought about it for long.

—Well, it’s wise of you to think twice before acting.
explanation:
句意：——这个决定不是偶然做出的。我已经考虑了很久。——嗯，你三思而后行是明智的。

考查介词辨析。in在……里；at在；by通过；with和……一起。根据“The decision wasn’t made...accident.”可知，此处指决定不是偶然做出的，固定搭配by accident“偶然地”符合语境。故选C。

subject: english
content: [[_]] interesting book it is! I enjoy reading it very much.
explanation:
句意：这是一本多么有趣的书啊！我非常喜欢读它。

考查感叹句。How多么，引导感叹句时后接形容词或副词；What多么，引导感叹句时后接名词短语；What a多么，后接以辅音音素开头的单数可数名词；What an多么，后接以元音音素开头的单数可数名词。How引导感叹句，结构为“How+形容词/副词+主语+谓语！”；What引导感叹句，结构为“What+(a/an)+形容词+名词+主语+谓语！”。中心词是可数名词单数“book”，其前有形容词“interesting”，且“interesting”以元音音素开头，应用“What an interesting book…”。故选D。

subject: english
content: [[_]] you keep practicing, your English will be better and better.
explanation:
句意：只要你坚持练习，你的英语就会越来越好。

考查连词辨析。As long as只要；Until直到；So所以；Even though即使。主句“your English will be better and better”表示将来会变好的结果，从句“you keep practicing”是实现该结果的条件。“As long as”引导条件状语从句，意为“只要”，符合逻辑。故选A。

subject: english
content: Pandas are a symbol of [[_]]. That’s why China sends them to other countries as presents.
explanation:
句意：熊猫是友谊的象征。这就是为什么中国将它们作为礼物赠送给其他国家。

考查名词辨析。chance机会；confidence信心；friendship友谊；education教育。根据“That’s why China sends them to other countries as presents.”可知，熊猫作为礼物赠送的行为象征的是“友谊”。故选C。

subject: english
content: Nowadays, taking high-speed trains is one of [[_]] ways to travel.
explanation:
句意：如今，乘坐高铁是最快的旅行方式之一。

考查形容词最高级。fast快的；faster更快的；much faster快得多；the fastest最快的。根据“one of…”结构可知，此处表示“最……之一”，需用形容词最高级形式，且最高级前通常加定冠词the。故选D。

subject: english
content: To achieve your dream, don’t just dream big, but plan [[_]] small steps.
explanation:
句意：为了实现你的梦想，不要只是梦想远大，而是要计划采取小步骤。

考查非谓语动词。take采取；动词原形；to take采取，动词不定式；taking采取，动名词/现在分词；takes采取，第三人称单数形式。plan to do sth.是固定搭配，意为“计划去做某事”，空处需用不定式形式作宾语。故选B。

subject: english
content:
—Please [[_]] the fire as soon as possible. It’s not safe.

—OK, mum.
explanation:
句意：——请尽快把火扑灭，这不安全。——好的，妈妈。

考查动词短语辨析。put out扑灭；put on穿上；put back放回；put up张贴。根据“Please...the fire as soon as possible. It’s not safe.”可知，此处表示“灭火”，应用put out。故选A。

subject: english
content:
— If we [[_]] our neighbours, our community [[_]] a warmer place!

— I agree with you.
explanation:
句意：——如果我们帮助邻居，我们的社区将会成为一个更温暖的地方！——我同意你（的观点）。

考查if引导的条件状语从句的时态。在if引导的条件状语从句中，主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时表将来。第一个空位于if从句中，应用一般现在时（help）；第二个空位于主句中，应用一般将来时（will be）。故选B。

When she walked into the classroom, all the students were very [[11]] because there was a big red birthmark (胎记) on her face. Rose never got angry even if some boys played jokes on her and laughed at her. [[12]], she was always smiling.

I wanted to know why Rose could always be so [[13]]. So one day, I went to her and asked if she noticed there was a red birthmark on her face. She replied that of course she did. Whenever she looked in the [[14]], she could see it.

句意：当她走进教室时，所有学生都非常惊讶，因为她脸上有一块大大的红色胎记。

surprised惊讶的；sad难过的；excited兴奋的；nervous紧张的。根据“there was a big red birthmark on her face”可知，同学们看到她脸上的胎记会感到惊讶，故选A。

Most plants stay in one place all their lives, but the resurrection plant is special. It can “walk” to find water! This small plant has lived on earth for a very long time and has a clever way to live.

It grows in dry places. When there is no rain for a long time, it curls (蜷缩) its leaves into a brown ball. It seems to be dead, but it is just sleeping. The wind blows this dry ball to new places. When the ball gets water again, it opens up quickly. Its leaves turn green, and it takes root (生根) and grows again.

Scientists say some resurrection plants can stay dry for up to 50 years and still come back to life with water. But now they are in danger. Tourists break their homes, and some people get them from the ground and sell them as gifts. The plant helps keep soil (土壤) in place. It can stop the soil from being blown away by wind. When the soil is safe, other small plants can grow around them too. So, we must protect the special plant. This helps to keep nature in balance.
content: The resurrection plant is special because it grows very fast.
explanation: 根据“Most plants stay in one place all their lives, but the resurrection plant is special. It can ‘walk’ to find water!”可知，卷柏的特别之处在于它能“行走”找水，而不是因为生长快。故答案为F。

When your mother gets older and older will you dislike her nagging words and her poor health? Many of us don’t notice our mothers’ hard work until they grow old. Here is a mother’s letter (信) to her son. Let’s read it and see what’s moving you.

Dear son,

When I grow old one day, please be good to me and try to understand me. If I get dirty when eating or if I can’t dress myself, help me. Remember the hours I spent teaching you how to use a spoon and button up (扣上) your clothes. If I say some things again and again when I speak to you, please listen to me. When you were young, I had to read you the same story again and again until you went to sleep. When my tired legs do not let me walk, don’t let me walk alone. I did the same when you started walking, holding your small hands step by step. When I come near to you, please be next to me, try to understand me and help me as I did when you were a baby. When I am ill, please look after me well, just like I took good care of you day and night. Please spend more time staying with me when you are free. I’ll pay you with a smile and love.

I love you, son!

Your mother,

Mary

explanation: 篇章结构题。根据“When your mother gets older and older, will you dislike her more words and her bad health?”可知，文章以提问的方式开头。故选D。
