Do you know how smartphones answer questions and robots play games? It’s so cool to see your phone give quick answers to your questions or watch a robot win a video game! Artificial intelligence (AI) and AI trainers (people who teach AI how to work) help make these things happen!

AI trainers are like teachers for computers. Their job is to teach AI to think and learn, just like your teachers help you learn maths and English. They work hard to make AI smarter day by day, and this smart AI makes people’s lives easier, like when your phone helps you find a way home or a robot cleans your room. Let’s learn about how they do their work.

First, they collect lots of information for AI. For example, if they want AI to learn about animals, they collect thousands of pictures of animals—from cute cats and playful dogs to colorful birds and big elephants. Then, they teach AI the differences between these animals, so it can recognize different animals quickly and exactly. After that, AI trainers test AI to see if it learns correctly. If AI makes a mistake, the trainers will go back and teach it again.

If you’re interested in becoming an AI trainer in the future, you need to study maths and science hard in school. These subjects help you understand how machines work and think! You can also try fun coding (编程) games to learn how to “talk” to machines. Who knows? Maybe you can become an AI trainer to do more amazing new things one day!

options: To teach AI to think and learn.
To draw lots of pictures for AI.
To design fun coding games for AI.

Do you know how smartphones answer questions and robots play games? It’s so cool to see your phone give quick answers to your questions or watch a robot win a video game! Artificial intelligence (AI) and AI trainers (people who teach AI how to work) help make these things happen!

AI trainers are like teachers for computers. Their job is to teach AI to think and learn, just like your teachers help you learn maths and English. They work hard to make AI smarter day by day, and this smart AI makes people’s lives easier, like when your phone helps you find a way home or a robot cleans your room. Let’s learn about how they do their work.

First, they collect lots of information for AI. For example, if they want AI to learn about animals, they collect thousands of pictures of animals—from cute cats and playful dogs to colorful birds and big elephants. Then, they teach AI the differences between these animals, so it can recognize different animals quickly and exactly. After that, AI trainers test AI to see if it learns correctly. If AI makes a mistake, the trainers will go back and teach it again.

If you’re interested in becoming an AI trainer in the future, you need to study maths and science hard in school. These subjects help you understand how machines work and think! You can also try fun coding (编程) games to learn how to “talk” to machines. Who knows? Maybe you can become an AI trainer to do more amazing new things one day!
content: What will AI trainers do if AI makes a mistake?
options: They will let AI learn by itself.
They will collect the pictures of animals.
explanation: 细节理解题。根据“If AI makes a mistake, the trainers will go back and teach it again.”可知，AI出错时，训练师会重新教它。故选B。

material:

Many students feel nervous before or during exams, especially when they face important tests like mid-term or final exams. But with the right ways to calm down, you can stay relaxed and do your best in the exam. [[41]]

Arrive on time for the exam. If you arrive late, you’ll feel rushed and can’t calm down quickly [[42]] Showing up on time helps you focus on the exam before it starts.

[[43]] Don’t waste time on difficult problems, but finish the easy ones quickly. Go back to the difficult questions when you have time left. This way, you can answer all questions on time and can’t miss any easy questions.

Mind your handwriting. [[44]] And it may even help you get better grades. As an old Chinese saying goes, “You write what you are.”

Take care of yourself before exams. A good sleep makes your brain work better during the exam. [[45]] Besides, taking a short walk or listening to light music can help you stay relaxed and calm down.

Stay happy and confident. After the exam, don’t worry too much about your answers or grades. You can’t change what you wrote, so it’s no use feeling upset. The best thing to do is to let it go and prepare for the next one.

With these tips, you can deal with exam stress easily and do your best in every exam.
options: Try to ask the teacher for help.
Drink some water during the exam.
Here are some useful tips to help you.
Eating well helps you get enough energy for the exam.
Beautiful and tidy writing is easier for teachers to read.
If you arrive too early, you may worry too much about the exam.
explanation: 根据前文提及学生考试易紧张，且后文列出多条缓解压力的建议，此处是引出下文的实用技巧，选项D“这里有一些有用的建议来帮助你。”符合语境。故选D。

subject: english
content: Green is a [[_]] of yellow and blue. That’s true for paint, but not for light. (mix)
explanation: 句意：绿色是黄色和蓝色的混合体。这一点对于颜料来说是对的，但对光来说不是。此处需要名词作表语，“mix”对应的名词是“mixture”（意为“混合体”），前面有不定冠词“a”，所以用单数形式。故填mixture。

subject: english
content: Dahan is the [[_]] traditional Chinese solar term (节气). It is usually the coldest time of the year. (twenty-four)
explanation: 句意：大寒是中国二十四节气中的第二十四个节气，它通常是一年中最冷的时候。twenty-four是基数词，此处表示“第二十四个”，需用序数词，twenty-four的序数词为twenty-fourth，故填twenty-fourth。

subject: english
content: The weather in Yuxi is very [[_]]. It’s not too hot and not too cold. (please)
explanation: 句意：玉溪的天气非常宜人，不太热也不太冷。please“使高兴；使满意”，是动词；此处需用形容词作表语，修饰天气，因此填其形容词形式pleasant表示“令人愉快的；宜人的”。故填pleasant。

subject: english
content: I could hardly believe she made some short [[_]] about water pollution by herself. (video)
explanation: 句意：我简直不敢相信她自己制作了一些关于水污染的短视频。video“视频”，是可数名词；some后接可数名词复数，此处应该填复数形式videos。故填videos。

subject: english
content: We should take our studies [[_]]. Only in this way can we get good grades. (serious)
explanation: 句意：我们应该认真对待我们的学习。只有这样我们才能取得好成绩。此处需要用副词来修饰动词短语take our study，serious是形容词，意为“认真的”，serious的副词形式是seriously。take sth. seriously是固定搭配，意为“认真对待某事”。故填seriously。

subject: english
content: [[_]] seagulls (海鸥) come to Kunming every winter. (数以千计的)
explanation: 句意：数以千计的海鸥每年冬天都来到昆明。“数以千计的”英文表达是“thousands of”，这是一个固定短语，用来表示数量非常多，句首字母大写。故填Thousands of。

subject: english
content: Steven is crazy about DIY, and it takes up most of his [[_]]. (空闲时间)
explanation: 句意：史蒂文痴迷于DIY，这占据了他大部分的空闲时间。“空闲时间”对应的英文是“free time/spare time”，此处作宾语符合语境。故填free time/spare time。

subject: english
content:
将下列句子中汉语部分译成英语，注意使用适当的形式。

I want to say “Thank you!” to my class teacher [[_]] because he helped me a lot. (亲自)
explanation: 句意：我想亲自向我的班主任说“谢谢你！”，因为他帮助了我很多。根据汉语提示可知，副词personally或介词短语in person“亲自”符合句意，在句中作状语，修饰动词say。故填personally/in person。

subject: english
content: Yunnan [[_]] many kinds of wild plants and animals, so it’s important to protect it. (是……的家乡)
explanation: 句意：云南是多种野生动植物的家乡，所以保护它很重要。“是……的家乡”对应的英文短语是“be home to”，主语“Yunnan”是第三人称单数，一般现在时中be动词用“is”。故填is home to。

subject: english
content: Health [[_]] good habits, like eating well, exercising often and getting enough sleep. (取决于)
explanation: 句意：健康取决于良好的习惯，比如吃得健康、经常锻炼和睡眠充足。“取决于”的英文表达为depend on，主语“Health”为不可数名词，故谓语动词应用第三人称单数形式depends。故填depends on。

subject: english
answer:
例文

My Plan for the Meaningful Winter Holiday

The winter holiday is coming, and I have made a plan to make it meaningful. First, I will stay with my family more. We will cook together and share stories, which can make us closer. Second, I plan to read at least five English books to improve my reading skills. Third, I want to do some volunteer work at the local library to help organize books for readers.

Through these activities, I hope to learn new things, become more responsible, and feel the joy of helping others. I believe this holiday will be both relaxing and rewarding.
explanation:
[总体分析]

①题材：话题作文；

②时态：一般将来时；

③提示：写作要点已给出，注意不要遗漏，并适当增加细节，以使行文连贯，并突出重点，注意字母大小写以及标点符号。

[写作步骤]

第一步，点明寒假计划的目标是使其有意义；

第二步，从家庭活动、英语学习、志愿服务三个方面介绍具体计划；

第三步，总结希望通过这些活动获得的成长与感受。

[亮点词汇]

①stay with my family more更多陪伴家人

②improve my reading skills提高我的阅读技能

③volunteer work志愿服务

④both relaxing and rewarding既放松又有收获

[高分句型]

①We will cook together and share stories, which can make us closer. (which引导的非限制性定语从句)

②I plan to read at least five English books to improve my reading skills. (动词不定式作目的状语)

③I believe this holiday will be both relaxing and rewarding. (省略that的宾语从句，both…and…结构)

subject: english
content: I have [[_]] aunt and she plays [[_]] Chinese chess really well.
explanation:
句意：我有一个阿姨，她下中国象棋下得非常好。

考查冠词。a不定冠词，表泛指，用于以辅音音素开头的单词前；the定冠词，表特指；an不定冠词，表泛指，用于以元音音素开头的单词前。第一空，根据“aunt”可知，此处表示一个阿姨，应用不定冠词表泛指，且“aunt”是以元音音素开头的单词，要用an修饰；第二空，play Chinese chess“下中国象棋”，固定搭配，棋类名词前不加冠词。故选B。

subject: english
content: This is my friend. [[_]] is a Chinese boy. [[_]] favourite place is the gym.
explanation:
句意：这是我的朋友。他是一个中国男孩。他最喜欢的地方是体育馆。

考查人称代词和物主代词。He他；His他的。根据“...is a Chinese boy”以及选项可知，应用主格人称代词He，作主语，表示他是一个中国男孩；根据“...favourite place is the gym”以及选项可知，应用形容词性物主代词His，作定语，表示他最喜欢的地方。故选A。

subject: english
content: The cake is delicious! Can I have [[_]] piece, please?
explanation:
句意：蛋糕真好吃！请再给我一块好吗？

考查代词辨析。other其他的，后常接复数名词；another（泛指三者或以上的）另一个；others其他的人或物；the other（特指两者中的）另一个。根据“The cake is delicious! Can I have...piece, please?”可知，此处指想再吃一块蛋糕，应用another表泛指。故选B。

subject: english
content: Lucy likes reading. She spends a lot of time [[_]] every day.
explanation:
句意：露西喜欢阅读。她每天花大量的时间阅读。

考查非谓语动词。spend time doing sth固定用法，意为“花费时间做某事” 。故选C。

subject: english
content:
—Are they [[_]]?

—No, they’re carrots.
explanation:
句意：——它们是番茄植株吗？——不，它们是胡萝卜。

考查名词复数。当tomato用作定语修饰plant时，tomato要用单数形式。根据“Are they ...”可知，此处要用名词的复数形式，中心名词plant要用其复数形式plants。故选D。

subject: english
content:
—Is this [[_]] eraser, Bob?

—No. It is [[_]].
explanation:
句意：——Bob，这是你的橡皮吗？——不，它是Tom的。

考查代词和名词所有格。you你，代词主格或宾格；your你的，形容词性物主代词；Tom人名；Tom’s名词所有格形式。第一空，根据“Is this ... eraser”可知，此处要用一个形容词性物主代词来修饰名词eraser，要用your；第二空，根据“No. It is ...”可知，此处表示所属关系，要用名词所有格，用Tom’s。故选D。

subject: english
content: Tina Green is my class teacher. We can call her [[_]].
explanation:
句意：Tina Green是我的班主任，我们可以叫她Green女士。

考查常识。Mr. Green格林先生；Tina蒂娜女士；Ms. Green格林女士；Mrs. Tina蒂娜夫人。根据Tina Green这个名字可知，这位老师是个女士；在西方文化中，Tina是名，Green是姓，名在前，姓在后。再结合选项可知，这位老师应该被称为Ms. Green。故选C。

subject: english
content:
—What class are you in?

—I’m in [[_]].
explanation:

①As Daddy’s only daughter, I knew what made my Daddy more wonderful than all the other fathers, I’d ever seen or heard of—his large hands.

②Daddy had long smart fingers (指头) that could make lots of paper toys for me to play with. His hands could tie my hair beautifully. That’s why I felt happy when the other students talked about my hairstyle. I kept it to myself for years. His hands could paint a second-hand bike to look new. I got one on my tenth birthday.

③Daddy’s creative hands were also useful and hard—working. They could fly a kite high in the sky as well as to get it down from the top of a tree. They could wash my white dress clean, which became my favorite one. To my surprise, those hands fed seven children after Mom died. Daddy always tried his best to do everything for me.

④Not only were Daddy’s hands great, they could also send me a note full of love. When I was ill, he made me feel better. He would take a small blanket (毯子),warm it up and cover it around my small cold feet with his loving hands. When I was worried about something, Daddy would often hand me a cup of hot milk and talk with me. He would say, “The best is always to come, my dear.” to relax my heart.

⑤Daddy’s hands were fantastic. They had the knowledge (知识) and power to move mountains. They made the impossible possible.

Do you see “dopamine dressing (多巴胺穿搭)” on the Internet? It’s one of the most popular fashion styles (时尚风格). Now, many people take this style to fight back (反击) bad feelings and show themselves.

The meaning of dopamine dressing

A US fashion psychologist (心理学家) Dawnn Karen gives the name “dopamine dressing”. Dopamine dressing uses bright colours like pink, yellow and green, because they bring happy feelings to people.

The science behind colours

Science shows that different colours can make people feel different. For example, bright colours can make people feel happy. The colours like black, white and gray may make people sad.

Getting popular in the fashion world

Some fashion brands (品牌) use different colours in different ways. They say this could bring fun and surprise to the world through fashion.

Tips (小贴士) for dopamine dressing

If you want to try dopamine dressing but think it’s too much, you can try one thing at a time.

*Bags: With black and white clothes, you can use a bright pink or yellow bag.

*Shoes: You can light up your dark (暗色的) clothes with a pair of red shoes.

*Socks: Colourful socks can make you look cute.

Hello, everyone! My name is Alan Green. I’m an outgoing (外向的) boy. Our school has a Glee Club and it’s very nice. I know this because I’m a member (成员)! So what is a Glee Club? It’s a club for singing and I love singing.

Sam is my friend. He has [[61]] happy family. His father [[62]] (work) in a hospital in Beijing. He [[63]] (have) two eggs and a glass of milk for breakfast. His mother is a Chinese teacher in [[64]] (we) school. She eats some bread for breakfast. Her Chinese [[65]] (class) are very interesting, so her students [[66]] (real) love her. Sam and I are [[67]] the same class. He eats a hamburger and two bananas for lunch. He likes ice cream a [[68]], [[69]] his mother doesn’t want him to eat it. She thinks ice cream is [[70]] for his health.
explanation:
句意：他有一个幸福的家庭。根据“happy family”可知，此处泛指一个幸福的家庭，且happy是辅音音素开头的单词，用不定冠词a修饰。故填a。

句意：他的父亲在北京的一家医院工作。work“工作”，主语“His father”为第三人称单数，一般现在时中动词需改为三单形式works。故填works。

句意：他早餐吃两个鸡蛋和喝一杯牛奶。have“吃，喝”，主语“He”为第三人称单数，一般现在时中动词需改为三单形式has。故填has。

句意：他的母亲是我们学校的语文老师。此处需用形容词性物主代词修饰名词“school”，we的形容词性物主代词为our，意为“我们的”。故填our。

句意：她的语文课很有趣，所以她的学生都很喜欢她。根据“are”可知主语为复数，class的复数形式为classes。故填classes。

句意：她的语文课很有趣，所以她的学生都很喜欢她。此处需用副词修饰动词“love”，real的副词形式为really。故填really。

句意：Sam和我在同一个班级。表示“在班级里”用介词in。故填in。

句意：他很喜欢吃冰淇淋，但是他妈妈不让他吃。固定搭配a lot表示“非常”。故填lot。

句意：他很喜欢吃冰淇淋，但是他妈妈不让他吃。前后句为转折关系，用but连接。故填but。

句意：她认为冰淇淋对他的健康有害。根据“his mother doesn’t want him to eat it”可知，此处应该说冰淇淋对健康有害，固定搭配be bad for表示“对……有害”。故填bad。

People all over the world enjoy sports, because sports can help them keep healthy and live long. Some sports or games go back to(追溯到) thousands of years, like running or jumping. Chinese boxing, for example, has a very long history. But basketball and volleyball are very new. People are inventing new sports or games all the time.

Many people like to watch others play sports or games. They don’t play themselves. They buy tickets or turn on their TVs to watch the games. Often they get very excited and happy when their favorite player or team wins the match.

People play different sports in different seasons. Swimming is fun in warm weather, but skating is a good choice in winter. Some sports are so interesting that people everywhere enjoy them. For example, millions of people in more than 200 countries play basketball. People can play it in parks, schools, or fac- tories. What fun it is to watch an NBA match!

阅读短文，根据语篇内容，在方框内的缩写文章中，填入与短文意思最符合的单词，每空一词

As teenagers, you have many dreams. These dreams can be very big, such as winning the Nobel Prize, or can be small, such as becoming one of the ten best students in your class. Once you have a dream, what do you do with it? Do you ever try to make your dream real?

An Australian writer tells us that making our dreams real is our life’s biggest challenge. You may think you’re not very good at some school subjects, or that it is impossible for you to become a writer. These kinds of thoughts stop you from realizing your dream. In fact, everyone can make his dream come true. The first thing you must do is to remember what your dream is. Don’t let it leave your heart. Keep telling yourself what you want. Do this step by step and your dream will come true faster because a big dream is, in fact, made up of many small dreams.

You must also never give up your dream. There will be difficulties on the road to your dream. But the biggest difficulty comes from yourself. You need to decide what is the most important. Studying instead of watching TV will bring you better exam results. And saving five yuan instead of buying an ice cream means you can buy a new book.

If you don’t have dreams, you won’t make up your mind to learn something more useful and find new hobbies.

In China, the twelfth month of the lunar calendar (农历) is called “Layue”. Chinese people celebrate the Laba Festival on the [[44]] (eight) day of this month. After the festival, everyone in China gets ready for the Spring Festival. At the Laba Festival, people would like [[45]] (enjoy) the hot Laba porridge. People [[46]] (usual) cook it with eight different ingredients. And of course, you can also make it according [[47]] your own recipe. You will find it tastes [[48]] (good) than the ordinary (普通的) porridge. And the [[49]] (sweet) of the porridge is sure to make your mouth water.

The Laba porridge is also called Eight Treasure Porridge. Most people like cooking and having the porridge [[50]] it is not only good for their health, but also a blessing (祝福) for the coming of the Spring Festival. Why not make the porridge with [[51]] (you) family at the Laba Festival? I’m sure it can leave you [[52]] lot of sweet memories. To make the porridge delicious, one of the [[53]] (secret) is to cook with love.
explanation:
句意：中国人在这个月的第八天庆祝腊八节。根据“the...day of this month”可知，此处指第八天，应用序数词eighth“第八”。故填eighth。

句意：在腊八节，人们喜欢喝热腊八粥。would like to do sth.“想要做某事”，为固定短语，故此处应用动词不定式to enjoy。故填to enjoy。

句意：人们通常用八种不同的原料煮它。此处修饰动词cook，应用副词usually“通常”。故填usually。

句意：当然，你也可以根据自己的配方来做。according to“根据”，为固定短语。故填to。

句意：你会发现它比普通粥味道更好。根据“than”可知，此处应用形容词good的比较级better“更好”。故填better。

句意：粥的甜味一定会让你流口水。根据“the...of the porridge”可知，此处指粥的甜味，应用名词sweetness“甜味”。故填sweetness。

句意：大多数人喜欢煮和喝粥，因为它不仅对他们的健康有好处，而且也是对即将到来的春节的祝福。根据“Most people like cooking and having the porridge...it is not only good for their health, but also a blessing (祝福) for the coming of the Spring Festival.”可知，前后句为因果关系，前果后因，应用because“因为”引导原因状语从句。故填because。

句意：为什么不在腊八节和家人一起煮粥呢？此处修饰名词family，应用形容词性物主代词your“你的”。故填your。

句意：我相信它能给你留下许多美好的回忆。a lot of“许多”，为固定短语。故填a。

句意：要使粥美味，秘诀之一就是用爱心烹饪。one of the+名词复数，表示“……之一”，故此处应用名词secret“秘诀”的复数形式secrets。故填secrets。

When you travel, there are so many places to [[57]]: museums, shops and parks. You may spend most of your days walking [[58]] these places. You may be very tired after a few [[59]]. If this is the way you feel, you should take a good rest.

Sleep is [[60]] important. You may want to stay out late at night. In many cities, the nightlife can be very colorful. Then you should plan to sleep for an hour in the day.

Finally, if you want to stay healthy, you must eat good food. That [[61]] eating the right kinds of foods. When you are in a new country, you may want to try new food, but you need to be careful about how [[62]] you eat. Lots of rich (油腻的) food isn’t good for you.

So, remember these! If you want to enjoy your holiday, take good care of [[63]].

句意：那么你能做些什么来保持健康呢？根据“stay in good...”可知，此处指的是保持健康，health“健康”，名词作宾语。故填health。

material:
Boston University Summer Term High School Programs

Details

Start:June, July

Length:Two Weeks, Three Weeks, Six Weeks

Entering Grade:9th to 12th

Minimum (最低的) Cost:$1,500-$2,999

Call:(617) 353-1378

Overview

Boston University Summer Term High School Programs invite you to experience pre-college summer study at one of the world’s top teaching and research universities.

With four programs to choose from, you can earn college credits, discover new subject areas, perform research in university labs, or improve yourself through hands-on learning. You will have the opportunity to push yourself academically while experiencing college life and making friends with other students from 87 countries.

Information

·High School Honors — Rising seniors and outstanding rising juniors take undergraduate courses and earn up to 8 college credits. Six weeks — July 2-August 15.

·Research in Science and Engineering (RISE) — Rising seniors conduct university-level research with some of the nation’s brightest minds. Six weeks — July 2-August 11.

·Academic Immersion (AIM) — Rising seniors and seniors focus on one subject, combining classroom work with hands-on experiential learning. Three track options: Introduction to Experimental Psychology (心理学), Introduction to Medicine, or Creative Writing. Three weeks — Psychology: July 2-July 21; Medicine, or Creative Writing: July 23-August 11.

·Summer Challenge — Rising sophomore (二年级学生), juniors, and seniors explore two subjects of their choice and experience college life. Two weeks — Session 1: June 18-June 30; Session 2: July 9-July 21; Session 3: July 23-August 4.
content: What do we know about the programs?
options: They run from June to July.
They are held at different universities.
They are designed for high school students.

subject: english
material:
Time magazine has chosen its 2024 Kid of the Year—and it’s Heman Bekele, a teenager who could change the way skin cancer is treated.

As a student from Fairfax’s Woodson High School, Bekele divides his time between the classroom and the lab at Johns Hopkins University, where he’s inventing a soap that could one day treat the deadly disease. “I was raised under the thought that I could always ask questions, and be as curious as possible,” Bekele said. “And this pushed me to the field of science.” Heman was born in Ethiopia. He remembers seeing people in Africa working in the hot sun without protection for their skin. Because of that, some of them developed skin cancer, a disease caused by too much exposure to the sun. Treating the cancer is costly, about $40,000. Heman wondered if there was a cheaper way for people to deal with the disease.

At home, Bekele began wondering how he could help. “What’s one thing that is an internationally impactful (有影响力的) idea, something everyone can use, regardless of socioeconomic class?” Bekele asked himself. “Almost everyone uses soap and water for cleaning. So soap would probably be the best choice.” So Bekele began his thoughtful trial-and-error process, which led him to learn about a cream-based skin cancer treatment called Imiquimod that did produce satisfying results—but can cost as much as $180 for the insured in America. Inspired by the cream, Bekele designed his affordable soap.

Bekele knew he’d need an actual lab to improve his creation. Bekele applied to—and won—the Minnesota-based tech company 3M’s Young Scientist Challenge in 2024, securing $25,000 and the title of “America’s Top Young Scientist”. Now, with the help of Johns Hopkins’ professor and biologist Vito Rebecca, Bekele has been testing the soap on mice at the university’s lab for almost half a year. The soap still has a long way to go: Perfecting it could take ten years. But even then, Bekele will only be 26 years old.
content: What does the underlined part “exposure to” in paragraph 2 mean?
explanation: 词义猜测题。根据第二段内容可知，非洲人在烈日下劳作却没有防护措施，由此患上了皮肤癌。因此exposure to the sun意为“暴露在阳光下/与阳光接触”，与Contact with含义相近。故选D项。

subject: english
material:
Olympic athletes pour everything into training for the Games. They regularly go beyond their physical and mental limits to the edge for a chance at a gold medal. Yet they are often hit by an emotional letdown afterward.

Emotions are increased by the very nature of the event. The Olympics are a huge global occasion — a mix of worldwide public attention, financial investment (资金投入), and media coverage. New international stars are born, and some competitors’ good names are destroyed among various criticisms. Athletes face high pressure to represent their countries and win medals before a global crowd. “But after the Games, all the attention and excitement for the Olympians quickly disappears,” says Cogan, a leading sports psychologist. “It’s a bit like having a detailed map to reach a destination. Once you arrive, you might feel confused and wonder, ‘Now what?’”

A 2025 study shed light on the identity (身份) problems athletes face because of over focus on performance, leaving their non-athletic selves underdeveloped. In a 2018 paper, Howells wrote that athletes with too narrow a focus are easier to feeling “down.” “It’s common for top competitors to have this very strong athletic identity”, Howells explains. “They’ve sacrificed (牺牲) almost every other part of who they are to be an Olympian. They may not realize that their single-minded run after Olympic dreams could have bad results later in life.”

Efforts to change this mindset have encouraged some athletes to open up more about their mental health struggles. Experts recommend that Olympians start protections about mental health support long before the Games begin. They should also discuss strategies for mental examination before, during, and after the competition.

Athletes and experts note that the sports industry has, over the past decade, been promoting a better work-life balance outside of competition. Briana, a soccer goalkeeper, says her team and coaches actively encourage spending quality time with family and loved ones, as well as following hobbies that bring joy and a sense of achievement.
content: What is the focus of paragraph 2?
explanation: 主旨大意题。第二段先点明奥运会的高关注度、高投入等特性给运动员带来巨大压力，随后引用运动心理学家的观点，指出赛事结束后关注度的迅速消退，是导致运动员陷入迷茫和情绪低落的关键原因。整段围绕奥运选手赛后情绪低落的诱因展开。故选A项。

subject: english
material:
Olympic athletes pour everything into training for the Games. They regularly go beyond their physical and mental limits to the edge for a chance at a gold medal. Yet they are often hit by an emotional letdown afterward.

Emotions are increased by the very nature of the event. The Olympics are a huge global occasion — a mix of worldwide public attention, financial investment (资金投入), and media coverage. New international stars are born, and some competitors’ good names are destroyed among various criticisms. Athletes face high pressure to represent their countries and win medals before a global crowd. “But after the Games, all the attention and excitement for the Olympians quickly disappears,” says Cogan, a leading sports psychologist. “It’s a bit like having a detailed map to reach a destination. Once you arrive, you might feel confused and wonder, ‘Now what?’”

A 2025 study shed light on the identity (身份) problems athletes face because of over focus on performance, leaving their non-athletic selves underdeveloped. In a 2018 paper, Howells wrote that athletes with too narrow a focus are easier to feeling “down.” “It’s common for top competitors to have this very strong athletic identity”, Howells explains. “They’ve sacrificed (牺牲) almost every other part of who they are to be an Olympian. They may not realize that their single-minded run after Olympic dreams could have bad results later in life.”

Efforts to change this mindset have encouraged some athletes to open up more about their mental health struggles. Experts recommend that Olympians start protections about mental health support long before the Games begin. They should also discuss strategies for mental examination before, during, and after the competition.

Athletes and experts note that the sports industry has, over the past decade, been promoting a better work-life balance outside of competition. Briana, a soccer goalkeeper, says her team and coaches actively encourage spending quality time with family and loved ones, as well as following hobbies that bring joy and a sense of achievement.
content: What might be a basic solution to the athletes’ identity problem?
explanation: 推理判断题。第三段指出运动员身份问题的根源是过度聚焦运动表现，非运动层面的自我认知发展不足；最后一段提到体育行业正在推动运动员实现赛场外的工作与生活平衡，鼓励他们陪伴家人、培养爱好。由此可推知，解决身份问题的根本方法是让运动员建立超越体育领域的多元身份认同。故选D项。

subject: english
material:
The Haskell Free Library and Opera House might not be as well-known as the Grand Canyon or the Statue of Liberty. [[32]]. Completed in 1904, the building is located directly between Stanstead, Quebec, and Derby Line, Vermont with the official US-Canada border line running right across the library’s floor.

Martha Stewart Haskell and her son, Colonel Horace Stewart Haskell, both Canadians, built the building as a tribute (纪念) to Mrs Haskell’s late husband, Carlos. [[33]].

While the Haskell Free Library’s official entrance is on the US side of the building, most of the books are on the Canadian side. [[34]]. The Opera House is similarly divided, with most of its seats in the US and its stage in Canada. As Atlas Obscura reported, it is often said that the Haskell is the only library in the US with no books, and the only opera house in the country with no stage.

Passports and other forms of identification aren’t required to cross from country to country in the library, though the Haskell’s website notes that the border inside the building “is real and it is enforced (强制执行)”. [[35]]. If they don’t, they risk possible detention (拘留) and fines.

Even beyond the building’s unique position, library director Nancy Rumery told CTV News that Haskell workers — Canadian and American alike — consider it to be like any other library in the world.

“We’re just trying to be the best library we can. [[36]].” she said. “These are all our neighbors and we do our very best to help them on their life-long learning journey.”
options: It is divided between the two countries.
The Haskell Free Library is full of mysterious places.
Visitors have access to a variety of cultural resources.
Our community is made up of people from two different countries.
Visitors are expected to return to their side of the border after a visit.
However, it’s undoubtedly one of America’s most unique tourist attractions
The family hoped that citizens would use it as a “center for learning and cultural enrichment”.
explanation: 前句提到该图书馆和歌剧院“可能不如大峡谷或自由女神像那么有名”，后句介绍其建成时间和地理位置——位于美加边境线，建筑被国境线横穿。F项“然而，它无疑是美国最独特的旅游景点之一”通过转折关系衔接上下文，既承接前文的“知名度不高”，又引出后文对其独特之处的介绍，符合逻辑。故选F项。

People [[37]] their lights and shouted angrily at me as they [[38]].

I called Discovery Insure to help. When waiting, I saw the truck [[46]] behind us and a man ran up quickly. I said I couldn’t pay him and my insurance (保险) service was on the way. He said, “I don’t want money. Someone will probably [[47]] you. You aren’t safe here.” Then I knew his name, Godfrey.

After placing a warning [[48]] behind my car, Godfrey took us to his truck, managed to pull my car onto his truck, and drove us to [[49]]. His behavior made me so moved. I was [[50]], saying the world needs more people like him. Godfrey waited until Discovery Insure came. Knowing we were OK, Godfrey drove off as quickly as he appeared! People [[37]] their lights and shouted angrily at me as they [[38]].

I bet you have no idea how terrible it is on the [[39]] flowing at 120 km. When you’re [[40]], you are a part of the flow and you don’t feel the speed. When you [[41]], you suddenly realize how dangerous you are. As a 16-wheel truck [[42]] my car’s back window, I found it stopped in order not to hit me. Cars got [[43]] behind me one after another and tried to miss each other and [[44]] themselves from running into me. We felt [[45]] sorry for them.

I called Discovery Insure to help. When waiting, I saw the truck [[46]] behind us and a man ran up quickly. I said I couldn’t pay him and my insurance (保险) service was on the way. He said, “I don’t want money. Someone will probably [[47]] you. You aren’t safe here.” Then I knew his name, Godfrey.

After placing a warning [[48]] behind my car, Godfrey took us to his truck, managed to pull my car onto his truck, and drove us to [[49]]. His behavior made me so moved. I was [[50]], saying the world needs more people like him. Godfrey waited until Discovery Insure came. Knowing we were OK, Godfrey drove off as quickly as he appeared! He was gone, but his [[51]] left a long-lasting impression on me!
explanation: quit 放弃；forget 忘记；avoid 避免；prevent 阻止。根据后文“from running into me”的搭配和语境，后方车辆努力避让，“防止”撞到作者的车，故选D项。

subject: english
content:
Tom, a passionate musician, started playing [[52]] guitar when he was 12. He taught [[53]] (he) by watching online videos and practicing every day. His hard work paid off, and he became quite skilled at the guitar soon.

When he entered high school, Tom wanted to form a band. He invited some classmates [[54]] (join) him, as they shared the love for music. At first, their band was not very good. But they kept practicing and improving [[55]] (steady). They wrote their own songs, [[56]] (draw) inspiration from their daily lives.

One time, they performed at a school talent show. They were very nervous, [[57]] the audience loved their performance. After that, their band got more and more popular in the school. A teacher said, “Their music has a [[58]] (power)influence on students.”

Tom’s parents were initially worried that music would affect his studies. But seeing his devotion, they became supportive. Now, Tom’s band often [[59]] (play)at local events. For Tom, music is not just a hobby — it’s a way to express himself.

Last month, they released their first song, [[60]] quickly became very popular. Thanks [[61]] their determination, they have achieved their initial dreams.
explanation:
考查冠词。play后接西洋乐器时，乐器名词前需加定冠词the，guitar为西洋乐器，故填the。

考查代词。teach oneself为固定短语，意为“自学”，故填himself。

考查非谓语动词。invite sb. to do sth.为固定搭配，意为“邀请某人做某事”，故填to join。

考查副词。空处修饰动词improving，应用副词形式，steady的副词为steadily，意为“稳步地”，故填steadily。

考查非谓语动词。分析句子结构，句中已有谓语动词wrote，空处应用非谓语动词；主语they与draw之间为主动关系，故用现在分词作伴随状语，填drawing。

考查连词。前半句“他们非常紧张”与后半句“观众喜欢他们的表演”之间为转折关系，应用but或yet连接，故填but/yet。

考查形容词。空处修饰名词influence，应用形容词作定语，故填powerful。

考查时态和主谓一致。根据时间状语now和频度副词often可知，此处应用一般现在时；主语Tom’s band为单数，谓语动词应用第三人称单数形式，故填plays。

考查定语从句。空处引导非限制性定语从句，先行词为their first song，指物，关系词在从句中作主语，故填which。

考查介词。thanks to为固定短语，意为“由于、多亏”，故填to。

subject: english
answer:
Dear Jack,

I’m sorry to learn that you are anxious about the upcoming swimming class. Actually, you are not alone. So I’m writing to offer some advice.

To begin with, it will be wise of you to practice in advance to get yourself well prepared for some basic swimming skills, like floating, breathing and kicking. What’s more, you’d better calm down before class and concentrate on mastering what you have learned, helping you go through all challenges step by step. Besides, it’s highly recommended that you exchange feelings with your classmates when necessary for the team is another source of courage and confidence.

Hopefully you will find these suggestions useful. Looking forward to hearing your good news soon.

Yours, Li Hua

subject: english
content:
阅读下面材料，根据其内容和所给段落开头与续写两段，使之构成一篇完整的短文。

I grew up in a poor family in a small town. With our mother often working nights at a factory, my older sister, Anne, six years my senior, became like a second mother and my best friend.

At seventeen, my only chance for college was a scholarship (奖学金) interview in a distant city. The opportunity filled me with excitement, but also with a deep fear. “Anne,” I told her about my worry one evening. “I’m afraid they’ll judge me before I even speak.” I showed her my pitiful collection of “best” clothes: the old blouse and pants, and worst of all, the worn-out shoes. “It’s the hole in the bottom of the shoes that I’m most worried about,” I said, showing her how I would have to carefully place my feet to hide the hole. “What if I forget and someone sees? What if it rains?” The thought of being judged as poor in that important room was terrifying.

Seeing my anxiety, Anne took me to a department store the following weekend. We walked to the shoe section, and she pointed to a fine pair of leather (皮制的) shoes. “Try these on,” she suggested. When I did, they gave me a sense of safety. “We can’t afford these, Anne,” I said, immediately taking them off, my heart aching.

“I can,” she said firmly, already heading to the sales girl. I tried to stop her, reminding her of her own struggles as a part-time student. But she turned to me, her mind made up. “You need to walk into that room standing tall, not thinking about the hole in your shoe. Let this one thing not be a worry for you.” I was speechless, holding the shoes that felt far heavier than their weight.

注意：1. 续写次数应为150左右；

2. 请按如下格式在答题卡相应位置作答。

Wearing the new shoes, I entered the interview room.

____________________________________________________________________________________________

____________________________________________________________________________________________

____________________________________________________________________________________________

When I opened the door at home, I saw Anne’s anxious face.

____________________________________________________________________________________________

____________________________________________________________________________________________

____________________________________________________________________________________________
answer:
Para 1

Wearing the new shoes, I entered the interview room. The shoes felt comfortable, and every step I took made me less nervous. The interviewers smiled at me, and I answered their questions clearly, without thinking about the old worn-out shoes anymore. When I talked about my dreams of going to college, my voice was loud and firm. After the interview, I walked out of the room with a big smile, knowing I had done my best, all thanks to Anne’s help.

Para 2

When I opened the door at home, I saw Anne’s anxious face. She ran up to me right away, asking, “How was the interview? Did everything go well?” I hugged her tightly and said, “It was great! Those new shoes gave me so much courage.” Then I told her how confident I felt during the interview. Anne’s eyes lit up, and she said, “I knew you could do it.” At that moment, I realized that the most precious thing isn’t the new shoes, but the deep love and support from my sister that always helps me go forward.

content:
从每小题所给的A、B、C三个选项中，选出能填入空白处的最佳答案。

21.Look! The horse [[_]] a sheep.
explanation:
句意：看！那匹马正在追赶一只羊。

考查现在进行时的用法。根据“Look”可知，句子时态为现在进行时，其谓语结构为“be+doing”，故选C。

subject: english
content: [[_]] school life is very busy. So it is important for [[_]] to make good use of time.
explanation:
句意：我们的学校生活非常忙碌。因此，对我们来说，合理利用时间很重要。

考查代词辨析。we我们，人称代词主格；us我们，人称代词宾格；our我们的，形容词性物主代词。根据名词短语“school life”可知，第一空应用形容词性物主代词作定语，而由“for”可知，此处应用宾格作宾语，故选C。

subject: english
content: You need [[_]] your room tidy.
explanation:
句意：你需要保持房间整洁。

考查非谓语动词。need作情态动词时，后接动词原形，没有人称和数的变化，主要用于否定句、疑问句和条件句中；而本句中的need作实义动词，后接动词不定式时，表示“需要做某事”，即need to do sth.；后接动名词时，即need doing sth.，表达“某事需要被做”，相当于“need to be done”，主动形式表被动含义，本句主语为“You”，不用被动情况，应用动词不定式。故选C。

考查特殊疑问句。How about后需接动名词；Let’s后接动词原形，但用于祈使句；Why not后接动词原形，表示建议性疑问，符合对话语境。故选C。

subject: english
content:
— You know what? This year we have P.E.lessons every day.

— Great! It’s really [[_]] for us students to have a strong body.
explanation:
句意：——你知道吗？今年我们每天都有体育课。——太好了！对我们学生来说，拥有强壮的身体真的很重要。

考查形容词辨析。important重要的；interesting有趣的；different不同的。根据“to have a strong body”可知，身体健康对学生来说是重要的。故选A。

subject: english
content:
—[[_]] does he go to Guangzhou on business (出差)?

—Very often. Almost every year.
explanation:
句意：——他多久去广州出差一次？——很频繁。几乎每年都去。

考查疑问词辨析。How long多久，询问时长；How often多久一次，询问频率；What time几点，询问具体时间。根据答句“Very often. Almost every year.”可知，这是在询问频率。故选B。

content: It’s a [[_]] day. Don’t go out, or you can be all wet.
explanation:

考查形容词辨析。cloudy多云的；sunny晴朗的；rainy有雨的。根据“Don’t go out, or you can be all wet. ”可知，此处是说“今天是雨天。”故选C。

subject: english
content:
—Let’s watch the football game on TV.

—It’s over. And the [[_]] is two to one. China wins the game.

考查名词辨析。side方面；survey调查；result结果。根据“is two to one. China wins the game.”可知，这是比赛的结果，故选C。

subject: english
content:
—Why do you look so happy, Lin Ling?

—Because I [[_]] a new bike from my grandparents.
explanation:
句意：——你为什么看起来这么高兴，林玲？——因为我从祖父母那里得到一辆新自行车。

考查动词辨析。get得到；give给予；make制作。根据上下文“Why do you look so happy”可知，林玲高兴的原因是她收到了祖父母给的新自行车，强调“得到”的动作，因此用“get”最符合句意。故选A。

content:
— Do you know the [[_]] between bats and birds?

— Yes. Bats are active at night but birds are active in the day.

Do you like flowers? Do you know about plum blossoms? Plum blossoms are a special kind of flower.

The plant can grow up to 10 meters tall. Plum blossoms come in the main colors: white, red, pink and yellow. They grow on a plum tree. A plum tree has many branches. They are long and thin. Plum blossoms grow on these branches. Each flower has five petals. They have a sweet smell (香气) and make people happy.

The flowers bloom (开花) at different times around the country. In the south, such as Guangzhou and Xiamen, they bloom from December to February. In the north, such as Beijing, they begin to bloom in late March or April.

Plum blossoms open up quietly during cold days. Many flowers do not like the cold, but plum blossoms stand in snow and ice bravely (勇敢地). They make the cold world more beautiful. Plum blossoms are Number One of the Top Ten Chinese flowers. The flowers are very important to Chinese people because of their history and cultural meanings: happiness, good luck and hope. subject: english
content:
Bamboo is one of the most useful plants. Many people call this plant a tree—a tall tree, but it [[81]] (be) a kind of grass.

There are more than 500 [[82]] (kind) of bamboo; some are tall but some are not. This plant grows well in warm places. It [[83]] (come) in a lot of colors, from yellow to black.

The Chinese people are very good [[84]] using bamboo. They use it to make many things, [[85]] as boxes and cooking tools (用具). They even use it to build buildings because it is [[86]] (real) strong. They also use it to make paper. A lot of Chinese singers write beautiful songs about bamboo [[87]] many artists draw it in pictures.

Now, farmers in many poor countries are [[88]] (learn) how to find water by using bamboo. These farmers need many easy [[89]] (way) to get water because they have little money, and their crops (庄稼) can’t live without rain or water. Bamboo can help [[90]] (they) bring water to their crops without spending much money.
explanation:
句意：很多人把这种植物叫做树——一棵高大的树，但它是一种草。句子为一般现在时，根据主语“it”（第三人称单数），结合一般现在时的be动词用法，此处填“is”。故填is。

句意：竹子有500多种；有些很高，有些不高。根据“more than 500（超过500）”，“kind”需用复数形式表示“种类”。故填kinds。

句意：它有很多颜色，从黄色到黑色。根据主语“it”（第三人称单数），结合一般现在时的动词变化规则，“come”需用第三人称单数形式“comes”。故填comes。

句意：中国人很擅长利用竹子。根据固定搭配“be good at（擅长）”，此处填“at”。故填at。

句意：他们用它做很多东西，比如盒子和炊具。根据固定搭配“such as（比如）”，可知此处填“such”。故填such。

句意：他们甚至用它来建房子，因为它真的很坚固。根据“strong（坚固的）”是形容词，需用副词修饰，“real”的副词形式是“really”。故填really。

句意：很多中国歌手写关于竹子的优美歌曲，很多艺术家把它画在画里。根据前后两个句子是并列关系，此处填并列连词“and”。故填and。

句意：现在，很多贫困国家的农民正在学习如何用竹子找水。根据“Now（现在）”，句子用现在进行时（be+doing），“learn”的现在分词是“learning”。故填learning。

句意：这些农民需要很多简单的方法来取水，因为他们没什么钱，而且他们的庄稼离不开雨水或水。根据“many（很多）”，“way”需用复数形式“ways”。故填ways。

句意：竹子可以帮助他们不用花很多钱就能给庄稼引水。根据“help（帮助）”后接宾格，“they”的宾格是“them”。故填them。

His mum said, “Aron, you get angry easily, but you never [[16]] why those things happen.”

Then she [[17]] explained, “Those people did [[18]] wrong. The kids just showed off but didn’t hurt you. Your teacher scolded (批评) you because you [[19]] trouble in class. Your schoolmate just wanted to help you. Next time when you’re angry, take a deep breath and walk away for a while. Then [[20]] and talk to that person. You’ll feel better.”

You may not agree your friends or family sometimes. Here are some ways to make your talks polite and meaningful.

Listen to their side

Even if you don’t agree with others, you should listen to them carefully. Show that you are listening by looking at them, nodding and facing them.

Try respectful language

When someone has an opinion you don’t agree with, it can be easy to dismiss it. Here are some ways to express your opinion politely. Stay calm and use “I” not “You”. For example, you can say “I feel” or “I see this in another way”. Don’t use “We” even if your friends agree with you.

▲

An opinion based only on feelings is not strong. If you have a strong opinion, you can show it better with facts. Facts are true and not just feelings or guesses. Speak in a calm voice and make sure your facts are true.

Look for shared ideas

You may not change others’ opinions, and they may not change yours. But try to find something you both agree on. It is worth doing this because good talks help you get on well with others.

subject: english
content:
配对阅读。左栏是五位同学的需求，右栏是七则与健康相关的活动信息。请为每位同学匹配合适的活动。

[[31]] Tom wants to learn how to make healthy salads for his family.

[[32]] Jenny feels stressed and wants to learn how to manage it.

[[33]] David wants to learn eye exercises to protect his eyes from screen time.

[[34]] Sarah wants to join a sports activity to keep fit with others in the afternoon.

[[35]] Bob wants to share his homemade healthy cookies in an activity.

A. Eye Exercise Class: Practice simple eye exercises to relax your eyes. Time: 1:00 p.m., Sunday.

B. Healthy Cooking Workshop: Learn to make healthy salads and sandwiches. Time: 10:00 a.m., Saturday.

C. Running Club: Join us for daily running to keep fit. Time: 6:00 a.m., every day.

D. Sleep Improvement Talk: Learn how to get better sleep every night. Time: 4:00 p.m., Thursday.

E. Healthy Food Sharing Party: Share your homemade healthy food and exchange recipes. Time: 3:00 p.m., Monday.

F. Group Yoga Session: Do yoga with others to keep fit and relax. Time: 5:00 p.m., Friday.

G. Stress Management Lecture: Learn tips to reduce stress and stay calm. Time: 2:00 p.m., Wednesday.
explanation:
根据“Tom wants to learn how to make healthy salads for his family”可知，Tom的需求是学习制作健康沙拉，而选项B的“Healthy Cooking Workshop: Learn to make healthy salads and sandwiches”正是教授制作健康沙拉的课程，与Tom的需求完全匹配。

根据“Jenny feels stressed and wants to learn how to manage it”可知，Jenny希望学习如何管理压力，而选项G的“Stress Management Lecture: Learn tips to reduce stress and stay calm”是关于压力管理的讲座，能帮助她减压，符合她的需求。

根据“David wants to learn eye exercises to protect his eyes from screen time”可知，David想学习眼保健操保护眼睛，而选项A的 “Eye Exercise Class: Practice simple eye exercises to relax your eyes”是专门的眼保健操课程，正好满足他的需求。

根据“Sarah wants to join a sports activity to keep fit with others in the afternoon”可知，Sarah想在下午和他人一起参加运动健身，而选项F的“Group Yoga Session: Do yoga with others to keep fit and relax. Time: 5:00 p.m., Friday”是下午时段的团体瑜伽活动，既满足了运动健身的需求，也符合时间和同伴的要求。

根据“Bob wants to share his homemade healthy cookies in an activity”可知，Bob想分享自己制作的健康饼干，而选项E的“Healthy Food Sharing Party: Share your homemade healthy food and exchange recipes”是分享自制健康食物的活动，与Bob的需求一致。

subject: english
content:
请从方框内选择适当的词并用其正确形式填空，使文章完整连贯。注意每空一词，每词仅用一次，有两词为多余项。

as begin choose if creative happy

in outdoor kind next share comfortable

The end of one year means the start of a new one. You might think about your resolutions at the [[36]] of the new year. Maybe you’ll decide to take up a hobby this year. But to [[37]] a hobby is more than just picking an activity. Make sure it is something you are interested [[38]].

First, think about what brings you [[39]]. Do you find joy in being outdoors, or do you feel [[40]] when you stay at home? If you enjoy nature, you can have a hobby like gardening or hiking. For [[41]] people, activities like painting, cooking or writing may be good.

Then, ask yourself about the time. How much time can you spend on a hobby? Some hobbies, such [[42]] reading or listening to music, can be done at any time. For other hobbies, you need to do an activity regularly (定期地).

You can join a club [[43]] you want to make more friends. You can [[44]] an interest with other students in the club. It can be a book club, a sports team or a dancing group. This can be a great way to meet all [[45]] of people.

In a word, the best hobby for you is something that brings you joy and self-improvement. So for your New Year’s resolution, why not get yourself into a hobby this year?
explanation:
句意：你可能会在新年伊始思考自己的新年决心。“at the beginning of”是固定搭配，意为“在……的开端”，契合“新年伊始思考决心”的语境；begin是动词，此处需用其名词形式beginning构成该短语。

句意：但是选择一项爱好，并不只是挑选一项活动那么简单。句子主语为不定式结构，需用动词原形；结合后文“picking an activity”，此处表达“选择爱好”的含义，故用choose。

句意：确保它是你感兴趣的事物。“be interested in”是固定搭配，意为“对……感兴趣”，此处in是该短语的必要组成部分，符合“爱好要选自己感兴趣的”的语境。

句意：首先，想想什么能给你带来快乐。bring sb. sth.是固定结构，意为“给某人带来某物”，此处需填名词；结合后文“Do you find joy in being outdoors”，表达“带来快乐”，故用happy的名词形式happiness。

句意：你是在户外活动中找到乐趣，还是待在家里时感到舒适？feel为感官动词，后接形容词作表语；此处对比户外和居家的感受，“待在家感到舒适”符合逻辑，故填comfortable。

句意：对于有创造力的人来说，绘画、烹饪或写作这类活动可能很合适。此处需用形容词修饰名词people；painting, cooking or writing这类活动需要创造力，故用creative修饰，契合语境。

句意：有些爱好，比如阅读或听音乐，随时都可以进行。“such as”是固定搭配，意为“例如”，用于列举“reading or listening to music”这类爱好，是英语中列举事物的常用表达，故填as。

句意：如果你想交更多朋友，可以加入一个俱乐部。此处引导条件状语从句，表达“如果想交更多朋友，可以加入俱乐部”的逻辑关系，故用连词if。

句意：你可以和俱乐部里的其他同学分享一项爱好。情态动词can后接动词原形；结合“在俱乐部和同学”的语境，表达“分享兴趣”，share sth. with sb.是固定搭配，意为“和某人分享某物”。

句意：这会是认识各种各样的人的好方法。“all kinds of”是固定搭配，意为“各种各样的”，此处表达“认识不同类型的人”，故用kind的复数形式kinds。

subject: english
material: 五、读写综合（本大题分为A、B两部分，共25分）
content:
假设你是Lin Tao的好朋友Li Hua，请你给他写一封建议信，帮助他养成健康的生活习惯，保持身心健康。

内容提示：

写作要求：

(1) 词数80词左右，开头、结尾不计入总词数；

(2) 必须包含所有提示要点，可适当拓展；

(3) 语句通顺，逻辑清晰，语法正确；

(4) 文中不得出现真实姓名、校名。

Dear Lin Tao,

I’m sorry to learn that you are upset and worried. I’d like to share some advice with you.

_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

I hope my advice can help you and you will be better soon.

Yours,

Li Hua
answer:
例文
Dear Lin Tao,
I’m sorry to learn that you are upset and worried. I’d like to share some advice with you.
First, you should have a healthy diet. It is important to eat more fruit and vegetables instead of junk food. And you’d better avoid cold drinks, as they are bad for your health. Second, use your mobile phone less. Don’t stay up late playing games, watching short videos or chatting. You need enough sleep to stay energetic. You can do sports or do other things to relax. Finally, communicate with your parents. Try to understand their love and talk to them nicely.
I hope my advice can help you and you will be better soon.
Yours,
Li Hua

A

Li Le

Beijing

I usually read for about 1.5 hours every day. Most of the time, I read textbooks or short articles after finishing homework. There’s a lot of pressure with schoolwork. How I wish to have more time to enjoy my favorite books!

Wu Ke

Shanghai

I spend around 2 hours reading daily. My school has a great library, so I borrow (借) books often—mostly science and history. Even on busy days, I try to read for at least 30 minutes before bed. It’s a good way to relax after studying.

Qian Li

Shenzhen

content: Which teenager spends the most time reading every day?

Money isn’t easy to get, but many students don’t think much about it. They might ask parents for new toys, nice clothes or expensive snacks without hesitation. What they may forget is: Where does the money come from? It doesn’t grow on trees.

Most parents work hard for their money. Some get up early for work and come back late after a long day. Others do heavy or boring jobs just to make money to support the family. Every penny they make comes from their hard work.

If you waste money, you are not just throwing away paper but ignoring (忽视) your parents’ efforts. For example: buying an expensive pen but losing it soon, or ordering too much food and leaving a lot on the plate. These small acts of waste add up. When we waste, we are wasting our parents’ efforts.

Being thrifty (节约的) doesn’t mean being stingy (吝啬的). It means using money wisely. Think carefully before buying something, save for what you really need and cherish (珍爱) what you have. Let’s remember: every coin counts, and hard work should never be wasted.

根据材料内容选择最佳答案。

explanation: 第一段指出“Money isn’t easy to get, but many students don’t think much about it. They might ask parents for new toys, nice clothes or expensive snacks without hesitation.”，这直接说明“without hesitation”指不经过认真思考就向父母索要东西。

Dear Miss Zhang,

It’s so great to be in touch with you! I only knew several (几个) letters of English when I entered Xiaoguan Junior High School. But three years in your class were my most precious (珍贵的) memories.

Back then, I was too nervous to speak English. Yet, you never looked down on “zero-basic” students like me. You kept on encouraging us, “Speak bravely! It’s okay to make mistakes!” With your help, I was able to learn step by step.

To improve our listening skills, you bought a tape recorder (录音机) with your own money. After that, our classroom was filled with English songs. You made English learning lively.

When I decided to work to support my poor family, you suggested, “Your starting point may not be high, but as long as you work hard, the future will be better. You should walk out of the mountains to see the world.” For me, a left-behind child, these words were not just encouragement but a seed (种子) of hope planted in my heart. I began to try my best to realize that dream.

Thanks to your help, now I’m an English teacher abroad, and your words and teaching methods still guide me. Thank you for lighting up my life!

Yours,

Li Mei

根据材料内容选择最佳答案。
content: Why was Li Mei nervous when speaking English in the beginning?
options: Because Miss Zhang was very strict.
Because the English classes were boring.
Because she had no basic English knowledge.

Li Mei

content:
阅读短文，从方框中选择适当的词并用其正确形式填空，使短文通顺，意思完整。每空限填一词，每词限用一次。

coin of direct shell borrow trade business sheep but type

Have you been to a money museum? What [[56]] of money do you know? You may say [[57]] and banknotes. But do you know that in ancient times, many things were used as forms [[58]] money?

At first, people traded goods [[59]]. They used natural products such as shells and feathers, and animals like hens and [[60]]. On a small island in Micronesia, people used stones as money. [[61]] money was first used in ancient China.

With the development of our society, people began to use goods like salt, grains (谷物) and cloth (布) to [[62]]. Can you guess what kind of money you can eat? Yes, it’s cheese! In northern Italy, people would use their cheese as security (抵押品) when they [[63]] money from a bank. Later, to make doing [[64]] easier, people began to use metal as money. Gold was a major one. In ancient China, gold was not only wealth (财富) [[65]] also a symbol of power.
explanation:
句意：你知道哪些种类的货币？根据“banknotes”可知是对货币种类的回答，对应使用What type of…来提问货币类型。

句意：你可能会说硬币和纸币。根据“and banknotes”可知空格处应填与纸币并列的货币形式，coin“硬币”符合常识，且需用复数形式coins，表示泛指一类事物。

句意：但你知道在古代，许多东西都被用作货币形式吗？此处使用搭配forms of money，意为“货币的形式”。

句意：起初，人们直接进行商品交易。后文提到古代早期交易使用天然产物和动物，这是一种直接的物物交换，此处需要副词修饰动词traded，填入direct的副词形式directly“直接地”。

句意：他们使用贝壳、羽毛等天然产物，以及鸡和羊等动物作为货币。根据“animals like hens and ”说明填入一种动物，sheep“羊”是动物，且单复数同形。

句意：贝壳货币最早是在中国古代被使用的。前文提到密克罗尼西亚用石头做货币，此处表示什么类型的货币是中国最早开始使用的，对应的是贝壳Shell货币，句首首字母大写。

句意：随着社会的发展，人们开始用盐、谷物和布等商品来进行交易。人们使用商品代替实物交换的目的是进行交易trade，此处结构为不定式，使用动词原形即可。

句意：在意大利北部，人们从银行借钱时，会用奶酪作为担保。此处使用搭配borrow sth. from…，意为“从……借某物”，此处borrow money from a bank是指从银行借钱；故事叙述的是过去的事情，使用一般过去时，填入borrow的过去式borrowed。

句意：后来，为了让交易更便捷，人们开始使用金属作为货币。此处使用搭配doing business，意为“做生意/进行交易”，在此处表达“为了让交易更便捷”。

句意：在中国古代，黄金不仅是财富，也是权力的象征。此处使用连词not only…but also…，意为“不仅……而且……”，用于连接并列成分。

content:
I’m Lily. In the past, I wasted a lot of money. I bought many things I didn’t really need. For example, I saw a beautiful dress in a shop. I still bought it [[66]] I had many dresses already.

But one day, I wanted to buy a good book. It was [[67]] little expensive, and I didn’t have enough money. I asked my parents for help, but they said I should learn [[68]] manage my money well. That made me realize my problem.

Now I make a budget every month. I write down the money I get and spend. I try to spend less money [[69]] unnecessary things. I also get money by doing some part-time jobs. Now I can save some money every month. I [[70]] proud of myself.
explanation:
句意：尽管我已经有很多裙子了，我还是买下了它。前文说“已经有很多裙子”，后文说“还是买了”，前后是让步关系，需用从属连词though或although引导让步状语从句。

句意：它有点贵，而且我没有足够的钱。空格后“little expensive”中，“a little”意为“有点”，修饰形容词expensive，需用不定冠词a。

句意：我向父母求助，但他们说我应该学会好好理财。“learn to do sth.”是动词短语，意为“学会做某事”，后接动词不定式作宾语，故用to。

句意：我尽量少在不必要的东西上花钱。“spend money on sth.”是动词短语，意为“花钱在某物上”，on后接名词。

句意：我为自己感到骄傲。句子描述现在的情况，需用一般现在时；主语“I”是第一人称，be动词用am。

subject: english
content:
根据下面的对话情景，在每个空白处填上一个适当的句子，使对话的意思连贯，完整。

A: Kangkang, I find it hard to learn English. [[71]]?

B: Sure. What difficulties do you have in your learning?

A: [[72]]. I forget them easily.

B: Well, I usually write down the new words on a small notebook and go over them whenever I have time.

A: [[73]]. I’ll try that. And how can I improve my oral English?

B: [[74]]? In the English club, you can often talk with your friends in English. You know that “practice makes perfect”.

A: That’s a good idea. [[75]]. I’ll follow your advice.

B: You’re welcome.
answer: (1) Could you give me some advice/Can you help me；(2) I have trouble remembering new words/I can’t remember new words well；(3) That sounds good/Great idea；(4) Why not join the English club/What about joining the English club；(5) Thank you very much/Thanks a lot
explanation:
上文A表示觉得英语难学，下文B询问学习上有什么困难，因此A应请求对方给予建议或帮助，故用Could you give me some advice/Can you help me。

下文B提到自己把生词记在小本子上随时复习，因此A应描述自己在记单词方面的困难，故用I have trouble remembering new words/I can’t remember new words well。

上文B给出了记单词的建议，A表示会尝试，因此A应对该建议表示认可或赞赏，故用That sounds good/Great idea。

上文A询问如何提高英语口语，下文B提到在英语俱乐部可以经常用英语和朋友交流，因此B应建议对方加入英语俱乐部，故用Why not join the English club/What about joining the English club。

A表示会采纳B的建议，下文B回应“You’re welcome.”，因此A应表示感谢，故用Thank you very much/Thanks a lot。

subject: english
content:
某学校一名班主任了解到班上学生间借钱的现象越来越普遍，于是她开展了原因调查。结果显示，很多同学在星期一就花光了零花钱，后面需要用时只能去借钱。为了帮助学生们合理规划使用零花钱，班主任决定让班长在班会课分享合理规划和使用零花钱的方法。假设你是该班班长，请用英语写一篇短文，介绍你的方法。

提示信息：

How much pocket money do you have every week?

List “needs” and “wants”.

How much do you spend on each part of them?

Check and stick to the budget.

写作要求：

1．必须包含所有提示信息，可适当发挥；

2．文中不得出现真实姓名、校名和地名；

3．词数：100词左右，开头和结尾已给出，不计入总词数。

Hello, everyone! Today, I’d like to share how to make a weekly budget for your pocket money. It’s not as hard as you might think. Here is my experience.

___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

A good budget helps you use money wisely and even allows you to save for something special. I hope these tips will be useful for you. Thank you!
answer: Hello, everyone! Today, I’d like to share how to make a weekly budget for your pocket money. It’s not as hard as you might think. Here is my experience. I get 50 yuan each week. First, I list my “needs” like school supplies and “wants” like snacks. Needs cost about 30 yuan, and wants 15 yuan. I keep 5 yuan for savings. Every Sunday, I check my spending. If I spend too much on wants, I try to cut down next week. Sticking to the plan is key. For example, if I want a new book, I use my saved money. This way, I never need to borrow from others and I can also develop a good habit of managing money wisely. A good budget helps you use money wisely and even allows you to save for something special. I hope these tips will be useful for you. Thank you!

subject: english
material:
On a weekday afternoon some years ago, I was sitting alone in my apartment when someone knocked on the door. As I wasn’t expecting a visitor, I assumed it was the postman.

“Yes?”

“Hello, sir. I work for the television show Law & Order. We’re seeking a location for some scenes, and I wonder if you might be willing to let me see your apartment.”

I live on a lovely block in a historic district, so quite a bit of filming does take place in my neighborhood, but it certainly never occurred to me that someone might consider my simple home as a location for a TV show.

As he looked around, my mind began to race, thinking of what it might mean if my apartment was chosen for filming.

I had been out of work for a few months. I’d once read that TV shows and movies paid generously to use private homes for filming. That money would certainly be useful, as my unemployment insurance was winding down.

My daydream suddenly ended when my visitor received a call. After chatting quietly for a few moments, he turned to me and said, “I’m sorry. My colleague found an apartment down the street that suits our purposes, and it looks as if we’ll be filming there.”

Was I disappointed? Yes, of course, but I also felt oddly cheered by the near miss. I was reminded that blessings (祝福) are often given just when they’re needed most. In this case, the blessing wasn’t that I would be paid for the use of my apartment. It was being reminded that blessings large and small wait for us, though we can’t always guess when or where they will present themselves. But they are there for us, and we must try very hard to remain open to receiving them.
content: How did the author feel at the man’s request?
explanation: 细节理解题。根据第四段中“... it certainly never occurred to me that someone might consider my simple home as a location for a TV show”可知，作者从未想过自己的普通公寓会被选为拍摄地，因此对男人的请求感到惊讶。故选D。

subject: english
material:
For everyone whose relationship with mathematics is broken, Jo Boaler, a professor at Stanford Graduate School of Education, has ideas for repairing it.

Most students have only ever experienced what she calls narrow mathematics. In this world of mathematics, questions have one valued method and one answer. Students need to follow a set of procedures at speed. When blindly memorizing math facts, they’re not developing number sense. They don’t learn how to use numbers flexibly in different situations. For most of them, mathematics is an almost completely symbolic experience. It’s a big part of why we have a country of mathematics failure and fear.

In her new book, Boaler argues that mathematics should be taught in more visual (可视的) ways. Students should be invited to see mathematical ideas not only as numbers but also as words, visuals, physical representations, tables, models and movements.

In her book she mentioned an activity she did with middle-school students in a summer camp where students were shown an image of a4 x4 x 4 cm cube (立方体) made up of smaller1 cm cubes. The larger cube was dipped (蘸) into a can of blue paint, and she asked, if they could take apart the little cubes, how many sides would be painted blue? To solve it, she gave the students sugar cubes and had them physically build a larger 4x 4 x 4 cube.

A year later, she asked one student, Jed, how the camp had impacted him. Jed told her that he was in advanced math class, but he still remembered that sugar cube — what it looked like and felt like — and he had used the memory to solve many questions. He had built a mental representation of a cube.

Some people may consider physical representations more suitable for younger kids, but Boaler wrote at last, “Look at those Tesla engineers. They’re drawing, they’re building models, and nobody says that’s basic mathematics.”
content: What is the result of narrow mathematics?
options: Fear of teachers and the school.
explanation: 细节理解题。根据第二段中“... it’s a big part of why we have a country of mathematics failure and fear”可知，狭义数学教育导致学生对数学产生失败感和恐惧感。故选A。

subject: english
material:
Storytelling is an important way that people pass down knowledge and culture. Stories can be passed along in many ways, including speaking, writing, and movement.

Hula is a type of dance, and it is also a form of storytelling. It has been a part of Hawaiian storytelling traditions for generations. Many years ago, Hawaiians did not have a written language. To pass down knowledge, they shared chants (吟唱) that told stories of important events. They danced hula to these chants. Through hula, Hawaiians recorded Hawaiian history.

There are two main types of hula. Ancient hula, or hula kahiko, is the oldest form of the dance. Hula kahiko often celebrates Hawaiian gods or chiefs. It also tells stories about important Hawaiian figures in history. Its beat is slow and the movements are graceful. Musicians keep that beat for the dancers with bamboo sticks and drums. A modern form of hula, hula auana, is danced to songs and, often, faster beat. Musicians play the ukulele and guitar in this type of hula. Unlike hula kahiko, hula auana is not performed as a part of a religious ceremony. It's often more relaxed but it also carries significant cultural and education values. Both types of hula are popular in Hawaii today. Masters train students at hula schools, asking them to draw inspiration from nature.

In hula, each movement has a meaning, much like words in a story. Hula dancers use their hands, feet, and hips to tell these stories. One basic hula step is called the kaholo. To perform this step, dancers lower their knees deeply. They move their hips from side to side to the beat. This move can represent a person going on a journey. Other hula steps express nature or weather. For example, in one step, a dancer lifts their hands up, and then they move their fingers as they bring their hands down. This movement represents rain. Through various movements, hula dancers can communicate meanings and share important stories with their community.
content: Why did Hawaiians create hula?
explanation: 细节理解题。根据第二段中“Through hula, Hawaiians recorded Hawaiian history” 可知，呼啦舞的创造是为了记录夏威夷历史。故选B。

subject: english
material:
We live in a culture that encourages us to be strong and independent, but is it possible that we have gone too far?

Over-independence is the belief that you are the only person you can depend on. [[1]]For example, you have depended on someone in the past and been let down, so, as a result, you have a “if you want something done, you have to do it yourself” mind.

[[2]]One day, I had just come back from a funeral(葬礼) when a friend called me to see how I was. Being so used to being very over-independent at that point, I said he didn't need to worry. Hours later, he turned up at my door simply saying, “I thought you might want a hug.” He was right.[[3]]

What I ignored was that the great pressure I put on myself to do everything alone was blocking me from forming real and close connections, because in order to ask for help, you need to trust others and let them in.

[[4]]But living a life where you don't give anyone a chance to be there for you is extremely lonely, and not the solution. Humans are sociable creatures. With our communities getting smaller and smaller, and our dependence on others becoming greater, it can be really easy to feel alone. [[5]]When you feel like no one cares, text someone who you love. The more you give them a roadmap on how to help you, the more they can. So feel free to ask someone for support, and it is so worth it.
options: I used to be the same.
He taught me to ask for what I want.
It is often born out of a painful experience.
Learning how to ask for help is rather hard.
Letting people in gives them possibility to hurt you.
The way we deal with this is by reaching out anyway.
explanation: 上文定义“过度独立是认为自己是唯一可依靠的人”，下文以“过去依赖他人却被辜负”为例。D项中“It”指代“过度独立”，“a painful experience”直接呼应下文“been let down”，用“born out of”解释其根源，构成“定义—例证”的逻辑衔接。故选D。

content:
Festivals are celebrated throughout the world. In spite of their various [[31]] (origin), the spirit of sharing joy, gratitude, love, or peace is common in all festivals. The harvest festival is one of the most popular festivals, [[32]] takes place after all the crops have been gathered in. The harvest season in ancient Egypt, [[33]] (feature) a parade and a great feast with music, dancing, and sports, was celebrated during the springtime.

Customs are [[34]] great significance in festivals, but they can change over time. For example, lighting firecrackers [[35]] (stop) in some Chinese cities during the Spring Festival, as [[36]] can increase air pollution. Another change is that festivals are becoming more commercial, with the celebrations taken advantage of by businesses. Online shopping websites and social media apps have made it much [[37]] (easy) for the public to spend more on gifts.

Festivals are [[38]] important part of society. They reflect people’s wishes, beliefs, faiths, and attitudes towards life. They are occasions that allow us [[39]] (relax), enjoy life, and forget about our work for a little while. They help us understand where we came from, who we are, and [[40]] to appreciate.
answer: (1) origins；(2) which；(3) featuring；(4) of；(5) has been stopped；(6) it；(7) easier；(8) an；(9) to relax；(10) what
explanation:
考查名词。句意：尽管起源不同，但分享快乐、感恩、爱或和平的精神在所有节日中都是共同的。various修饰可数名词复数形式。故填origins。

考查定语从句。句意：收获节是最受欢迎的节日之一，它发生在所有的庄稼都收割完毕之后。空处引导非限制性定语从句，先行词The harvest festival，指物，在定语从句中作主语，需用关系代词which引导。故填which。

考查非谓语动词。句意：在古埃及，春天是丰收的季节，人们会举行游行和盛大的音乐、舞蹈和体育盛宴。空处需填非谓语动词，修饰名词The harvest season，feature和The harvest season为逻辑主谓关系，需用现在分词形式。故填featuring。

考查介词。句意：习俗在节日中很重要，但它们会随着时间的推移而改变。be of great significance为固定搭配，表示“很重要”。故填of。

考查动词时态语态和主谓一致。句意：例如，中国一些城市在春节期间已经停止燃放鞭炮，因为这可能会增加空气污染。此处表示过去发生的事情对现在产生影响，使用现在完成时，lighting firecrackers和stop为被动关系，需用被动语态，主语为动名词短语，助动词用has。故填has been stopped。

考查代词。句意同上。空处作主语，指代上文的“lighting firecrackers”，需用it。故填it。

考查形容词比较级。句意：在线购物网站和社交媒体应用程序使公众更容易在礼物上花更多钱。much修饰形容词比较级，空处需填easier作宾语补足语。故填easier。

考查冠词。句意：节日是社会的一个重要组成部分。part为可数名词，此处表示泛指，且important发音以元音音素开头，需用不定冠词an修饰。故填an。

考查非谓语动词。句意：它们是让我们放松、享受生活、暂时忘记工作的场合。allow sb to do sth为固定搭配，意为“允许某人做某事”。故填to relax。

考查疑问代词。句意：它们帮助我们理解我们从哪里来，我们是谁，以及我们应该欣赏什么。此处为“特殊疑问词+动词不定式”结构作宾语，appreciate后缺宾语，指物，需用疑问代词what。故填what。

subject: english
content:
阅读下面材料，根据其内容和所给段落开头语续写两段，使之构成一篇完整的短文。

Sumiko worked with her mother in their vegetable garden every day. They made their living by selling the produce from their garden at the market. Each day, Sumiko carefully watered plants and pretended they were beautiful chrysanthemums (菊花), like Mrs. Higaki’s prize flowers. In her heart, she wanted to grow chrysanthemums.

“Foolish girl!” her mother lectured. “Flowers can’t be eaten!”

“But Mum, people buy flowers.”

“City people. No one in our poor village wastes money.”

Sumiko knew her mother was right. The only person in the village who made money selling flowers was Mrs. Higaki. Every year she won first prize at the Kyoto Chrysanthemum Festival. Many people whispered that Mrs. Higaki used magic to grow her chrysanthemums. How else could she win first prize twenty years in a row?

Sumiko admired Mrs. Higaki. If she could sell flowers like Mrs. Higaki, she would be able to buy things for her mother. But chrysanthemums were expensive to start, and Sumiko could only dream about growing them.

One day, Sumiko visited Mrs. Higaki’s garden. “Mrs. Higaki, I wish I could grow beautiful chrysanthemums and win a prize like you,” said Sumiko.

“You! Win a prize growing flowers?” Mrs. Higaki laughed. “Do you know what’s required to grow such flowers? The secret to growing them has been passed down to me from past generations of my family. And you-a child-believe you can compete against me? Stick to vegetables, child. Leave flowers to those who know the secret of flowers.”

Mrs. Higaki returned to her gardening, ignoring the sad look on Sumiko’s face. Then she pulled up a plant.

“What’s that?” Sumiko asked.

“A plant in poor condition -a waste of my time,” Mrs. Higaki said, throwing the plant into the field beside the garden.

注意：

1. 续写词数应为 150 左右;

2.开头已给出。

Sumiko smiled before she had an idea.

_______________________________________________________________________________

_______________________________________________________________________________

_______________________________________________________________________________

Sumiko got up early on the morning of the Kyoto Chrysanthemum Festival.

_______________________________________________________________________________

_______________________________________________________________________________

_______________________________________________________________________________
answer:
Sumiko smiled before she had an idea. She asked for Higaki’s permission to have that plant, dashed back home, and grew it behind the cottage. She leaned close to the hanging leaves and whispered, “Grow, little flower. You don’t have to win a prize. Just grow.” She took care of her plant every morning and evening. “You are my beautiful plant,” Amy would sing softly, as she weeded and watered it. “Someday, you will bloom prettier than any flower at the festival.” Each time Amy visited her little plant, it looked greener and taller. Time seemed to fly by as the festival neared.
Sumiko got up early on the morning of the Kyoto Chrysanthemum Festival. When Amy visited her plant again, she screamed with delight. Her plant was in full bloom! It was the most beautiful rainbow chrysanthemums Amy had ever seen. Mrs. Higaki, who was passing by with flowers for the festival, stopped to see what the excitement was. Her mouth dropped open seeing the brilliant chrysanthemums. She never thought that the weak plant she threw away should have grown to be so remarkable. “It’s plain to see you will win a prize this year.” Mrs. Higaki sighed. And off they went to the festival. Finally, Amy's chrysanthemums won first prize as Mrs. Higaki had predicted.

subject: english
content:
请通读下面对话，根据对话内容，填写适当的句子。

A: Hi, Robert—What are you doing?

B: [[1]]

A: Oh, The Adventures of Tom Sawyer. This is the book our teacher ask us to read last month.

B: Right. [[2]]

A: Yes, I have already finished reading it.

B: [[3]] I have just finished reading half of it. I think it is really interesting.

A: Yes. Most of your classmates like it very much.

B: [[4]]

A: No, I haven't. But I have done the most difficult part of the book report.

B: How great you are! [[5]] We must finish the book report in a week.
answer: (1) I'm reading The Adventures of Tom Sawyer.；(2) Have you finished reading it?；(3) You are so fast.；(4) Have you finished your book report?；(5) I must work harder.
explanation:
根据上文问句“What are you doing?”和下文提到的书名，可知此处需回答正在读《汤姆·索亚历险记》，故填“I'm reading The Adventures of Tom Sawyer”直接回应了对方的询问，点明自己正在进行的阅读活动。

根据下文答句“Yes, I have already finished reading it.”，可知此处需用现在完成时问句询问对方是否读完了书，故填“Have you finished reading it?”以一般疑问句的形式确认对方的阅读进度，自然承接后续对话。

根据上下文“A已读完”与“Robert才读一半”的对比，可知此处是对A的阅读速度表示赞叹，故填“You are so fast!”用感叹句表达对对方高效阅读的惊讶与认可，使对话语气更自然。

根据下文答句“No, I haven't. But I have done the most difficult part of the book report.”可知此处需用现在完成时问句对读书报告的完成情况进行提问，故填“Have you finished your book report?”以一般疑问句的形式切入新话题，引出后续关于读书报告的交流。

根据下文“We must finish the book report in a week.”的时间要求，可知此处需表达自己要努力赶进度的态度，故填“I must work harder.”用陈述句表明自己的决心，呼应了读书报告的截止时间要求。

The District Games(区运会)will begin on August 7th and end on 15th. We need 500 volunteers. The jobs are only for persons aged 18 or over 18. It's better for you to have experience of volunteering in sports events.

Skills Needed

※Have good communication skills

※Be good at learning and love trying new things

Services to Offer

※Answer questions

※Take photos of the faces

※Guide guests and players

subject: english
material:
(B)

Through ultra-low temperature lychee preservation (荔枝超低温保鲜) technology, lychees from Guangdong can be sold to more countries. Zhu Zhiwei is a professor in University. He said, “With the technology, the preservation period of lychee can be increased to one year. Also, the quality is for sure. It allows people to enjoy fresh lychees all year round.”

▲ There are also lots of Guangdong lychees in supermarkets in the United States. The prices have risen from $4.99 to $5.99 a pound (0.45 kilogram) in recent years. The sales period of the fruit usually starts from May and ends in July. Because of the hot weather, lychee growers and sellers in China were troubled.

In the fridge, lychees can be stored for about 10 days. But the new technology can quickly freeze lychees below -35°C to store for one year. People now try to use the method to keep more than 2,000 tons of the fruit fresh. The technology will help solve the problem of selling bad lychees and selling them in high prices. And it will improve the quality of lychees in the future. With the help of it, lychees can keep the bright color and the good taste for a long time. It meets the demands of some countries, including the US, Japan and so on.

The technology is safe and easy to use. People will use it in keeping other fruits and vegetables fresh in the following years.
content: How did Zhu Zhiwei think of the new technology?
options: It increased the preservation period of lychees.
There was no need to worry about the taste of lychees.
Lychees from Guangdong could be sold to any country.
It allowed people to enjoy all kinds of fruits all year round.
explanation: 根据第一段朱志伟的话：“With the technology, the preservation period of lychee can be increased to one year.”，可知他认为这项技术延长了荔枝的保鲜期。

配对阅读。左栏是学生们的五种不妥行为或危险的情形，右栏是老师所给出的建议。请将行为或情形选择合适的建议。

[[36]] Yesterday Li Hong found a stranger following her all the way. She ran home as quickly as possible.

[[37]] Tom often uses earphones when walking outside.

[[38]] It’s a long way from Wang Jun’s home to school, so he often sleeps all the way on the bus.

[[39]] There are too many passengers on the bus today, and Li Feng puts his bag out of his reach.

[[40]] The house is on fire and is full of smoke, and you are in it.

A. You should press the cut with a piece of cloth to stop the blood, then go to hospital as quickly as possible.

B. Don’t use earphones when walking outside. It’s dangerous to do so because you can’t notice those cars, buses or trucks back and forth.

C. Your bag should be put within your reach, or it is easy enough for the thieves to steal the things in your bag.

D. If you are followed by a stranger, cross the street and go in the other direction. Next, go and get help from others if it is necessary.

E. You can’t leave school by yourself. Don’t forget it’s safer in school yard than the outside world.

F. Don’t sleep on buses, or you may miss the right stop.

G. If your house catches fire and you have to escape through smoke, move on your hands and knees with your head 30 to 60 centimeters above the floor.
explanation:
问题是“Li Hong被陌生人跟踪”，右栏中D建议：“如果你被陌生人跟踪，穿过马路往反方向走。必要时，去向他人求助。”与之相符。

Tom的问题是“走路戴耳机”，右栏中B明确建议：“走路时不要戴耳机。这样做很危险，因为你无法注意到来往的汽车、公交车或卡车。”。与之相符。
