请从方框内选择适当的词并用其正确形式填空，使文章完整连贯。注意每空一词，每词仅用一次，有两词为多余项。请将答案写在答题卡对应题目的答题位置上。

special, hard, before, although, fall, rich, that, stop, ill, enjoy, job, myself

Unlike many of my classmates, my hero is my dad.

When I was five, I was seriously [[41]] and needed attention all the time. My dad knew how much my mum loved her job, so he [[42]] working to look after me in hospital. Later he took up a [[43]] to work at night so that he would only be out when I was sleeping. He always thought about others [[44]] himself. This made me start to respect him.

When I was seven, I started learning to ride a bike. My dad ran behind me and held the back of the bike so that I would not [[45]]. I felt so safe because I knew he was near. Soon, I was able to ride by [[46]].

My family is not [[47]] than others, and we do not own a big house or an expensive car. My dad ever said to me, “Family is the only thing [[48]] is the most important in the whole world.” [[49]] he is now very busy with his work every day, he always spends time staying with me. He has also taught me that if I really work [[50]], I can achieve anything.

My dad is my hero because he has shown me the most important thing in life.
explanation:
句意：当我五岁的时候，我病得很重，一直需要照顾。根据“look after me in hospital”可知我生病住院了，ill“生病的”，故填ill。

句意：我父亲知道我母亲有多么热爱她的工作，所以他停止了工作，在医院里照顾我。根据“to look after me in hospital”可知是他停止了工作，在医院里照顾我，stop“停止”，描述过去的事，动词使用过去式，故填stopped。

句意：后来，他找了一份工作，晚上上班，这样他就只在我睡觉的时候出去。根据“to work at night”可知是指一份工作，空前有a修饰，job“工作”填原形，故填job。

句意：他总是先为别人着想，然后才是自己。根据“This made me start to respect him.”可知我很敬佩爸爸，因此爸爸是先为别人着想，然后才是自己，before“在……之前”，故填before。

句意：我爸爸跑在我后面，扶着自行车的后座，这样我就不会摔倒了。根据“My dad ran behind me and held the back of the bike”可知爸爸这样做是为了防止我摔倒，情态动词would后接动词fall“摔”原形，故填fall。

句意：很快，我就能自己骑了。根据“I was able to ride”可知是指我就能自己骑了，myself“我自己”，故填myself。

句意：我们家并不比别人富裕，我们也没有大房子，也没有昂贵的汽车。根据“we do not own a big house or an expensive car”可知我们并不富裕，结合than，此空需使用rich“富裕的”比较级，故填richer。

句意：家庭是世界上唯一最重要的东西。先行词是thing，指物，且有only修饰，用that引导定语从句，故填that。

句意：虽然他现在每天都在忙他的工作，但他总是会花时间和我在一起。根据“he is now very busy with his work every day, he always spends time staying with me”可知前后表转折，although“虽然”，故填Although。

句意：他还教会了我，如果我真的努力工作，我就能取得任何成就。根据“I can achieve anything.”可知如果我真的努力工作，我就能取得任何成就，hard“努力”，副词修饰动词work，故填hard。

Do you understand your parents? It is difficult for many teenagers to understand them and deal with the relationships with their parents. But you can make it easier by using the following tips.

There are four good ways to improve your relationship with your parents. The first is respect. It is important to show respect to your parents. You haven’t experienced your parents’ lives, so you may not know that they are under great pressure(压力) with their work.

Second, there is trust. You should trust your parents as they trust you. If you learn how to trust, your life will be much easier.

Third, there is communication. When you have arguments, you’d better communicate with your parents and show them that you have the right to make your own decisions.

Finally, there is company(陪伴). Just as kids need their parents’ company, parents also need company. Have you tried to comfort (安慰 ) your parents when they felt down? Company is a good way to drive away the black clouds hanging over your family.

Your parents give all their love to you. Why not try your best to care about them effectively (有效地)?

The Mid-Autumn Festival has a history of 2,000 years. All the celebrations of the Mid-Autumn Festival show the happiness and excitement of people. The main celebrations during the Mid-Autumn Festival are admiring the moon, eating mooncakes together and making Chinese Mid-Autumn Festival lanterns.

In some places in China, people celebrate the festival in different ways. In Chaozhou, Guangdong Province, people eat taro (芋头) to celebrate the festival, because the taro harvest happens at the same time. They eat taro and hope the harvest is good in the next year. In Nanjing, people cook ducks with sweet-scented osmanthus (桂花), because Nanjing people think sweet-scented osmanthus is a symbol of peace. In some places people make fires inside towers to celebrate the festival, because they think the fire is a symbol of good business.

content:
阅读短文，根据语篇内容，在方框内的缩写文章中，填入与短文意思最符合的单词，每空一词。

In our English class, our teacher introduced a new way of learning English. It is group learning. This brought many changes to our English study. And I like it a lot.

Each group has four to five students. We work together on different tasks (任务), such as reading English stories, discussing grammar points, and preparing short English plays. When reading a story, we take turns to read aloud. Then we discuss points and new words in the story. Everyone can share their ideas and understanding.

Group learning helps us improve our English in many ways. For shy students, it provides a chance to practice speaking English more often. They can say their thoughts within the small groups without worrying. Also, by listening to others’ thoughts, we can learn different ways of thinking.

Group learning also teaches us to share tasks and solve problems together as a team. We learn to communicate well, respect each other’s ideas, and divide (划分) tasks carefully to get the best results.

Our English teacher introduced a new way of learning English— [[61]] learning. It changed our English study. Each group has four to five students. We do tasks like reading English stories, discussing [[62]] points and preparing English plays. When reading stories, we take turns to read [[63]] and discuss points and new words. Everyone shares their thoughts freely. Group learning helps us in many ways. Shy students can practice speaking English more [[64]]. Listening to others’ thoughts also helps us learn different ways of [[65]]. This learning way teaches us to work as a [[66]]. We learn to communicate well, respect each other and divide tasks carefully to get good results.
explanation:
根据第一段“It is group learning.”可知，老师介绍的英语学习新方法是小组学习。故填group。

根据第二段“discussing grammar points”可知，小组任务包括讨论语法点。故填grammar。

根据第二段“we take turns to read aloud”可知，朗读故事时是轮流大声朗读。故填aloud。

根据第三段“it provides a chance to practice speaking English more often”可知，害羞的学生可以在小组中更经常地练习说英语。故填often。

根据第三段“we can learn different ways of thinking”可知，倾听他人的想法可以帮助我们学习不同的思维方式。故填thinking。

根据第四段“teaches us to share tasks and solve problems together as a team”可知，小组学习教会我们作为一个团队一起工作。故填team。

subject: english
content:
阅读下面短文，在空白处填入适当的词或用括号中所给词的正确形式填空。每空不超过两词。

Tom still remembers his childhood in the small village during the 1990s. Life [[70]] (be) simple then. Every morning, he woke up to the sound of birds. There were no smartphones or [[71]] (computer) at his home. Instead, children played outside until sunset, creating wonderful memories.

Everything began to change [[72]] 2005. One day, his father brought the family a computer. Tom was so [[73]] (excite) that he could hardly believe his eyes. This amazing [[74]] (invent) opened a whole new world for him. At first, he only used it [[75]] (communicate) with his cousin. [[76]] soon he realized how much he could learn online.

As years passed, technology has become [[77]] important part of daily life. Now Tom works as an engineer in the city. While he enjoys the modern life, he sometimes misses [[78]] (he) childhood. Video calls are used [[79]] (wide) by people, but he knows that something from the past can never come back.

The world is changing quietly. However, we should [[80]] (know) that something will be the same in our hearts forever.
answer: (1) was；(2) computers；(3) in；(4) excited；(5) invention；(6) to communicate；(7) But；(8) an；(9) his；(10) widely；(11) know
explanation:
句意：那时生活很简单。根据“Tom still remembers his childhood in the small village during the 1990s.”可知，描述的是过去的事情，句子时态为一般过去时，主语“Life”为第三人称单数，be动词用“was”。故填was。

句意：他家里没有智能手机或电脑。根据“smartphones”可知，此处用复数形式“computers”，表示没有智能手机或电脑这类物品。故填computers。

句意：2005年，一切都开始改变了。年份前用介词“in”表示在某一年。故填in。

句意：Tom如此兴奋，以至于他几乎不敢相信自己的眼睛。“so...that...”表示“如此……以至于……”，“was”后接形容词作表语，主语“Tom”指人，用“excited”表示“感到兴奋的”。故填excited。

句意：这个惊人的发明为他打开了一个全新的世界。根据“This amazing”可知，此处用名词形式“invention”，表示“发明”。故填invention。

句意：起初，他只是用它来和他的表弟交流。“use sth. to do sth.”表示“用某物做某事”，所以此处用动词不定式“to communicate”。故填to communicate。

句意：但很快他就意识到他可以在网上学到很多东西。根据“At first, he only used it...with his cousin.”和“soon he realized how much he could learn online.”可知，前后句为转折关系，用“but”表示“但是”。故填But。

句意：随着岁月的流逝，科技已经成为日常生活重要的一部分。“part”为可数名词单数，“important”以元音音素开头，用不定冠词“an”表示“一个”。故填an。

句意：虽然他享受着现代生活，但他有时会怀念他的童年。根据“childhood”可知，此处用形容词性物主代词“his”修饰名词，表示“他的童年”。故填his。

句意：视频通话被人们广泛使用。根据“Video calls are used”可知，此处用副词“widely”修饰动词“used”，表示“广泛地使用”。故填widely。

句意：然而，我们应该知道有些东西永远不会改变。根据“should”可知，情态动词后接动词原形“know”。故填know。

subject: english
content:
阅读短文，从方框中选择适当的词并用其正确形式填空，使短文通顺，意思完整，每空一词，每词限用一次。

luck the happiness also many same them that through relative pay

During the Chinese New Year, one of [[81]] most exciting traditions for children is receiving lucky money in red envelopes (红包). This tradition is not only about getting money but [[82]] carries cultural meanings and family love.

Long ago, people believed that bad things might harm (伤害) children. To protect [[83]], adults put coins in red paper. The red color scared away bad [[84]] and the coins brought safety. Today, the coins have become paper money. Grandparents, parents, and [[85]] give red envelopes while saying nice words like “Wish you health and [[86]]!”

Even with modern changes, like digital (数字的) red envelopes on phones, the most important part of this tradition stays the [[87]]. Families get together, share joy, and pass down love [[88]] these bright red envelopes. It teaches young people to [[89]] attention to family relations.

Lucky money is [[90]] than a gift—it’s a bridge among family members and it reminds us [[91]] the best things in the world are love and togetherness.
explanation:
句意：在中国新年期间，对孩子们来说最令人兴奋的传统之一就是收到装在红包里的压岁钱。“one of the+形容词最高级+名词复数”表示“最……的……之一”，此处用定冠词the。故填the。

句意：这一传统不仅仅是为了得到钱，而且承载着文化意义和亲情。not only … but also“不但……而且”。故填also。

句意：为了保护它们，成年人把硬币放在红纸里。根据“Long ago, people believed that bad things might harm (伤害) children.”和备选词可知，此处用人称代词“他们”代指“children”，位于动词protect后面，人称代词用宾格them“他们”。故填them。

句意：红色能驱走厄运，硬币能带来平安。根据“The red color scared away bad”可知，红色能驱走厄运。luck“运气”，名词。故填luck。

句意：祖父母、父母和亲戚送红包，同时说“祝你健康快乐！”根据“Grandparents, parents, and … give red envelopes”和备选词可知，祖父母、父母和亲戚送红包。relative“亲戚”，此处表示多数，用其复数形式。故填relatives。

句意：祝你健康快乐！根据“Wish you health and”和备选词可知，此处指“祝你健康快乐”，空处应填名词happiness“快乐，幸福”，与health并列。故填happiness。

句意：即使有了现代的变化，比如手机上的数字红包，这一传统中最重要的部分仍然保持不变。根据“Even with modern changes, like digital (数字的) red envelopes on phones, the most important part of this tradition stays the”和备选词可知，此处指保持不变。stay the same“保持不变”，same“相同的”。故填same。

句意：家人聚在一起，分享快乐，通过这些鲜艳的红包传递爱。根据“and pass down love … these bright red envelopes”和备选词可知，指通过红包传递爱意。through“通过”，介词。故填through。

句意：它教会年轻人注意家庭关系。pay attention to“注意”，teach sb to do sth“教某人做某事”，此处用动词原形。故填pay。

句意：压岁钱不仅仅是一份礼物，它是家庭成员之间的桥梁，它提醒我们，世界上最好的东西是爱和团结。many的比较级more，more than“不仅仅，超过”。故填more。

句意：压岁钱不仅仅是一份礼物，它是家庭成员之间的桥梁，它提醒我们，世界上最好的东西是爱和团结。“it reminds us … the best things in the world are love and togetherness.”为宾语从句，用that引导。故填that。

subject: english
answer:
Changes in My Life

With the development of science and technology, my life has changed a lot.

First, the way I study is different. Now I often have online classes at home. I can learn from the best teachers across the country. It’s very convenient and helpful. Second, how my family communicates has changed too. My parents often use WeChat to video call our relatives. We can see each other even when we’re far apart. Third, entertainment has become more fun. I sometimes watch movies in VR at home, which feels like being in a cinema.

These changes make my life more colorful and convenient. I believe our lives will become even better in the future with new technologies.

subject: english
content: A true friend will never [[_]] from you when you’re in trouble.
explanation:
试题分析：句意：真正的朋友永远不会在你陷入困境时跑开。take away带走，拿开；run away逃跑，跑开； put off推迟；get off下车。

考点：考查动词短语辨析。

subject: english
content: The headmaster advises parents to [[_]] the parents’ meeting with their children this Friday.
explanation:
句意：校长建议父母和他们的孩子们来参加本周五的家长会。

考查动词辨析。manage管理；discuss讨论；control控制；attend出席，参加。根据“the parents’ meeting”可知，此处是“出席家长会”。故选D。

subject: english
content:
—Is the man over there Mr. Brown?

—It [[_]] him. He has gone to Brazil.
explanation:
句意：——那边的那个人是布朗先生吗？——不可能是他，他去了巴西。

考查情态动词。may not可能不，语气较弱；can’t be不可能，语气强；shouldn’t不应该；mustn’t禁止，不要。根据“He has gone to Brazil.”可知，那个人不可能是布朗先生，说话人对此很确定。故选B。

subject: english
content: Students love the teachers [[_]] are outgoing and humorous.
explanation:

subject: english
content: A number of foreign players[[_]]playing basketball in the NBA. The number of them[[_]]about five hundred.
explanation: 句意：大量的外国选手都在NBA里打篮球。数量大约是五百人。a number of 大量的，相当于a lot of , 后接可数名词复数，the number of是……的数量 后面接名词单数，根据题意可知选A。

subject: english
content: My mum did all she could [[_]] money for my education at that hard time.
explanation:
句意：在艰苦的岁月里，妈妈竭尽全力挣钱供我上学。

考查动词不定式。根据“My mum did all she could...money for my education”可知，妈妈竭尽全力是为了挣钱，应用动词不定式作目的状语。故选C。

subject: english
content: English is [[_]] in the world, so we must [[_]] it well.
explanation:
句意：英语在世界上被广泛使用，所以我们必须学好它。

考查被动语态、副词和情态动词用法。wide形容词，广泛的；widely是副词，广泛地，spoke过去式；spoken过去分词；be learned被动语态；is learned被动语态；learn原形；be learn形式错误。根据“English is…in the world, so we must…it well.”可知，English和speak是被动关系，用spoken，widely spoken表示“被广泛说”；must是情态动词，后接动词原形learn，must learn表示“必须学习”，符合逻辑。故选C。

subject: english
content:
—Could you please tell me how many gold medals [[_]]?

—40. We all feel so proud!
explanation:
句意：——你能告诉我中国在2024年巴黎奥运会上赢得了多少枚金牌吗？——40枚。我们都感到非常自豪！

考查宾语从句。宾语从句用陈述语序，排除A和C选项；根据“Could you please tell me how many gold medals”可知，此处询问的是已经发生的事实，2024巴黎奥运会发生过了，应用一般过去时，故选D。

subject: english
material:
阅读下列短文,然后从每小题A､B､C､D四个选项中选出能回答所提问题或完成所给句子的最佳答案.

A

Five years ago, my mother gave birth to a brother for me when I was 8. I have learned a lot from getting along with him.

After he was born, I almost became a babysitter (保姆). I had to amuse him after school. I would make faces and sing to him when he was crying. Sometimes I even carried him everywhere in our yard to refresh (使……清新) him while my parents were busy. What I liked to do best was to feed him when looking after him. How cute he was as he tasted his favorite food! My parents often praised me happily, “As an elder brother, you’ve done a good job in looking after your younger brother.”

I have got happiness from sharing. When I was young, I was the only child in my family. I could get what I wanted from my parents and get my parents’ whole love. I was a “Little Emperor”.

But now, as long as I get something good, I will share it with him. I remembered the year when he was three, he was interested in Rubik’s cubes (魔方). I bought one for him with my lucky money as a birthday present. When he got the toy, he was so happy that he laughed, hugged me and said, “Brother, I love you!”

Thanks for spending these years together with my family, it has taught me what responsibility means, what unselfishness means and what friendship means. Not only should I look after myself, but also I should pay attention to my family and my friends.
content: The underlined word “amuse” in the second paragraph (段) means [[_]].
explanation: 词句猜测题。根据下文“I would make faces and sing to him when he was crying”可知，弟弟哭的时候作者要做鬼脸、唱歌让他高兴起来，由此可推测“amuse”有“使……开心”之意，故选B。

subject: english
material:
阅读下列短文,然后从每小题A､B､C､D四个选项中选出能回答所提问题或完成所给句子的最佳答案.

A

Five years ago, my mother gave birth to a brother for me when I was 8. I have learned a lot from getting along with him.

After he was born, I almost became a babysitter (保姆). I had to amuse him after school. I would make faces and sing to him when he was crying. Sometimes I even carried him everywhere in our yard to refresh (使……清新) him while my parents were busy. What I liked to do best was to feed him when looking after him. How cute he was as he tasted his favorite food! My parents often praised me happily, “As an elder brother, you’ve done a good job in looking after your younger brother.”

I have got happiness from sharing. When I was young, I was the only child in my family. I could get what I wanted from my parents and get my parents’ whole love. I was a “Little Emperor”.

But now, as long as I get something good, I will share it with him. I remembered the year when he was three, he was interested in Rubik’s cubes (魔方). I bought one for him with my lucky money as a birthday present. When he got the toy, he was so happy that he laughed, hugged me and said, “Brother, I love you!”

Thanks for spending these years together with my family, it has taught me what responsibility means, what unselfishness means and what friendship means. Not only should I look after myself, but also I should pay attention to my family and my friends.

options: making faces and singing to him

One pleasant evening, I was holding Grandpa’s hand and taking a walk in the park. “Where are the peanuts? Give me now!” He suddenly said. How I wished I had some with me! “William, the monkeys are taking long to come out today. Wait till they smell the peanuts.” I knew he was lost in one of his memories again. I remembered the stories he told me of how he fed the monkeys when he was a kid. Then, he saw the goldfish! He acted as if he was seeing them for the first time.

Poor Grandpa! He fell ill with Alzheimer’s disease (阿尔茨海默症) last year. The doctor said it was a progressive brain disorder which could destroy ( 破 坏 ) a person’s memory. Ray, Grandpa!” Even if he had forgotten who I was, he would always be my beloved grandfather.

A young man went to the boss of a logging crew(伐木队) and asked for a job.

“That depends,” replied the boss. “Let’s see you fell(砍伐) this tree.”

The young man stepped forward and skillfully felled a big tree.

The boss was amazed and said, “You can start on Monday.”

Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday went by, and Thursday afternoon the boss went to the young man and said, “You can pick up your wages(薪水) your way out today.”

The young man was very surprised. He replied, “I thought you would pay on Friday.”

“Usually we do,” the boss said. “But we’re letting you go today because you’ve fallen behind. Our daily felling charts(日程表)show that you’ve dropped from first place on Monday to last place today.”

“But I’m quite hardworking,” the young man argued. “I am the first to arrive, and the last to leave, and even work during my coffee breaks.”

The boss thought for a minute and then asked, “Have you sharpened(变锋利) your axe(斧子)?”

The young man replied, “No, sir. I’ve been working too hard to take time for that!”

Our lives are like this. We sometimes get so busy that we don’t take time to “sharpen the axe”. There’s nothing wrong with working hard. But we all need time to relax, to think, to learn and grow. If we don’t take time to relax, we will feel dull(迟钝的) and lose our effectiveness (效率).
content: How did the young man get the job?
options: He showed his ability to fell a tree.
He gave the boss a sharp axe.
He made a promise to work hard.

A new study finds that more than eighty percent of Internet users in the United States search of health information online.

Susannah Fox from the Pew Internet Project says doctors are still the main source of health information. But the study found that searching online is one of the leading ways that people look for a second opinion. He says, “People are sort of fact-checking what they have heard from a doctor. Our studies show that people are still very likely to turn to a health doctor when they need a diagnosis (诊断) or are planning a treatment.”

Forty-four percent of people are actually looking for doctors or other providers when they search for health information online. Two-thirds of Internet users look online for information about a certain disease or medical condition.

The Internet has also become an important source of spiritual support for people with health problems. Susannah Fox says one in five Internet users has gone online to find other people who have the same condition.

A disease is considered uncommon if it affects(侵袭) fewer than 200,000 people worldwide. The rise of social networking has made it easier for people with uncommon diseases to connect with each other and feel less alone. Social networking is also changing the way some doctors and patients communicate with each other.

Dr. Jeff Livingston operates a medical center for women in Irving, Texas. His office uses password-protected software to share information with patients. He says the software has increased efficiency(效率)， reduced costs and improved relations with patients. It has just changed the way we do health care. subject: english
content:
阅读下面短文，用括号内所给动词的适当形式填空（必要时可加情态动词或助动词）。

At the age of nine, Kelly dreamed of being a very good basketball player. But one day while she [[51]] (play) basketball, she hurt her left leg badly. The doctor told her she could no longer play basketball. What was worse, she needed help doing everything, including going to the bathroom.

Thinking that her dream could never come true, Kelly [[52]] (be) in low spirits and gave up her studies at school. Her mother did all she could [[53]] (cheer) her up, but Kelly refused to change. She even took out all her anger and pain on her mother.

Then one day Kelly’s friends introduced her to the gym. Kelly realized that she [[54]] (turn) her attention to what she could do, not to what she couldn’t. [[55]] (post) her story online, she got lots of kind and inspiring words. As she [[56]] (encourage) by the kindness, she returned to school for two half days a week. And with the help of a bodybuilding trainer, she trained hard and soon found herself on stage (舞台) performing—as a bodybuilder. Her mother was truly happy and proud.

Today, Kelly [[57]] (study) to be a life coach. She is at peace with what happened to her, not just physically, but mentally (精神上). “Sometimes you [[58]] (experience) difficult things to come out stronger on the other side,” said Kelly. From her words, we can see she [[59]] (change) completely. All of us hope she[[60]] (become) stronger and stronger.
answer: (1) was playing；(2) was；(3) to cheer；(4) should turn；(5) Posting；(6) was encouraged；(7) is studying；(8) must experience；(9) has changed；(10) will become
explanation:
句意：但是有一天，当她打篮球时，她的左腿严重受伤。根据“while”可知，此处指当她打篮球时；再根据“hurt”是过去式可知，此处要用过去进行时，结构为was/were doing；主语是“she”，故用was。故填was playing。

句意：想到她的梦想永远不会实现，凯莉情绪低落，放弃了在学校的学习。由“gave up”可知，时态为一般过去时，主语“Kelly”是第三人称单数，故be动词用was。故填was。

句意：她的母亲尽她所能让她高兴起来，但凯莉拒绝改变。根据“Her mother did all she could ... her up”可知，为了让凯莉振作起来，她的母亲做了她能做的一切；此处用不定式表目的。故填to cheer。

句意：凯莉意识到她应该把注意力转移到她能做的事情上，而不是她不能做的事情上。根据“Kelly realized”可知，凯莉意识到自己应该转移注意力，不能老想着自己做不到的事情；should“应该”，情态动词，后接动词原形。故填should turn。

句意：她在网上发布了自己的故事，得到了很多善意和鼓舞人心的话语。分析句子可知，“在网上发布故事”这个动作是由凯莉发出的，是逻辑上的主谓关系，故应用现在分词posting，且句首首字母大写。故填Posting。

句意：由于受到这种善意的鼓励，她每周回学校两个半天。分析句子可知，主语“she”与动词encourage存在被动关系，时态为一般过去时，故应用一般过去时的被动语态，结构为was/were done。故填was encouraged。

句意：今天，凯莉正在学习成为一名生活教练。根据“Today”可知，时态为现在进行时，表示动作此阶段正在发生，结构为be doing；主语“Kelly”为第三人称单数，故be动词用is。故填is studying。

句意：有时候，你必须经历艰难的事情，才能在另一边变得更坚强。根据“come out stronger on the other side”可知，想要变得更坚强，必须要经历一些困难的事情。故填must experience。

句意：从她的话中我们可以看出她完全变了。根据“She is at peace with what happened to her, not just physically, but mentally (精神上).”以及上文“in low spirits and gave up her studies at school”可知，凯莉已经改变了，时态要用现在完成时，结构为have done。故填has changed。

句意：我们都希望她会变得越来越强。根据“All of us hope ...”可知，此处指希望她会变得越来越强；will“将，会”，后接动词原形。故填will become。

Many teenagers don’t get along well with their parents and they don’t know what to do. If you face such a problem, what I’m saying now might be h[[61]] to you.

Have you ever thought of t[[62]] to your parents to find out why you don’t get along well with each other? When I was a teenager, I didn’t get on well with my parents, e[[63]]. We sometimes argued(争吵) with each other. I am sorry that I had such an e[[64]]. Now I’m a mother of four girls. Of course we have different opinions, but I encourage them to communicate with me openly and honestly. In this way I make sure that they t[[65]] me and come to me for anything. As a r[[66]], we get along very well.

Arguing with your parents will make them angry and you won’t feel good. Also, remember that the most important thing is to solve problems. Try your best to be calm. If you cannot control your f[[67]], you can go to a doctor or your teacher who could give you a[[68]] on your problem.

Remember that your parents love you. Sometimes they do something that you find h[[69]] to understand. For example, you may want to be a singer in the future, but your parents want you to do something else. If s[[70]], try to think in their shoes.

Life is too short and family is important! Try your best to get along well with your parents.
explanation:
句意：如果你面临这样的问题，我现在所说的可能对你有帮助。根据“If you face such a problem”和首字母提示可知，就问题提出建议，helpful“有帮助的”符合语境，在句中作表语，故填(h)elpful。

句意：你有没有想过和你的父母谈谈，找出你们相处不好的原因？根据后文“but I encourage them to communicate with me openly and honestly”可知，是建议与父母沟通，talk to sb“与某人交谈”，介词of后用动名词作宾语，故填(t)alking。

句意：当我十几岁的时候，我和我的父母也相处得不好。根据“We sometimes argued with each other.”可知，作者也会跟父母争吵，此处表示“也”，用在否定句中，用either，故填(e)ither。

句意：我很抱歉我有这样的经历。根据“We sometimes argued with each other. I am sorry that I had such an e…”可知，作者因为这种经历感到抱歉，experience“经历”符合语境，此前有an修饰，故填(e)xperience。

句意：这样我就能确保他们信任我，无论什么事都来找我。根据“In this way I make sure that they t…me and come to me for anything.”可知，无论什么事都来找我，所以是信任我，trust“信任”符合语境，故填(t)rust。

句意：结果，我们相处得很好。根据“As a r…, we get along very well.”可知，此处是as a result短语，意为“结果”，故填(r)esult。

句意：如果你不能控制你的情绪，你可以去看医生或你的老师，他们可以给你的问题的建议。根据“Try your best to be calm.”可知，要尽最大努力冷静，所以是控制自己的情绪，feeling“感觉，情绪”符合语境，此处表示复数含义，使用名词复数形式，故填(f)eelings。

句意：如果你不能控制你的情绪，你可以去看医生或你的老师，他们可以给你的问题的建议。根据“you can go to a doctor or your teacher who could give you a…on your problem”可知，是向医生或老师寻求建议，advice“建议”，不可数名词，作动词的宾语，故填(a)dvice。

句意：有时他们会做一些你很难理解的事情。根据“Sometimes they do something that you find h…to understand.”可知，有时父母会做我们难理解的事，hard“难的”，作不定代词的后置定语，故填(h)ard。

句意：如果是这样，试着换位思考。根据“If s…, try to think in their shoes.”可知，跟父母沟通，互相理解，if so“如果是这样”，故填(s)o。

subject: english
material:
阅读短文，根据要求完成下面各小题。

At 9:40 p.m. yesterday, when I was sitting in my chair, I heard some strange sounds.They made me scared.

This was the third time I had heard the sounds. I didn’t know who or what made the sounds. They sounded like someone knocking at my window, but I lived on the ninth floor.

I was too scared to open my eyes until the sounds stopped. I thought about asking for help, but I was sure people would laugh at me. “There are no such things as ghosts (鬼)”, they’d say.

“There they begin again.” I shouted. My mom came upstairs and asked me what was going on. Then she heard the strange sounds, too. She went into the bathroom. I wanted to stop my mom because I was afraid that something bad would happen to her. But she started laughing.

“It is OK, dear. A strong wind is making your curtain (窗帘) shake and knock at the window.”

I was very surprised. Since then, I’ve started thinking more scientifically (合乎科学地). There are no ghosts. I don’t need to be afraid. If such a thing happens again, I will do as my mom did and find out the truth.

根据短文简要回答问题。

Why did the writer want to stop her mom from going into the bathroom?

___________________________________________________________________
answer: Because the writer was afraid that something bad would happen to her mother.

I was very surprised. Since then, I’ve started thinking more scientifically (合乎科学地). There are no ghosts. I don’t need to be afraid. If such a thing happens again, I will do as my mom did and find out the truth.

In recent years, Pop Mart has become a well-known cultural thing, winning the love of young fans around the world. It’s more than just a normal toy store. It creates a magical world full of cute characters that attract people with their charm.

The most interesting part of Pop Mart is its blind boxes, which hold the excitement of not knowing what’s inside. When you buy a blind box, you’re full of a feeling of mystery (神秘), because you won’t know which character is inside until you open it.

Usually, one series has a special “hidden” character that’s very hard to find and another 11 characters that are easier to get. This makes collecting them an exciting challenge. Many collectors really want to get the whole collection, especially those hard-to-find hidden characters. In 2023, Pop Mart sold over 10 million blind boxes just in China, showing how popular this idea is.

The characters of Pop Mart are designed carefully. Designers get ideas from many things, like old fairy tales, history, and modern art. Take the famous Molly series as an example. Designed by a Hong Kong artist. Molly has big round eyes and a special hairstyle. Each Molly figure wears different clothes and has different themes, like space adventures, animals, and festivals. These beautifully made figures are so lovely that people like them as soon as they see them.

Pop Mart has opened stores in many big cities around the world. These stores don’t only sell things. They also work as places where fans can get together. Here, people who love Pop Mart can meet, share stories about their collections, and trade figures.

options: It has the most expensive toys.

It sells toys just on the Internet.
It sells toys mainly for young people.

A primary school student, Ma Yuqian was amazed by Beijing’s new robot-themed restaurant in E-Town. When he visited it on Friday, he watched a humanoid (仿人的) robot cut a cake perfectly, with not a single crumb (碎屑) left on the plate. “It’s amazing to see them do such careful tasks so smoothly,” he said happily after the visit.

The robot-themed restaurant and the world’s first humanoid smart robot 4S store, officially opened on Friday in Beijing E-Town. Since opening, it has engaged thousands of visitors. The 4S store provides sales, service, spare parts (备件) and customer surveys. Since opening, thousands of visitors have come to experience it. In the restaurant, robot bartenders (酒吧侍者) warmly greet guests at the door, a robot band plays lively music, and robots dressed as ancient poets Li Bai and Su Shi tell funny stories to make everyone laugh.

Guests can enjoy hamburgers and spaghetti here. They can also interact (互动) with cute dinosaur robots while eating, and watch robots make delicious pancakes, coffee and milk tea on site. Delivery robots move around quickly to bring food to tables. Many people book through apps or wait in line outside to try this new dining experience.

The next day the stores opened, the 2025 World Robot Conference was launched in E-Town. As part of the event, a robot control competition for lower primary school students took place, which Ma and his mother attended. Ma’s mom praised, “The kids’ robot skills are great, opening a new world for the younger generation.”
content: What does the underlined word “engaged” mean in Paragraph 2?
explanation: 词句猜测题。根据第二段“Since opening, it has engaged thousands of visitors.”以及后文对餐厅和4S店热闹场景的描述，可知此处表达的是自开业以来，它吸引了成千上万的游客，所以“engaged”意为“吸引”，与“Attracted”意思相近。故选A。

①Do you often hear birdsong outside the window? How do you feel when you hear it? In fact, it is shown that birdsong can influence people’s life.

②Birdsong sounds especially nice in winter because it reminds people of spring. A study found that listening to birdsong for six minutes can help reduce people’s stress. It’s hard to feel sad when you hear birds singing or talking, as the energy in their songs makes people feel like walking in the garden. Unlike music, which can sometimes make you produce strong feelings, birdsong is usually seen as positive or neutral (中性的). If you live in a noisy city, birdsong can be a welcome relief (缓解) from the stress caused by outside noise.

③Another benefit is that birdsong has also been found to improve focus. It can help people focus on their tasks and be more productive (高效的). That’s because when people play birdsong in the background at work, it seems that a “wall” is built to help them stay away from the unpleasant noise outside. In this way, birdsong can be a powerful tool to improve productivity at work.

④Carrie Tom, a doctor in North Carolina, has also found that birdsong makes it easier to help people enter a deep sleep. Birdsong, as a kind of white noise, can slow down people’s heartbeats and breath. After listening to birdsong for a long time, a conditioned response (条件反射) is developed in their brains. Therefore, birdsong becomes a signal of entering sleep, which helps them fall asleep faster than before and improves their sleep quality.

content:
阅读短文，在空白处填入一个适当的单词或用括号内所给词的正确形式填空，使短文通顺、连贯。

The Great Wall, which is a symbol of our history, snakes across a mountain area of Tianzhu, Gansu province. Thirty-nine protectors work [[51]] (careful) in the area to protect the great wonder.

With [[52]] history of over 2,000 years, the wall in Gansu wasn’t in good condition. Nature did great harm to the wall. Some parts of the wall were washed away by heavy rains and blown away by strong winds. People in some places also harmed it.

But things started to change. In 2006, Great Wall Protection Regulations (条例) [[53]] (come) into effect. After that, more and more people started to take part [[54]] caring for the wall. In recent years, the government of Tianzhu has spent more and more money protecting the wall. Modern technologies like self-driven sensing technology [[55]] drones (无人机) have also been used to watch the wall.

With all these efforts, the protectors are still busy with [[56]] (they) work. Every week they guard the wall, and any changes [[57]] (record) and reported to the government. They also help people realize it’s important [[58]] (protect) cultural heritage (遗产). Luckily, with their hard work, much [[59]] (great) changes have taken place.

“As long as we are here, we will protect this wall. It is our job and our [[60]] (proud),” said one of the protectors.
explanation:
句意：39名保护者在该地区小心翼翼地保护着这一伟大的奇迹。根据“work”可知，此处使用副词修饰动词，careful的副词为carefully。故填carefully。

句意：拥有2000多年历史的甘肃长城状况不佳。根据“history of over 2,000 years”可知，此处泛指一段超过2000年的历史，history以辅音音素开头，使用不定冠词a。故填a。

句意：2006年，《长城保护条例》生效。根据“In 2006”可知，此处为一般过去时，使用动词过去式。故填came。

句意：从那以后，越来越多的人开始参与到保护长城的行动中来。take part in“参加”，固定短语。故填in。

句意：像自动驾驶传感技术和无人机这样的现代技术也被用来监视长城。根据“self-driven sensing technology…drones”可知，此处表示并列关系，使用连词and连接。故填and。

句意：经过所有这些努力，保护者们仍然忙于他们的工作。根据“work”可知，此处使用形容词性物主代词修饰名词，they的形容词性物主代词为their。故填their。

句意：他们每周都会守卫长城，任何变化都会被记录下来并上报给政府。根据“Every week they guard the wall”可知，此处为一般现在时，主语changes是复数，且与record之间是被动关系，因此使用一般现在时的被动语态are recorded。故填are recorded。

句意：他们还帮助人们认识到保护文化遗产的重要性。根据“it’s important”可知，it’s adj. to do sth.“做某事是……”，固定句式，因此使用动词不定式。故填to protect。

句意：幸运的是，在他们的努力下，发生了更加显著的变化。根据“much”和语境可知，此处指与之前相比发生了更大的变化，使用形容词比较级greater。故填greater。

句意：“只要我们在，我们就会保护这面墙。这是我们的工作和我们的骄傲，”其中一位保护者说。根据“our”可知，此处使用名词，proud的名词为pride。故填pride。

subject: english
material:
阅读短文，然后根据内容回答问题

These years, many college students choose to join the army after graduation. Zhao Huan is one of them.

When Zhao Huan was 26 years old, he joined the army and became one of the soldiers on the top of Changbai Mountain in Jilin Province. The three-year life in the army made him really strong-willed.

The weather on the mountain is terrible in winter. The snow can reach as deep as 2 metres. The lowest temperature can be -40°C. There are over 200 days a year when the wind speed is nearly 12 metres per second. “It is very difficult to fall asleep with the wind outside crying like a wolf,” Zhao said. Life was hard because of the weather. When the snow cut off the roads, the soldiers needed water most. They had to heat the snow to get water to drink, cook and wash with. To save water, they only took a bath once a month.

Even so, Zhao and his team did not give up. Whatever difficulties they met, they tried their best to finish their tasks. Especially when they were on duty outside in winter, snow hit their faces and they were frozen because of the low temperature. But they put their duty before anything and stood like a statue without a slight move.

Zhao said, “Life is not easy on the top of Changbai Mountain. Thinking of the lights of thousands of homes, I think my efforts pay off. For me, all the difficulties can be overcome in the future. The experience of being a soldier here really means a lot to me.”
content:
How old was Zhao Huan when he joined the army?

[[_]]
explanation: 根据“When Zhao Huan was 26 years old, he joined the army and became one of the soldiers on the top of Changbai Mountain in Jilin Province.”可知，赵欢参军时26岁。故填He was 26 years old.

Dear Jack,

I have read your letter and I get to know that you are under stress in your study. I’m sorry to hear that you often stay up late. I think keeping a regular schedule is very important for your health and study. It helps you feel more energetic during the day and improves your concentration.

Yours, Li Hui

Maybe you are afraid of losing face, but you should think since we are students and we’re [[34]] English, there’s no need to worry about anything. You must always be [[35]] in practice. There’s no problem that your pronunciation and intonation (语调) can’t be as [[36]] as the native (本地的) people because we are Chinese, and we don’t have [[37]] to live in foreign countries and talk with the people there all the time. But we must know that the main [[38]] to study English is to make ourselves understood and understand other people. You should believe that native speakers will not laugh at you. subject: english
material:
A

Three students are sharing their opinions about social media (社交媒体).

David

I like WeChat. It is fast, convenient and fashionable. And you can use it for free. It can be used in my mobile phone. It has hold-to-talk voice messaging function (功能). It’s amazing.

I love MicroBlog. We can share messages with each other. I often write something on my MicroBlog, for example, “I’m in blue today. I didn’t pass the exam.” Then many friends comfort me. I share my birthday party, my new coat and so on with my friends. It is fun.

Alice

Lily

I don’t like WeChat or MicroBlog. I don’t believe them. Many people are fooled because they believe in other people on WeChat easily. It is not a real world. As to MicroBlog, I don’t think it is a good way to make friends. I don’t want my secrets known by others.
content: What does David think of WeChat?
explanation: 细节理解题。根据“I like WeChat. It is fast, convenient and fashionable”可知，David认为微信速度快，方便并且时尚。故选C。

subject: english
material:
B

Lusambo did the long drum dance with thousands of Chinese students. He felt very happy.

The long drum dance is a traditional folk performance of the Yao people in China. It is popular in many places, such as Hunan and Guangxi. In 2008, it was listed as the national intangible cultural heritage (非物质文化遗产).

Lusambo, from East Africa, is a student of a university in Hunan. He was greatly interested in the long drum dance when he first saw it. “The dance reminds me of my hometown. It is similar to the African style,” said Lusambo. He wanted to pass on the long drum dance, so he learned the dance and culture of the Yao people carefully. “The world keeps changing, but Chinese people have been holding on to their traditional culture. We should learn from them to protect and pass on our traditional culture, too.” he added.
content: What did Lusambo do with many Chinese students?
options: He did the long drum dance.
explanation: 细节理解题。根据第一段中的“Lusambo did the long drum dance with thousands of Chinese students.”可知，Lusambo和许多中国学生一起跳长鼓舞。故选C。

subject: english
material:
C

Interesting festivals in the world

Throwing tomatoes—Spain (西班牙)

Spain takes “tomatoes fights” to a whole new level. But the tomatoes are being thrown, not eaten. The festival takes place in the last Wednesday in August. Trucks (卡车) carry tomatoes into the square. People rush to the tomatoes and throw them into the crowd.

Rolling cheese—England

This festival is celebrated in May. It takes place on Cooper’s Hill. A large wheel (盘) of cheese is rolled (滚动) down Cooper’s Hill. The festival is a race where people run down the hill after the rolling cheese. The first person to cross the finish line wins the cheese.

Pouring water—Thailand

The Songkran Festival is the celebration of the New Year in Thailand. Thailand celebrates the New Year from April 13th to 15th. Thai people run after each other, pouring water. Songkran is one of the most important reasons why foreigners travel to the beautiful land.

Burning man—America

The Burning Man Festival lasts a week in September. The festival takes place in the Black Rock Desert. The best part of the festival is the burning of a large sculpture (雕塑) of a man.
content: Where will you probably go to enjoy one of the festivals above in August?
explanation: 细节理解题。根据“Throwing tomatoes—Spain (西班牙)...The festival takes place in the last Wednesday in August.”可知，人们可以在8月去西班牙过西红柿节。故选A。

subject: english
material:
D

Lifelong learners never think of themselves as the greatest experts in anything. They continue to learn and bring a great deal to the groups they belong to. Lifelong learners have some main characteristics (特征).

They are knowledge seekers. They are always searching for much information on a topic they’re interested in and looking for new experience or chances to improve their knowledge or skills.

They are social and self-directed learners. They like taking different courses and taking part in discussions about subjects they are interested in. [[_]] They also know their own learning styles. They can plan and organize their own learning.

They are critical (批判性的) thinkers. They always use a lot of ways to analyze (分析) information. From their research they can make sure if the information is useful for the question.

They are problem solvers. They will meet different problems while learning. However, they usually see problems as challenges (挑战) and life experiences and try to stand above them.
content: What does the underlined “knowledge seekers” mean?
options: Persons who are looking for knowledge.
explanation: 词义猜测题。根据“They are always searching for much information on a topic they’re interested in and looking for new experience or chances to improve their knowledge or skills.”可知他们总是在搜索他们感兴趣的主题的大量信息，并寻找新的经验或机会来提高他们的知识或技能，“knowledge seekers”指的是那些正在寻找知识的人。故选C。

Lifelong learners never think of themselves as the greatest experts in anything. They continue to learn and bring a great deal to the groups they belong to. Lifelong learners have some main characteristics (特征).

They are knowledge seekers. They are always searching for much information on a topic they’re interested in and looking for new experience or chances to improve their knowledge or skills.

They are social and self-directed learners. They like taking different courses and taking part in discussions about subjects they are interested in. [[_]] They also know their own learning styles. They can plan and organize their own learning.

They are critical (批判性的) thinkers. They always use a lot of ways to analyze (分析) information. From their research they can make sure if the information is useful for the question.

They are problem solvers. They will meet different problems while learning. However, they usually see problems as challenges (挑战) and life experiences and try to stand above them.

subject: english
material:

After a game like football, the players might get an X-ray in the hospital if they hurt their legs or arms. A dentist can use X-rays to look at teeth. And airport workers use an X-ray machine to check objects before a plane leaves. Nowadays, X-ray technology is widely used in medicine and other fields.

X-rays were first discovered by a German scientist, Wilhelm Conrad Röntgen (1845 –1923). He found them quite by accident in 1895. One day, he discovered that an unknown kind of radiation (放射线) could hardly pass through hard objects like bones (骨头). Later, Röntgen took a photo of his wife’s hand. It clearly showed her ring and her bones. That was the first X-ray photo in the world.

Why is there an “X” in the word X-ray? It’s because Röntgen couldn’t explain exactly how it worked. He just knew that X-rays were new and useful for science. In fact, X-rays soon became an important tool in medicine. With the help of X-rays, doctors could see inside the human body for the first time without surgery (外科手术).

Röntgen was awarded the first Nobel Prize (诺贝尔奖) in physics in 1901 for his discovery. When he was asked what he was thinking at the moment of discovery, he replied, “I didn’t think, I investigated (研究).” Röntgen gave away his Nobel Prize money to his university. And he never took out any patents (专利权) on X-rays, to make sure that the world could freely make use of his discovery.
answer: 根据“Nowadays, X-ray technology is widely used in medicine and other fields.”可知，它被广泛应用于医学和其他领域。故填In medicine and other fields.

subject: english
content:
阅读下面短文，在空白处填入适当的单词或所给单词的正确形式，使短文意思完整。

Jimmy was eleven years old. He was [[61]] (interest) in singing, [[62]] he learned things slowly. One day he [[63]] (sit) in the classroom alone. Mr. Black saw him and asked what happened [[64]] him. Jimmy answered, “I’m afraid I will lose the coming singing competition because other [[65]] (boy) laugh at me and call me ‘Slow Jimmy’.” Mr. Black said [[66]] (kind), “Look at the slow snail (蜗牛) in that tree. When you lose heart, think of the snail.” Jimmy felt more [[67]] (relax) after hearing it. He thought he could run [[68]] race with the snail.

So he decided to practice [[69]] (he) song until the snail got to the top of the tree. At last, the day [[70]] (come). Jimmy [[71]] (sing) very well and won [[72]] (one) prize. His monitor asked, “How could you make it?” Jimmy answered, “I saw the snail [[73]] (climb) up the tree step by step. It didn’t stop [[74]]turn back, but went on. And I thought I would finish my task in the [[75]] way.”
explanation:
句意：他对唱歌很感兴趣，但他学得很慢。be interested in…“对……感兴趣”。故填interested。

句意：他对唱歌很感兴趣，但他学得很慢。分析句子可知，前后句存在转折关系。故填but。

句意：有一天他独自坐在教室。根据通读全文可知，本文讲述的是过去发生的事情，应用动词过去式。故填sat。

句意：布莱克老师看到他，问他发生了什么。happen to sb.“发生在某人身上”，固定用法。故填to。

句意：吉米回答：“我担心自己会在唱歌比赛中失败，因为其他男孩子嘲笑我，叫我‘慢吉米’”。由“other…”可知，other后接可数名词复数。故填boys。

句意：布莱克先生友好地说：“看那棵树上的慢蜗牛。当你失去信心，就想一想蜗牛。”此处修饰动词said应用副词。故填kindly。

句意：吉米听到后感到更轻松了。由“Jimmy felt more…”可知，此处应填形容词作表语，主语为人，用动词加ed的形容词。故填relaxed。

句意：他认为他可以和蜗牛赛跑。由“…race”可知，此处需填不定冠词，表泛指，且race是以辅音音素开头的单词。故填a。

句意：所以他决定练习他的歌曲，一直练到蜗牛爬到墙的顶端。由“…song”可知，修饰名词应用形容词性物主代词。故填his。

句意：终于那一天到来了。根据通读全文可知，本文讲述的是过去发生的事情，应用动词过去式。故填came。

句意：吉米唱得非常好，赢得了第一名。此处描述的是过去发生的事情，所以需要用一般过去时。故填sang。

句意：吉米唱得非常好，获得了第一名。由“the…prize”可知，the后接序数词。故填first。

句意：我看到蜗牛正在一步一步地爬上树。此空描述的是正在进行的动作，see sb. doing sth“看到某人正在做某事”。故填climbing。

句意：它没有停下来或回头，而是继续前进。根据“went on”可知，蜗牛既没有停下来，也没有回头，而是继续前进，用连词“or”，用来连接两个并列的否定动作。故填or。

句意：我想我会以同样的方式完成我的任务。in the same way“以同样的方式”。故填same。

subject: english
content:
根据对话内容，在每小题的空白处，写出一个完整的句子，使对话意思完整。

A: Hello, John. Long time no see. [[76]]?

B: Not bad. What are you busy doing?

A: [[77]].

B: Oh, the toy bear looks so cute.

A: Could you help me pass the scissors?

B: Sure. Here you are. [[78]]?

A: It’s made of old clothes and waste cotton.

B: Wonderful! You are helping protect the environment.

A: Yes, you are right. [[79]].

B: What kind of things do you recycle?

A: I recycle all kinds of things, such as waste bottles. used cans and waste boxes.

B: Sounds great! [[80]]? I want to join you.

A: Certainly. I will show you how to make a toy bear later.
answer: (1) How is it going；(2) I’m making a toy bear；(3) What’s it made of；(4) I often recycle things in my life；(5) Can you tell me how to make a toy bear
explanation:
根据“Long time no see...Not bad”可知，此处是问候对方最近怎么样。故填How is it going。

根据“What are you busy doing?”，“Oh, the toy bear looks so cute.”和下文可知，A正在制作玩具熊。故填I’m making a toy bear。

根据“It’s made of old clothes and waste cotton.”可知，问它是由什么制作的。故填What’s it made of。

根据“You are helping protect the environment.”和“What kind of things do you recycle?”可知，是说自己经常回收生活中的东西。故填I often recycle things in my life。

根据“I want to join you.”和“I will show you how to make a toy bear later.”可知，请求对方告诉自己如何制作一个玩具熊。故填Can you tell me how to make a toy bear。

subject: english
content:
一次同学聚会上，你见到以前的朋友Mike，他的变化很大。请根据表格内容写一篇短文描述Mike的变化。

In the past

Now

Appearance

short; straight hair

tall; curly hair

Personality

shy

outgoing

Hobby

soccer

singing

…

要求：

(1) 短文须包括表格中所有要点和补充要点，可适当发挥；

(2) 短文中不得出现真实的人名、校名和地名；

(3) 词数80个左右(开头已给出, 不计入总词数。

Last week, I saw Mike at the party. ___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
answer:
Last week, I saw Mike at the party. He has changed a lot.

Mike used to be short. He used to have straight hair. Now he is a tall boy and has curly hair. He used to be shy and quiet. He had few friends. Now he is more outgoing than before. He has made many friends in his school. He used to like playing soccer, but now he enjoys singing and reading books. He used to be late for school. He didn’t like English. Luckily, his English teacher is very patient. With the teacher’s help, he is better at English now.

subject: english
content: Though she is young, she has much [[_]] about animals.
explanation:
句意：虽然她很年轻，但是她了解很多关于动物的知识。

考查名词辨析。interest兴趣；knowledge知识；hobby爱好。根据“ she has much...about animals.”可知，应是她对动物的知识知道得很多。故选B。

subject: english
content: If you visit Yu Garden in Shanghai, you can [[_]] many beautiful buildings and bridges.
explanation:
句意：如果你参观上海的豫园，你可以欣赏到许多美丽的建筑和桥梁。

考查动词辨析。create创造；admire欣赏；cross穿过。根据“If you visit Yu Garden in Shanghai”可知，在豫园参观，应是欣赏美丽的建筑和桥梁，故选B。

subject: english
content: His parents would be very [[_]] of everything good he did.
explanation:
句意：他的父母会为他所做的一切好事感到骄傲。

考查形容词辨析。proud骄傲的；absent缺席的；pride骄傲。根据“His parents would be very …of everything good he did”可知，此处用be proud of表示“以……为傲”，故选A。

subject: english
content:
—China is getting better at making high-technology products.

—That’s right. People all over the world can hardly avoid [[_]] products made in China.
explanation:
句意：——中国越来越擅长制造高科技产品。——没错。全世界的人都几乎不能避免购买中国制造的产品。

考查非谓语动词。根据“China is getting better at making high-technology products.”可知，此处表示不能避免购买中国制造的产品，再由“People all over the world can hardly avoid…products made in China.”可知，avoid doing sth.意为“避免做某事”，固定词组。故选B。

subject: english
content: Mr. Smith created a new game. Soon all his students [[_]] rules to play it.
explanation:
句意：——史密斯先生创造了一个新游戏。很快，他的所有学生都被教会了玩它的规则。

考查被动语态。taught过去式或过去分词；is taught一般现在时的被动语态；were taught一般过去时的被动语态。分析句子结构，句子的主语“all his students”和谓语动词“teach”之间是被动关系，即学生是“被教授”规则，所以要用被动语态，其结构为“be+过去分词”；根据前一句“Mr. Smith created a new game.”中“created”可知，句子时态是一般过去时，主语是复数，be动词用“were”。故选C。

subject: english
content:
A: Hello, Wu Tong! What a nice day, isn’t it?

B: Yes, it is. Liang Hang, I have not seen you for a long time. [[11]]?

A: I have been to my hometown with my parents. You know, Hulin is my hometown.

B: [[12]]?

A: I traveled around the whole city and visited my uncle.

B: I heard there were narrow (窄) streets and few tall buildings in Hulin many years ago. [[13]]?

A: Oh. It has changed a lot now. There are more and more tall buildings. The city is much cleaner. And the traffic is more convenient. It’s really beautiful now.

B: By the way, [[14]]?

A: By train.

B: Thanks to our open-door policy (政策), our country has developed rapidly. People in China are living a happier life.

A: [[15]]. And I hope our country will be richer and stronger.

B: I am sure it will.
answer: (1) Where have you been；(2) What did you do；(3) How is it now；(4) how did you go there；(5) I think so
explanation:
根据下文“I have been to my hometown with my parents.”可知，问句应该是询问对方 “去过哪里”，此句应用现在完成时的特殊疑问句，故填Where have you been。

根据下文 “I traveled around the whole city and visited my uncle.” 可知，问句应该是询问对方 “在那里做了什么”，此句应用一般过去时的特殊疑问句，故填What did you do。

根据下文 “Oh. It has changed a lot now.” 可知，问句应该是询问对方 “虎林现在怎么样了”，此句应用一般现在时的特殊疑问句，故填How is it now。

根据下文 “By train.” 可知，问句应该是询问对方 “去家乡的交通方式”，此句应用一般过去时的特殊疑问句，故填how did you go there。

根据“our country has developed rapidly. People in China are living a happier life.”及“And I hope our country will be richer and stronger.”可知，认可对方的评价，故填I think so。

subject: english
material:
Chewing gum (咀嚼口香糖) may be one of your favorite sweets. But do you know how it was [[16]]? The inventor of the chewing gum is an American scientist called Thomas Adams. He made it completely [[17]].

It was 1869. Earlier that year, one of Adams’ friends showed him an interesting kind of sap (树汁). His friend told him [[18]] people in Central America liked to chew on it for fun. Hundreds of years passed, people didn’t do that any longer. But Adams was interested in the sap. He wanted to use it to create some new [[19]]. Adams, however, [[20]] to create what he wanted. He felt [[21]] and disappointed and happened to chew on the sap. Surprisingly the sap tasted great. Adams then added something [[22]] to the sap and started selling it. Later in 1869, he opened a factory [[23]] produce this delicious treat.

In 1888, Adams gave a [[24]] to the invention “chewing gum”. The sweet can be got from selling machines at underground stations all over New York City. Over the years, new kinds have been [[25]]. Now, chewing gum is popular among many people.
explanation:
句意：但是你知道它是怎样被发明的吗？

eaten吃；polluted污染；invented发明。下文介绍口香糖是怎么被发明的，所以此处问的是“你知道它是怎样被发明的吗”。故选C。

material:
Ⅻ.根据所给材料，完成下列各题。(共40分)

(A)

Imagine you live in a smart city. Everything you need—schools, cinemas and parks—is all within a 10-minute walk. Many countries around the world are carrying out ideas similar to “10-minute city”. They have either come up with plans or have made it a reality.

The idea of a “15-minute city” has been realized in China. In July, Zhangyan Village built a “happy community”. The community is a 1,500-square meter area with a cafeteria, an entertainment center, a health center, a post office, and a restroom. All are within a 15-minute walk. According to online magazine Sixth Tone, the city plans to make such communities for nearly 99 percent of locals by 2035. Other places are following this step. Thirty cities across the country will try out the idea of 15-minute communities in the future.

Anne Hidalgo is the mayor (市长) of Paris. She wants to turn Paris into a 15-minute city. City travel is a key of the plan. In 2020, Paris built 60 km of temporary (临时的) cycle paths. Now people can use those paths forever. Under her plan, Paris will get rid of (消除) 72 percent of its on-street parking spaces for cars. Green spaces, gardens and playgrounds will replace them. The city will turn busy crossings into squares as well.

Portland, a city in the state of Oregon, hopes to make 20-minute neighborhoods. People can reach places and services such as schools and parks by walking or biking for 20 minutes or less. According to the plan, about 11 percent of the city will be 20-minute neighborhoods. There will be more sidewalks (人行道) and greenways for bikes to ride.

根据以上内容，选择正确答案。
content: You can find the following EXCEPT [[_]] in the community in Zhangyan Village in China.
explanation: 细节理解题。根据“The community is a 1,500-square meter area with a cafeteria, an entertainment center, a health center, a post office, and a restroom.”可知，未提及“学校”。故选B。

①Do you like to travel alone? Or do you think it’s better to travel with friends? If you’re still deciding, please read on. I will explain the advantages of both ways.

②One of the great things about traveling alone is that you make the rules about where you go and what you eat. You’ll be surprised at what you discover about yourself without any influence.

③Traveling alone really shows you what you’re made of and helps you to discover inner strength (内心的力量) you didn’t know you had. Besides, it also gives you time to think, learn and grow. When your eyes are wide open, you’ll get a whole new outlook on the world.

④It’s easy to think that traveling alone is lonely. Although that may sometimes be true, you’re hardly ever alone. When you travel in a one-person team, this can provide a chance for you to enjoy the most interesting part of travel—communicating with the locals and meeting travelers from all corners of the world.

⑤In fact, traveling to know more about the world is not easy. There’s research to be done, flights to be booked and choices to be made, not to mention that things can—and often do—go wrong. One of the main advantages of traveling with friends is being able to share these things and support each other through the process, even if it’s just someone who will wait with your bag when you go to the bathroom.

⑥Just as your mother always says, it’s true that traveling with others can give you a sense of safety, especially if you’re new to travel. You know that if you get lost or have your wallet stolen, there’s someone to hold your hand when you try to explain your situation in a foreign police station.

⑦There’s no right or wrong way to travel. Whether you travel alone or team up with friends, it depends on you.

根据短文内容，选择正确答案。

The traditional Chinese Longtaitou Festival, or Dragon-Head-Raising Festival, falls on the second day of the second lunar month every year. This year it falls on March 4.

Ancient people believed that after this day, rainfall increases because the rain-bringing Dragon King has awakened from his winter sleep. A well-known phrase goes, “Er yue er, long tai tou,” meaning, “On the second day of the second month, the dragon lifts his head.”

Today lots of people in China can speak English and more and more people are learning this language. Then what do they learn English for? We have done a survey and here are some people’s reasons.

Alice White: I like traveling by myself very much. I’ve been to many places in China, and I plan to travel to some foreign countries. English is the most widely used language in the world, so learning English will do great help to my trips.

English is spoken as the first language by most people in the U.S.A., Britain, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland and Canada. However, English is spoken all over the world. It is the main language in over 60 countries, including India, Singapore and many of the Caribbean and Pacific islands. In these places, English is often spoken as the second language.

English is also an international language in many other countries, like China and Japan. People in these countries use it for business, and travelers to these countries use English to communicate when they get there. Other people may learn English because they enjoy reading books in English, listening to British or American music or watching American films.

English has changed a lot over the years and still goes on changing. It is no longer right to talk about British English or American English if the speakers come or don’t come from those countries. People in Japan and Korea, for example, may use the American spelling but may not sound like American.

English has been the most widely used language in the world by the end of the 20th century. This language no longer belongs to British, American or Australian speakers. It belongs to anyone in the world. So, as a middle school student today, you should think about how you can use this language. After you leave school, you will almost certainly need it.

The world uses about one billion tons (吨) of water a day. Water is a human right and everyone should have their share. Yet more than 700 million people around the world have trouble getting clean, safe water.

Treating wastewater is a good way to provide fresh water for us. And it also helps the environment by keeping waste out of rivers and oceans. 80% of wastewater around the world is not treated at all, and it is running into oceans.

But now we have got the technology to treat and reuse the wastewater.

While 75% of our planet is covered with water, only about 2% is fresh water—that comes from rivers, lakes, ice and snow. The rest, 98% of the water, is in seas and oceans. It is too salty to drink. Then desalination businesses come in. More than 19,000 factories have been built around the world, mostly in coastal (沿海的) countries. They process more than 92 million tons of water every day. But the technology they use requires a lot of energy.

Scientists are working to create a less costly technology. They want to produce 20 times more clean water and make sure everyone has enough. But for now, the world still faces each day with not having enough water for everyone.

根据材料内容选择最佳答案。

explanation: 细节理解题。根据“Yet more than 700 million people around the world have trouble getting clean, safe water.”可知，全世界有超过7亿人无法获得清洁、安全的水。故选B。

Do you have difficulty falling asleep at night? If so, here is a piece of advice for you: Listen to some soft music.

Scientists have found that soft music can help to improve sleep quality and quantity (量). This works for sleepers of all ages, and even for those with sleeping problems. So music can help us fall asleep better, wake up less during the night and feel more relaxed in the morning. You may not notice the effects (功效) overnight, though. It could take as many as 3 weeks to see any improvements.

Why can soft music help us sleep better? The reasons aren’t clear yet. It may connect with the relaxing effect of a good song. Music can have real physical effects, too. Soft music can lower our heart rate (心率) and slow down our breathing. This prepares us for sleep.

Scientists say that for most people, music that has 70 beats (节拍) per minute (bpm) works best. Classical, jazz and folk music are usually more effective than other musical styles. Familiar songs work well, too. You may need to test to make your own playlists. If you are not sure how many beats a song has in a minute, you can find out by entering its title into songbpm.com. And remember to get volume (音量) right. Make sure that the final piece is gradually slowing down. Or you may be woken up by the sudden silence.

It’s very important to get enough high ­quality sleep. Before you go to bed tonight, play some soft music. Then, just prepare to be rocked off to dreamland.

根据材料内容选择最佳答案。

options: only help people under the age of 15
only help people with sleeping problems
only help people who are experiencing lots of stress

It could take as many as 3 weeks to see any improvements.

Why can soft music help us sleep better? The reasons aren’t clear yet. It may connect with the relaxing effect of a good song. Music can have real physical effects, too. Soft music can lower our heart rate (心率) and slow down our breathing. This prepares us for sleep.

Scientists say that for most people, music that has 70 beats (节拍) per minute (bpm) works best. Classical, jazz and folk music are usually more effective than other musical styles. And remember to get volume (音量) right. Make sure that the final piece is gradually slowing down. Or you may be woken up by the sudden silence.

It’s very important to get enough high ­quality sleep. Before you go to bed tonight, play some soft music. Then, just prepare to be rocked off to dreamland.

Good reading habit is the base (基础) of developing reading ability. So, it is very important to help students develop good habits to read well. Here are some useful tips.

[[16]]

As the saying goes, “Interest is the best teacher.” In order to stimulate (激发) students’ interests in reading, choose good reading books. This will make students keep reading all the time. If students meet good books, they want to read them all at once.

[[18]]

subject: english
content:
阅读短文，从方框中选择适当的词并用其正确形式填空，使短文通顺、意思完整。每空限填一词，每词限用一次。

they harm although rubbish another in show have wonderful way

Backpacks(背包) has becomes common and popular among students in the past 30 years. How many backpacks have you [[36]] since you went to school? If your backpacks become old, will you just treat them as [[37]] and throw them away? Five years ago, a research [[38]] that 85% of the old backpacks ended up in dustbins. But as we know, most backpacks are produced from different materials. If we throw them away, they will be [[39]] to our environment.

[[40]] some of the old backpacks are not what they used to be, there are still many things you can do with them. Here are some useful [[41]] for you. For example, it is a [[42]] idea that you can put your old backpacks online for sale. Also, offering your backpacks to other poor kids is [[43]] good choice, as those old backpacks may make [[44]] life more convenient (方便的) than before.

[[45]] a word, old backpacks are still of great value if we make good use of them. Remember: rubbish can be turned into treasures (宝物)!
explanation:
句意：自从你上学以来，你有多少个背包？根据“since you went to school”可知，此处应用现在完成时，have后接过去分词，故填had。

句意：如果你的背包变旧了，你会把它们当作垃圾扔掉吗？根据“throw them away”可知，此处表示当作垃圾扔掉，故填rubbish。

句意：五年前，一项研究表明，85%的旧背包最终被扔进了垃圾箱。根据“that 85% of the old backpacks ended up in dustbins”“Five years ago”可知，此处表示研究表明的结果，五年以前是一般过去时，动词使用过去式，故填showed。

句意：如果我们把它们扔掉，它们将对我们的环境有害。根据“If we throw them away”可知，此处表示随便乱扔对环境有害，be harmful to表示“对……有害”，故填harmful。

句意：虽然一些旧背包不再像以前那样，但你仍然可以用它们做很多事情。根据“there are still many things you can do with them”可知，仍然可以做很多事，此处表示转折，故填Although。

句意：这里有一些对你有用的方法。根据“For example”可知，下文是具体的方法，many后接可数名词复数，故填ways。

句意：例如，你可以把你的旧背包放在网上出售，这是一个很棒的主意。根据“you can put your old backpacks online for sale”可知，这是一个很棒的主意，故填wonderful。

句意：此外，把你的背包给其他贫穷的孩子也是一个很好的选择，因为那些旧背包可能会使他们的生活比以前更方便。根据“Also”可知，此处表示另一个选择，故填another。

句意：此外，把你的背包给其他贫穷的孩子也是一个很好的选择，因为那些旧背包可能会使他们的生活比以前更方便。根据“other poor kids”可知，此处表示他们的生活，故填their。

句意：总之，如果我们充分利用旧背包，它们仍然有很大的价值。in a word表示“总之”，故填In。

subject: english
content:
阅读短文，根据语篇要求填空，使短文通顺、意思完整。每空限填一词。

Dear headmaster,

I’m writing to tell you something important. Nobody likes to be untidy. However, some students throw waste paper and bottles everywhere. We all need a quiet place [[46]] study, but some students often make too much noise at school. Worst of all, some of them are quite rude [[47]] talking to others. Everyone knows their behavior is bad, [[48]] none of us knows how to stop them.

I think we should make rules to change the situation. Anyone [[49]] breaks the rules will be punished. Perhaps it will be hard for us to obey the rules in the beginning, but [[50]] everyone does his or her best to follow the rules, our school environment will improve.

Sincerely,

Kangkang
explanation:
句意：我们都需要一个安静的地方来学习。根据句子结构可知，此空需要一个不定式符号来连接动词study，用动词不定式to study表目的。故填to。

句意：最糟糕的是，有些人在和别人说话时很粗鲁。根据句子结构可知，此空需要一个连词when或while来连接“talking to others”作句子的时间状语。注意，“when/while talking to others”是一个省略了主谓“they are”的状语从句，完整的形式应该是“when/while they are talking to others”。故填when/while。

句意：每个人都知道他们的行为是不对的，但我们都不知道如何阻止他们。根据句子结构可知，此空需要一个连词来连接两个句子，表示转折关系。在英语中，but是表示转折关系的常用连词。故填but。

句意：任何违反规则的人都会受到惩罚。根据句子结构可知，此空需要一个关系代词来引导一个定语从句，修饰“Anyone”，说明是哪些人会受到惩罚。在英语中，who是引导定语从句的常用关系代词，用于指代人。故填who。

句意：但如果每个人都尽力遵守规则，我们的学校环境将会得到改善。根据句子结构可知，此空需要一个连词来引导一个条件状语从句，说明在什么条件下学校的环境会改善。在英语中，if是引导条件状语从句的常用连词，表示“如果”。故填if。

content:

M: Hi, Ann. I called you yesterday evening, but nobody answered it. [[51]]?

W: No, I was preparing for a speech about environmental protection.

M: That’s not easy. [[52]]?

W: I collected information on the Internet and made a PPT.

M: I’m sure you’ll do well.

W: Thank you. I need to go shopping now, would you like to go with me?

M: Yes, I’d love to.

W: Great. Wait a minute, I’ll take a cloth bag with me, I never use plastic bags.

answer:
The man next door

My mother got along well with all our new neighbours except the man who lived next door. My mother said he didn’t look like a nice man.

One day, when my mother came home from work, she realized that she had lost her new necklace which she had bought the day before. She was very worried. She wondered where she had been just then. subject: english
material:
A young man with excellent grades wanted to get a job in a big company. He met the manager for the interview. The manager asked, “Who paid for your education?”

“My parents.” The young man replied.

“Where do they work?”

“They work as clothes cleaners.”

Then, the manager asked the young man to show his hands. He found the young man’s hands were so smooth, and asked, “Have you ever helped your parents wash the clothes?”

“Never.”

“Now go home and clean your parents’ hands, then see me tomorrow morning.”

The young man felt upset. When he got home, he asked his parents to let him clean their hands. They felt strange but happy. While the young man was cleaning their hands, he found his parents’ hands were so wrinkled (起皱的), and there were so many bruises (瘀伤) in their hands. His tears fell. After cleaning his parents’ hands, he quietly washed all the rest of clothes.

The next morning, he went to the manager’s office. The manager asked him, “Can you tell me what you did and learned yesterday in your house?” He told the manager all he did with tears in his eyes and added, “Now I know what appreciation (感激) is. Without my parents, I would not be who I am today... By helping my parents, I realize how much they’ve done for me. And I also realize the importance and value of helping one’s family.”

The manager smiled and said, “This is what I’m looking for.”
content: Why did the young man meet the manager?
options: Because the manager was his friend.
Because the manager needed his help.
Because he wanted to find a job.
Because he wanted to ask for information.
explanation: 细节理解题。根据“A young man with excellent grades wanted to get a job in a big company. He met the manager for the interview.”可知是因为年轻人想找份工作。故选C。

subject: english
material:
In our daily life, we often have such an experience: When we want to eat, being busy, we fight with the hunger. But when we’ve been hungry for a long time, we find us no longer hungry. Why does the sense of hunger go away even if we don’t eat?

Why are people hungry? From a scientific point of view, the food we eat is changed into glucose (葡萄糖) for energy, and we feel hungry because we don’t have enough sugar. Our bodies can feel how much glucose there is in the blood. When there is not enough glucose, a person feels hungry. Hunger is not caused by having less food in the stomach, but the changes in glucose levels. So when you’re hungry, you don’t have to have meals.

When we have been hungry for a long time, why aren’t we hungry? In fact, the spare glucose can be stored. When we can’t eat for some reasons, our body will change these stored sugar into energy. When it arrives at a certain stage, our body will give us a message: the glucose is enough. So we don’t feel hungry anymore.

Is it OK not to eat when you’ve been hungry for a long time? No. It is harmful to the human body. When the stored energy is used up, the body breaks down fat to provide itself with energy. During this process, the person will feel dizzy. If worse, the protein (蛋白质) which is very important to the body also starts to break down, and we are in danger. If the worst, we may lose our lives.

For busy people, take some sweets with you on rainy days. If you have been hungry for too long, you mustn’t give up eating! Start with a piece of candy or some soup.

根据材料内容选择最佳答案。
content: What makes people hungry according to the text?
options: There is less food in our stomach.
The glucose in our body is not enough.
People don’t eat on time because of being busy.
explanation: 细节理解题。根据“When there is not enough glucose, a person feels hungry.”可知，人体内葡萄糖不够时会让人会感到饥饿。故选C。

Why are people hungry? From a scientific point of view, the food we eat is changed into glucose (葡萄糖) for energy, and we feel hungry because we don’t have enough sugar. Our bodies can feel how much glucose there is in the blood. When there is not enough glucose, a person feels hungry. Hunger is not caused by having less food in the stomach, but the changes in glucose levels. So when you’re hungry, you don’t have to have meals.

When we have been hungry for a long time, why aren’t we hungry? In fact, the spare glucose can be stored. When we can’t eat for some reasons, our body will change these stored sugar into energy. When it arrives at a certain stage, our body will give us a message: the glucose is enough. So we don’t feel hungry anymore.

Is it OK not to eat when you’ve been hungry for a long time? No. It is harmful to the human body. When the stored energy is used up, the body breaks down fat to provide itself with energy. During this process, the person will feel dizzy. If worse, the protein (蛋白质) which is very important to the body also starts to break down, and we are in danger. If the worst, we may lose our lives.

For busy people, take some sweets with you on rainy days. If you have been hungry for too long, you mustn’t give up eating! Start with a piece of candy or some soup.

根据材料内容选择最佳答案。
content: Which of the following shows the structure of the text? (①=Paragraph 1, ②= Paragraph 2, ...)

subject: english
material:
I’m sure many people are working hard for a lot of money, a big house, a new car, expensive clothes and so on. Those are considered to be symbols of success on the material level. [[16]] So I chose a job as a salesman and I did make much money.

But later I realized that it was not what I wanted, because I was often forced to sell the products that might not be good for customers. [[17]] I no longer felt proud of my job and even looked down upon myself for doing things like that. [[18]] The sense of belonging (归属感) was great and suddenly I felt successful in my life again. I made less money but I was satisfied with myself.

[[19]] I feel successful when I love what I do, not caring so much about money. I feel the most successful when I spread my kindness everywhere I go.

So be true to yourself. [[20]] Find your own way with a happy heart to achieve your own success.

根据材料内容，从下面五个选项中选出能填入文中空缺处的最佳选项，使文章意思通顺、内容完整。
options: So I gave up my sales job and joined a club to help people in need.
Learn to listen to the voice from the bottom of your heart.
For my part, success comes from the feeling of satisfaction and joy.
I became very unhappy although I could make a lot of money.
When I was young, I was also crazy about achieving material success.
explanation: 根据“So I chose a job as a salesman and I did make much money. But later I realized that it was not what I wanted.”可知，空处表达年轻的时候追求物质上的成功，与后来意识到这不是我想要的形成对比。选项E“当我年轻的时候，我也疯狂地追求物质上的成功。”符合语境。故选E。

Hume is a great teacher. Each of Hume’s students was excellent. In the last year of his life, Hume had already made all his plans. One day, he [[21]] that he would die soon. So he decided to give his [[22]] lesson in the open air.

“What do you see in this [[23]]?” asked Hume.

“Weeds (杂草),” the students answered together.

“Are there any ways to get rid of (除掉) the weeds?”

The students were a little confused (困惑的). “Isn’t this [[24]] to do?” they said to themselves.

The first to speak was an elder student. “I only need a hoe (锄头).”

The second student immediately added, “I think it would be [[25]] to use fire.”

The third student shouted, “To get rid of the weeds, [[26]] must dig deep.”

When his students had finished answering, Hume stood up with a [[27]] and said, “That’s all, you go back and do your own ways to remove a piece of weed. And we’ll come back a year later to [[28]] your results.”

The year passed [[29]]. When the students got together again, they all looked at each other in disappointment (失望) [[30]] no matter (无论) what they did, they could not get rid of the weeds. And some of them even got more. So they couldn’t wait to [[31]] advice from their teacher. [[32]], Hume had died. One passage in the book he had left went like this, “All of your methods are far from [[33]] weeds. The best way to get rid of weeds is planting crops in the fields. In a sense (在某种意义上), your [[34]] is also a field.”

So sow (播下)hope and happiness in the field of your heart. Sow these [[35]] things in the hearts of children and the weeds in their hearts will naturally be removed. Then they will be able to enjoy a beautiful heart and a happy life.

句意：有一天，他意识到自己将不久于人世。
