explanation: 考查冠词的用法。第一空表示“一个花园”，garden以辅音音素开头，用不定冠词a；第二空特指“花园里的花”，用定冠词the。故选A。

content: Welcome to [[_]] new classroom. It is much bigger and cleaner than [[_]].
explanation: 考查代词辨析。ours我们的，名词性物主代词；our我们的，形容词性物主代词；their他们的，形容词性物主代词；theirs他们的，名词性物主代词。根据语境可知，第一空修饰名词“classroom”，所以用形容词性物主代词“our”；第二空指代“他们的教室”，空后没有名词，所以用名词性物主代词“theirs”。故选C。

content: I’ve made great [[_]] in my English since Tom shared good ways of learning with me.
explanation: 考查名词辨析。trouble麻烦；progress进步；advice建议；mess混乱。根据“I’ve made great ... in my English since Tom shared good ways of learning with me.”可知，有了汤姆的好的学习方法，我的英语取得了很大的进步；make progress“取得进步”。故选B。

content: We must keep personal information [[_]] and we’ll be safe.
explanation: 考查形容词辨析。thick厚的；favourite最喜欢的；private私密的；expensive昂贵的。根据“personal information（个人信息）”和“we'll be safe”可知，此处指个人“隐私”，“private”符合语境，故选C。

content: Joe, you should give up playing computer games. It’s [[_]] a waste of time.
explanation: 考查副词辨析。suddenly突然；hardly几乎不；simply仅仅；简直；recently最近。根据“Joe, you should give up playing computer games.”可知，玩电脑游戏是浪费时间，需要一个副词来强调“a waste of time”的程度或肯定性。simply表示“简直是”，用于加强语气，符合语境。故选C。

content: We have to drive very carefully to [[_]] accidents.
explanation: 考查动词辨析。provide提供；refuse拒绝；encourage鼓励；avoid避免。根据句中“drive very carefully”可知，此处是“小心驾驶以避免事故”。故选D。

content: It’s good [[_]] us to do morning exercise.
explanation: 考查介词辨析。with和……一起；to到……；for为了，对于；at在……。根据语境可知，此处是在表达做早操这件事对于我们的健康是有好处的，“It is+形容词+for sb to do sth”是固定句型，表示“做某事对于某人来说是……的”，所以此处应该用介词for。故选C。

content: You should [[_]] all the possible results before making a plan.
explanation: 考查动词短语辨析。think about考虑；pick up捡起，接送；give up放弃；take up占据，从事。根据“all the possible results before making a plan”可知，在制定计划之前，应该考虑所有可能的结果。故选A。

content: His words always make everyone [[_]].
explanation: 考查使役动词make的用法。根据“His words always make everyone...”可知，使役动词make后接宾语和动词原形作宾补，即“make sb. do sth.”结构，表示“使某人做某事”。故选C。

content: Daming trained hard [[_]] his basketball skills.
explanation: 考查非谓语动词。根据“Daming trained hard...his basketball skills.”可知，大明努力训练的目的是提高篮球技能，因此此处应用动词不定式“to improve”作目的状语。故选B。

—Jim, how long have you [[_]] the book?

—For a week. I [[_]] it a week ago.
explanation: 考查延续性动词与非延续性动词。根据“how long”可知此处表示一段时间的时间状语，与have或keep搭配，第一空要用延续性动词，排除选项A；第二空根据“a week ago”是表示一般过去时态的时间状语，动词“buy”的过去式是“bought”。故选B。

content: [[_]] they were walking along the river, a great storm broke out.
explanation: 考查连词辨析。While当……时候；Though尽管；Until直到……为止；After在……之后。根据语境可知，此处是在描述大暴雨发生的时间，即当他们沿着河走的时候，所以应该用While。故选A。

content:
大规模“绿色唱片”的出现导致地下水枯竭，为缓解这一问题，合理的做法是（ ）

①提高节水意识②扩大种植规模③建立引水工程④合理控制“绿色唱片”数量
explanation: 大规模“绿色唱片”（即抽取地下水灌溉形成的农田）导致地下水枯竭，需要采取合理措施缓解。提高节水意识可以减少水资源的浪费，在农业生产和其他用水环节中更合理地利用水资源，有助于缓解地下水枯竭问题，①正确；扩大种植规模会需要更多的灌溉用水，会进一步加剧地下水的开采，导致地下水枯竭问题更严重，②错误；建立引水工程可以从其他水资源较丰富的地区引水，补充当地水资源的不足，减少对地下水的过度依赖，缓解地下水枯竭问题，③正确；合理控制“绿色唱片”数量，即减少过度依赖地下水灌溉的农田面积，可以降低地下水的开采量，缓解地下水枯竭问题，④正确。所以合理的做法是①③④，D正确，ABC错误。故选D。

options: 地球是离太阳最近的行星
地球是离太阳最远的行星
explanation: 水星是离太阳最近的行星，A错误；地球是太阳系的一颗行星，太阳系属于银河系，B正确，D错误；海王星是离太阳最远的行星，C错误。故选B。

content: 八大行星中，与地球相邻的两个行星分别是金星和（　　）
explanation: 太阳系中共有八颗行星，分别是水星、金星、地球、火星、木星、土星、天王星、海王星，因此与地球相邻的两个行星分别是金星和火星，B正确，ACD错误。故选B。

content: 据探测器观测，月球表面没有大量可供直接呼吸的氧气，也没有稳定存在的液态水。一片荒凉的月表布满了陨石坑。相比较而言，地球上生机勃勃的主要原因是（　　）
options: 宇宙环境非常安全，从来没有陨石撞击地球
地球昼夜温差极大，适合生物生存
地球土壤和月壤一样，都是岩石碎屑
日地距离适中，使地球有适宜的温度和液态水
explanation: 地球上生机勃勃的主要原因是日地距离适中，大气层保护下温度适宜，有适合的温度；相对安全的宇宙环境以及液态水的存在，为人类的生存提供生命之源，D正确；地球可能会遭到陨石袭击，A错误；地球昼夜温差较小，适合生物生存，B错误；地球上的土壤和月壤有所差别，C错误。故选D。

content: 观察下图“大河流域的亚非古国示意图”，图中ABCD四个文明区域与下列文明成果对应正确的是（　　）
options: B区——阿拉伯数字和《汉谟拉比法典》
explanation: 根据题干地图中信息可知，A区位于非洲东北部尼罗河流域，对应古埃及文明，其文明成果包括象形文字和太阳历，A项正确；B区为亚洲西部两河流域（古巴比伦），《汉谟拉比法典》是古巴比伦的重要成果，但阿拉伯数字是由古印度人发明、经阿拉伯人传播的，并非两河流域的文明成果，排除B项；C区为亚洲南部印度河流域（古印度），种姓制度是古印度文明成果，但金字塔是古埃及（A区）的文明成果，二者不匹配，排除C项；D区为亚洲东部黄河流域（中国），甲骨文是中国商朝的文字，但佛教起源于古印度（C区），并非中国文明成果，排除D项。故选A项。

content: 民国八年六月，《新闻报》载，“此次沪上风潮始由学生罢课，继由商人罢市，近日将有劳动工人同盟罢工。”文中史事（　　）
options: 支持了北伐的胜利进军
为中国民族资本主义的产生创造了条件
结束了国民党反动统治
为新的革命力量登上历史舞台创造了条件
explanation: 据材料“民国八年六月”“此次沪上风潮始由学生罢课，继由商人罢市，近日将有劳动工人同盟罢工”及所学可知，叙述的是1919年五四运动爆发的历史信息。五四运动是一场彻底的反帝反封建的爱国运动，标志着中国无产阶级作为新的力量登上了政治舞台，揭开了中国新民主主义革命的序幕，D项正确；北伐战争开始于1926年，民国八年是1919年，排除A项；洋务运动在客观上促进了民族资本主义的产生，排除B项；1949年4月，人民解放军渡过长江解放了南京，标志着国民党反动派在中国大陆的统治宣告结束，排除C项。故选D项。

content: 已知集合\(A = \left\{ x∣ {2}^{x} \geqslant 1 \right\} , B = \left\{ x ∣ 3 - x \gt 2 \right\}\)，则\(A \cap B =\)()
explanation:
解：因为\(A = \left\{ x∣ {2}^{x} \geqslant 1 \right\} = \left\{ x∣ {2}^{x} \geqslant{2}^{0} \right\} = \left\{ x∣x \geqslant 0 \right\}\)，\(B = \left\{ x ∣ 3 - x \gt 2 \right\} = \left\{ x ∣ x \lt 1 \right\}\)，

所以\(A \cap B = \left\{ x∣x \geqslant 0 \right\} \cap \left\{ x \mid x \lt 1 \right\} = \left\{ x ∣ 0 \leqslant x \lt 1 \right\}\)．

故选：\(D\)．

content: 命题\(p\)：\(\forall x \in \left\{ x \mid x \gt 1 \right\}\)，\(2 x + 1 \gt 5\)，则命题\(p\)的否定是()
explanation:
解：命题\(p\)：\(\forall x \in \left\{ x \mid x \gt 1 \right\}\)，\(2 x + 1 \gt 5\)，

则命题\(p\)的否定是：\(\exists x \in \left\{ x \mid x \gt 1 \right\}\)，\(2 x + 1 \leqslant 5 .\)

故选：\(A\)．

content: 某校男生与女生人数之比为\(3:2\)，为了解该校学生的体重情况，按性别采用分层随机抽样的方法从该校学生中抽样\(120\)人进行调查，则该校女生被抽取的人数是()
explanation:
解：由分层抽样定义可知被抽取到的女学生人数是\(120 \times \dfrac{2}{3 + 2} = 4 8\)．

故选：\(B\)．

content: 函数\(f \left( x \right) = {x}^{3} + 2 x - 4\)的零点所在区间是()
explanation:
解：因为\(y = {x}^{3} , y = 2 x - 4\)均在\(R\)上单调递增，

则\(f \left( x \right) = {x}^{3} + 2 x - 4\)在\(R\)上单调递增，

由已知\(f \left( 0 \right) = - 4 \lt 0\)，\(f \left( 1 \right) = 1 + 2 - 4 = - 1 \lt 0\)，\(f \left( \dfrac{3}{2} \right) = {\left( \dfrac{3}{2} \right)}^{3} + 2 \times\dfrac{3}{2} - 4 = \dfrac{19}{8} \gt 0\)，

\(f \left( 2 \right) = 8 + 4 - 4 \gt 0\)，\(f \left( \dfrac{5}{2} \right) = {\left( \dfrac{5}{2} \right)}^{3} + 2 \times\dfrac{5}{2} - 4 = \dfrac{133}{8} \gt 0\)，

\(\therefore f \left( 1 \right) f \left( \dfrac{3}{2} \right) \lt 0\)，

由零点存在性定理可得函数\(f \left( x \right) = {x}^{3} + 2 x - 4\)的零点所在区间是\(\left( 1, \dfrac{3}{2} \right)\)．

故选：\(C\)．

content: 已知函数\(f \left( x \right) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l} x - 2 , x \geqslant 0 \\ {2}^{2 x - 1} , x \lt 0 \end{array} \right.\)，则\(f \left( f \left( 1 \right) \right) =\)()
explanation:
解：函数\(f \left( x \right) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l} x - 2 , x \geqslant 0 \\ {2}^{2 x - 1} , x \lt 0 \end{array} \right. ,\)

则\(f \left( 1 \right) = 1 - 2 = - 1\)，

故\(f \left( f \left( 1 \right) \right) = f \left( - 1 \right) = {2}^{- 2 - 1} = {2}^{- 3} = \dfrac{1}{8}\)．

故选：\(C\)．

content: 函数\(f \left( x \right) = \dfrac{x}{1 - {x}^{2}}\)的图象大致是()
explanation:
【分析】

本题考查函数图象的识别，具体函数的定义域，属于基础题．

先求出函数的定义域，结合函数在不同范围的正负值，即可判断．

【解答】

解：由\(1 - {x}^{2} \ne 0\)，解得\(x \ne \pm 1\)，故C错误；

\(\because\)函数\(f \left( x \right) = \dfrac{x}{1 - {x}^{2}}\)，

当\(x \in \left( 0,1 \right)\)时，\(f \left( x \right) \gt 0\)，故D错误；

当\(x \in \left( 1 , + \infty \right)\)时，\(f \left( x \right) \lt 0\)，故A错误．

故选：\(B\)．

content: 已知定义在\(R\)上的函数\(f \left( x \right)\)满足：\(f \left( 2 \right) = 2\)，且\(\forall x \in R\)，\(f \left( x + 1 \right) \leqslant f \left( x \right) + \dfrac{x}{2}\)，\(f \left( x + 4 \right) \geqslant f \left( x \right) + 2 x + 3\)，则\(f \left( 1 0 \right) =\)()
explanation:
解：根据题意，\(\forall x \in R\)，\(f \left( x + 1 \right) \leqslant f \left( x \right) + \dfrac{x}{2}\)，

由于\(f \left( 2 \right) = 2\)，则\(f \left( 3 \right) \leqslant f \left( 2 \right) + 1 = 3\)，\(f \left( 4 \right) \leqslant f \left( 3 \right) + \dfrac{3}{2} \leqslant\dfrac{9}{2}\)，

\(f \left( 5 \right) \leqslant f \left( 4 \right) + 2 \leqslant\dfrac{13}{2}\)，\(f \left( 6 \right) \leqslant f \left( 5 \right) + \dfrac{5}{2} \leqslant 9\)，

\(f \left( 7 \right) \leqslant f \left( 6 \right) + 3 \leqslant 1 2\)，\(f \left( 8 \right) \leqslant f \left( 7 \right) + \dfrac{7}{2} \leqslant\dfrac{31}{2}\)，

\(f \left( 9 \right) \leqslant f \left( 8 \right) + 4 \leqslant\dfrac{39}{2}\)，\(f \left( 1 0 \right) \leqslant f \left( 9 \right) + \dfrac{9}{2} \leqslant 24\)，

又由\(f \left( x + 4 \right) \geqslant f \left( x \right) + 2 x + 3\)，而\(f \left( 2 \right) = 2\)，

则\(f \left( 6 \right) \geqslant f \left( 2 \right) + 7 = 9\)，\(f \left( 1 0 \right) \geqslant f \left( 6 \right) + 1 5 \geqslant 2 4\)，

综合可得：\(2 4 \leqslant f \left( 1 0 \right) \leqslant 2 4\)，故\(f \left( 1 0 \right) = 2 4\)．

故选：\(D\)．

content: 已知\(a \gt b \gt 0\)，\(c \lt 0\)，则下列不等式一定成立的是()
explanation:
解：选项A：由\(a \gt b \gt 0\)得\(a - b \gt 0\)，\(c a - c b = c \left( a - b \right)\)，因\(c \lt 0\)，故\(c a - c b \lt 0\)，即\(c a \lt c b\)，\(A\)成立．

选项B：\(c \lt 0\)，则\({c}^{2} \gt 0\)，又\(a \gt b \gt 0\)，故\(a {c}^{2} \gt b {c}^{2}\)，\(B\)成立．

选项C：\(c \lt 0\)，则\(c - 1 \lt - 1\)，\(a \gt b \gt 0\)，乘以\(c - 1 (\)负数\()\)不等号反向，故\(a \left( c - 1 \right) \lt b \left( c - 1 \right)\)，\(C\)不成立．

选项D：\(a \gt b \gt 0\)，乘\(a\)得\({a}^{2} \gt a b\)，乘\(b\)得\(a b \gt{b}^{2}\)，故\({a}^{2} \gt a b \gt{b}^{2}\)，\(D\)成立．

故选：\(ABD\)．

content: 下列命题正确的有()
options: 函数\(f \left( x \right) = {a}^{x - 1} + 1 ( a \gt 0\)且\(a \neq 1 )\)过定点\(\left( 1 , 2 \right)\)
函数\(f \left( x + 1 \right)\)的定义域为\(\left[ 0 , 1 \right]\)，则\(f \left( {2}^{x} \right)\)的定义域为\(\left[ 2 , 4 \right]\)
不等式\(\left| 2 x - 3 \right| \gt 5\)的解集为\(\{ x | x \lt - 1\)或\(x \gt 4 \}\)
explanation:
解：对于\(A\)，根据指数函数的性质可知，\(f \left( x \right) = {a}^{x - 1} + 1\)过定点\(\left( 1 , 2 \right)\)，A正确；

对于\(B\)，若\(f \left( x + 1 \right)\)的定义域为\(\left[ 0 , 1 \right]\)，则\(1 \leqslant x + 1 \leqslant 2\)，

对于函数\(f \left( {2}^{x} \right)\)，\(1 \leqslant{2}^{x} \leqslant 2\)，解得\(0 \leqslant x \leqslant 1\)，B错误；

对于\(C\)，由\(\left| 2 x - 3 \right| \gt 5\)可得\(2 x - 3 \gt 5\)或\(2 x - 3 \lt - 5\)，解得\(x \gt 4\)或\(x \lt - 1\)，C正确；

对于\(D\)，令\(t = \sqrt{2 + {x}^{2}}\)，\(t \geqslant \sqrt{2}\)，

原函数可化为\(y = t + \dfrac{1}{t}\)，则函数在\(\left[ \sqrt{2} , + \infty \right)\)上单调递增，\(y \geqslant \sqrt{2} + \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}} = \dfrac{3 \sqrt{2}}{2}\)，D错误．

故选：\(AC\)．

content:
已知定义在\(R\)上函数\(f \left( x \right)\)的图象是连续不断的，且满足以下条件：

\(① \forall x \in R\)，\(f \left( - x \right) = f \left( x \right)\)；

\(② \forall{x}_{1}\)，\({x}_{2} \in \left( 0 , + \infty \right)\)，当\({x}_{1} \neq{x}_{2}\)时，都有\(\dfrac{f \left( {x}_{2} \right) - f \left( {x}_{1} \right)}{{x}_{2} - {x}_{1}} \lt 0\)；

\(③f \left( - 1 \right) = 0 .\)

则下列选项成立的是()
options: \(\forall x \in R\)，\(\exists M \in R\)，使得\(f \left( x \right) \leqslant M\)
explanation:
解：对于\(A\)，因为\(\forall x \in R\)，\(f \left( - x \right) = f \left( x \right)\)，

所以函数\(f \left( x \right)\)为偶函数，

因为\(\forall{x}_{1}\)，\({x}_{2} \in \left( 0 , + \infty \right)\)，

当\({x}_{1} \neq{x}_{2}\)时，都有\(\dfrac{f \left( {x}_{2} \right) - f \left( {x}_{1} \right)}{{x}_{2} - {x}_{1}} \lt 0\)，

所以函数\(f \left( x \right)\)在\(\left( 0 , + \infty \right)\)上递减，

则\(f \left( 5 \right) \lt f \left( 4 \right) = f \left( - 4 \right)\)，故 A正确；

对于\(B\)，因为定义在\(R\)上函数\(f \left( x \right)\)的图象是连续不断的，\(f \left( - 1 \right) = 0\)，则\(f \left( 1 \right) = 0\)，

所以当\(- 1 \lt x \lt 1\)时，\(f \left( x \right) \gt 0\)，

当\(x \lt - 1\)或\(x \gt 1\)时，\(f \left( x \right) \lt 0\)，

由\(\dfrac{f \left( x \right)}{x} \lt 0\)，得\(\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x \gt 0 \\ f \left( x \right) \lt 0 \end{array} \right.\)或\(\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x \lt 0 \\ f \left( x \right) \gt 0 \end{array} \right. ,\)

解得\(x \gt 1\)或\(- 1 \lt x \lt 0\)，

即若\(\dfrac{f \left( x \right)}{x} \lt 0\)，则\(x \in \left( - 1 , 0 \right) \cup \left( 1 , + \infty \right)\)，故 B正确；

对于\(C\)，若\(f \left( m - 1 \right) \lt f \left( 2 \right)\)，则\(\left| m - 1 \right| \gt 2\)，

解得\(m \gt 3\)或\(m \lt - 1\)，故 C错误；

对于\(D\)，要使\(\forall x \in R\)，\(\exists M \in R\) ，\(f \left( x \right) \leqslant M\)，只需要\(f {\left( x \right)}_{\max} \leqslant M\)，

因为函数\(f \left( x \right)\)的图象在\(R\)上是连续不断的，

且函数\(f \left( x \right)\)在\(\left( 0 , + \infty \right)\)上递减，函数\(f \left( x \right)\)是\(R\)上的偶函数，

所以函数\(f \left( x \right)\)在\(\left( - \infty , 0 \right)\)上递增，

所以函数\(f {\left( x \right)}_{\max} = f \left( 0 \right)\)，

所以当\(M \geqslant f \left( 0 \right)\)时，\(f \left( x \right) \leqslant M\)，

故\(\forall x \in R\)，\(\exists M \in R\)，使得\(f \left( x \right) \leqslant M\)，故 D正确．

故选：\(ABD\)．

content: 已知幂函数\(y = f \left( x \right)\)图象过点\(\left( 2 , 4 \right)\)，则\(f \left( 9 \right) =\)[[_]]．
explanation:
【分析】

本题考查了幂函数的定义，考查了函数值的求法，属于基础题．

设出幂函数的解析式，把点\(\left( 2 , 4 \right)\)代入求出解析式，然后直接求解\(f \left( 9 \right)\)的值．

【解答】

解：设幂函数为\(f \left( x \right) = {x}^{a}\)，

由于图象过点\(\left( 2 , 4 \right)\)，得\({2}^{a} = 4\)，\(\therefore a = 2\)，

\(\therefore f \left( 9 \right) = {9}^{2} = 8 1\)．

故答案为：\(81\)

content: 已知函数\(f \left( x \right) = 2 {a}^{x - 2} - 1 ( a \gt 0\)且\(a \neq 1 )\)无论\(a\)取何值时，\(f \left( x \right)\)的图象恒过定点\(A\)，且\(A\)在直线\(y = m x + n \left( m \gt 0 , n \gt 0 \right)\)上，则\(\dfrac{2}{m} + \dfrac{1}{n}\)的最小值为[[_]]．
explanation:
解：函数\(f \left( x \right) = 2 {a}^{x - 2} - 1 ( a \gt 0\)且\(a \neq 1 )\)，

当\(x - 2 = 0\)时，\(f \left( x \right) = 2 \times 1 - 1 = 1\)，

可得\(x = 2\)，所以\(f \left( x \right)\)的图象恒过定点\(A \left( 2,1 \right)\)，

而\(A\)在直线\(y = m x + n \left( m \gt 0 , n \gt 0 \right)\)上，

所以\(2 m + n = 1\)，

所以\(\dfrac{2}{m} + \dfrac{1}{n} = \left( \dfrac{2}{m} + \dfrac{1}{n} \right) \left( 2 m + n \right) = 4 + 1 + \dfrac{2n}{m} + \dfrac{2m}{m} \geqslant 5 + 2 \sqrt{\dfrac{2n}{m} \cdot\dfrac{2m}{n}} = 9\)，

当且仅当\(\dfrac{2n}{m} = \dfrac{2m}{n}\)，即\(m = n = \dfrac{1}{3}\) 时，取等号，

所以\(\dfrac{2}{m} + \dfrac{1}{n}\)的最小值为\(9.\)

故答案为：\(9.\)

content: 近年来，遵义市基础教育质量大幅提升，\(2025\)年高考成绩再上新台阶，一方面，得益于各级政府及教育部门的殷切关怀与高度重视：另一方面，与莘莘学子的“聪慧值”密切相关\(.\)定义：“聪慧值”\(=\)“天赋值”\(\times\)“年提升值”\((\)“天赋值”具有先天性\()\)，某中学高一\(\left( 1 \right)\)班学生小李和小王开学时的“天赋值”分别为\(150\)分和\(100\)分，“年提升值”相同，自开学那天起，小王努力学习，刻苦钻研，“年提升值”都在前一年的基础上进步\(5\%\)，而小李疏于学习，“年提升值”都在前一年的基础上退步\(2\%.\)问：大约经过[[_]]年，小王的“聪慧值”是小李的\(2\)倍\(. (\)精确到整数，参考数据：\(lg3 \approx 0.48\)，\(lg105 \approx 2.02\)，\(\lg 98\approx 1.99)\)
explanation:
解：由题意可得\(100\times{\left( 1 + 5 \% \right)}^{x}=2\times 150\times{\left( 1 - 2 \% \right)}^{x}\)，化简可得\({\left( \dfrac{1.05}{0.98} \right)}^{x} = 3\)，

\(\therefore x = l o {g}_{\frac{1.05}{0.98}} 3 = \dfrac{lg3}{\lg\dfrac{105}{98}} = \dfrac{lg3}{l g 1 0 5 - l g 9 8} \approx \dfrac{0.48}{2 . 0 2 - 1 . 9 9} = 1 6\)，

\(\therefore\)大约经过\(16\)年，小王的“聪慧值”是小李的\(2\)倍．

故答案为：\(16\)．

已知集合\(A = \left\{ x∣ {x}^{2} - 3 x - 4 \lt 0 \right\} , B = \left\{ x ∣ a - 3 \lt x \lt a + 5 \right\}\)．

\(\left( 1 \right)\)当\(a = 3\)时，求\(A \cup B,A \cap B\)；

\(\left( 2 \right)\)若\(A \cap B = ⌀\)，求\(a\)的取值范围．
answer: 解：\(\left( 1 \right)\)因为\(A = \left\{ x \left| {x}^{2} - 3 x - 4 \lt 0 \right\} = \left\{ x \right| - 1 \lt x \lt 4 \right\}\)． 当\(a = 3\)时\(B = \left\{ x \mid 0 \lt x \lt 8 \right\}\)， 所以\(A \cup B = \left\{ x \mid - 1 \lt x \lt 8 \right\}\)，\(A \cap B = \left\{ x \mid 0 \lt x \lt 4 \right\}\)． \(\left( 2 \right)\)因为\(a + 5 \gt a - 3\)， 所以\(B \ne ⌀\)， 因为\(A \cap B = ⌀\)， 所以\(a + 5 \leqslant - 1\)或\(a - 3 \geqslant 4\)， 所以\(a \leqslant - 6\)或\(a \geqslant 7\)． 综上\(a\)的取值范围是．

content:
\((\)本小题\(12\)分\()\)

某企业为响应国家节水号召，决定对污水进行净化再利用，以降低自来水的使用量\(.\)经测算，企业拟安装一种使用寿命为\(4\)年的污水净化设备\(.\)这种净水设备的购置费\((\)单位：万元\()\)与设备的占地面积\(x (\)单位：平方米\()\)成正比，比例系数为\(0.2\)，预计安装后该企业每年需缴纳的水费\(C (\)单位：万元\()\)与设备占地面积\(x\)之间的函数关系为\(C \left( x \right) = \dfrac{20}{x + 5} \left( x \gt 0 \right)\)，将该企业的净水设备购置费与安装后\(4\)年需缴水费之和合计为\(y (\)单位：万元\()\)．

\(\left( 1 \right)\)要使\(y\)不超过\(7.2\)万元，求设备占地面积\(x\)的取值范围；

\(\left( 2 \right)\)设备占地面积\(x\)为多少时，\(y\)的值最小？
answer: 解：\(\left( 1 \right)\)由题意得\(y = 0 . 2 x + \dfrac{80}{x + 5} \left( x \gt 0 \right)\)， 令\(y \leqslant 7.2\)即\(0 . 2 x + \dfrac{80}{x + 5} \leqslant 7.2\)， 整理得\({x}^{2}-31x+220\leqslant 0\)即\(\left( x - 1 1 \right) \left( x - 2 0 \right) \leqslant 0\)， 所以解得\(11 \leqslant x \leqslant 20\)， 所以设备占地面积\(x\)的取值范围为\(\left[ 11,20 \right]\)． \(( 2 y = 0 . 2 x + \dfrac{80}{x + 5} = \dfrac{x + 5}{5} + \dfrac{80}{x + 5} - 1 \geqslant 2 \sqrt{\dfrac{x + 5}{5} \times\dfrac{80}{x + 5}} - 1 = 2 \sqrt{16} - 1 = 7 ,\) 当且仅当\(\dfrac{x + 5}{5} = \dfrac{80}{x + 5}\)即\(x = 1 5\)时等号成立， 所以设备占地面积为\(15 {m}^{2}\)时，\(y\)的值最小．
explanation:
本题考查了利用函数模型解决实际问题，属于中档题．

\(\left( 1 \right)\)由题意得\(y = 0 . 2 x + \dfrac{80}{x + 5} \left( x \gt 0 \right)\)，解不等式\(y \leqslant 7.2\)即可得解．

\(\left( 2 \right)\)将\(y = 0 . 2 x + \dfrac{80}{x + 5} \left( x \gt 0 \right)\)变形为\(y = \dfrac{x + 5}{5} + \dfrac{80}{x + 5} - 1\)，再利用基本不等式即可求解．

content:
\((\)本小题\(12\)分\()\)

某地区有小学生\(9000\)人，初中生\(8600\)人，高中生\(4400\)人，教育局组织网络“防溺水”网络知识问答，现用分层抽样的方法从中抽取\(220\)名学生，对其成绩进行统计分析，得到如图所示的频率分布直方图．

\(\left( 1 \right)\)根据频率分布直方图，估计该地区所有学生中知识问答成绩的平均数和众数；

\(\left( 2 \right)\)成绩位列前\(10\%\)的学生平台会生成“防溺水达人”优秀证书，试估计获得“防溺水达人”的成绩至少为多少分；

\(\left( 3 \right)\)已知落在\(\left[ 6 0 , 7 0 \right)\)内的平均成绩为\(67\)，方差是\(9\)，落在\(\left[ 6 0 , 8 0 \right)\)内的平均成绩是\(73\)，方差是\(29\)，求落在\(\left[ 7 0 , 8 0 \right)\)内的平均成绩和方差．

\((\)附：设两组数据的样本量、样本平均数和样本方差分别为：\(m\)，\(\overline{x_{1}}\)，\({s}_{1}^{2}\)；\(n\)，\(\overline{x_{2}}\)，\({s}_{1}^{2}\)，记两组数据总体的样本平均数为\(\overline{w}\)，则总体样本方差\({s}^{2} = \dfrac{m}{m + n} \left[ {s}_{1}^{2} + {\left( \overline{x_{1}} - \overline{w} \right)}^{2} \right] + \dfrac{n}{m + n} {\left[ {s}_{2}^{2} + \left( \overline{x_{2}} - \overline{w} \right) \right]}^{2} ) .\)
answer: 解：\(\left( 1 \right)\)一至六组的频率分别为\(0.10\)，\(0.15\)，\(0.15\)，\(0.30\)，\(0.25\)，\(0.05\)， 所以平均数估计为： \(45\times 0.10+55\times 0.15+65\times 0.15+75\times 0.30+85\times 0.25+95\times 0.05=71\)， 由图可知，众数为\(75\)，以样本估计总体， 该地区所有学生中知识问答成绩的平均数为\(71\)分，众数为\(75\)分； \(\left( 2 \right)\)前\(4\)组的频率之和为\(0.10+0.15+0.15+0.30=0.70\lt 0.90\)， 前\(5\)组的频率之和为\(0.70+0.25=0.95\gt 0.90\)， 所以第\(90\%\)分位数落在第\(5\)组，设为\(x\)， 则\(0.70+\left( x - 8 0 \right)\times 0.025=0.90\)， 解得\(x = 8 8\)， 所以“防溺水达人”的成绩至少为\(88\)分； \(\left( 3 \right) \left[ 6 0 , 7 0 \right)\)的频率为\(0.15\)，\(\left[ 7 0 , 8 0 \right)\)的频率为\(0.30\)， 所以\(\left[ 6 0 , 7 0 \right)\)的频率与\(\left[ 6 0 , 8 0 \right)\)的频率之比为\(\dfrac{0.15}{0 . 1 5 + 0 . 3 0} = \dfrac{1}{3}\)， \(\left[ 7 0 , 8 0 \right)\)的频率与\(\left[ 6 0 , 8 0 \right)\)的频率之比为\(\dfrac{0.30}{0 . 1 5 + 0 . 3 0} = \dfrac{2}{3}\)， 设\(\left[ 7 0 , 8 0 \right)\)内的平均成绩和方差分别为\(\overline{x_{2}}\)，\({s}_{2}^{2}\)， 依题意有\(7 3 = \dfrac{1}{3} \times 6 7 + \dfrac{2}{3} \times\overline{x_{2}}\)，解得\(\overline{x_{2}} = 7 6\)， \(2 9 = \dfrac{1}{3} \times\left[ 9 + {\left( 6 7 - 7 3 \right)}^{2} \right] + \dfrac{2}{3} \times\left[ {s}_{2}^{2} + {\left( 7 6 - 7 3 \right)}^{2} \right]\)，解得\({s}_{2}^{2} = 1 2\)， 所以\(\left[ 7 0 , 8 0 \right)\)内的平均成绩为\(76\)，方差为\(12\)．
explanation:
本题主要考查了分层随机抽样的方差，分层随机抽样的样本均值，百分位数、平均数、众数、中位数的概念，属于中档题．

\(\left( 1 \right)\)在频率分布直方图中，平均数等于每组的组中值乘以每组的频率之和；众数是最高矩形横坐标的中点，据此求解．

\(\left( 2 \right)\)依题意可知题目所求是第\(90\%\)分位数，先判断第\(90\%\)分位数落在哪个区间再求解即可；

\(\left( 3 \right)\)先求出每组的比例，再根据分层随机抽样的平均数及方差求解即可．

．

content:
\((\)本小题\(17\)分\()\)

已知\(f \left( x \right) = l o {g}_{3} \dfrac{5 + x}{a - x} \left( a \gt 0 \right)\)是奇函数．

\(\left( 1 \right)\)求\(a\)的值及\(f \left( x \right)\)的定义域；

\(\left( 2 \right)\)判断\(f \left( x \right)\)的单调性并用定义法证明；

\(\left( 3 \right)\)求不等式\(f \left( 2 x - 3 \right) + f \left( x - 3 \right) \geqslant 0\)的解集．
answer:
解：\(\left( 1 \right)\)因为\(f \left( x \right) = l o {g}_{3} \dfrac{5 + x}{a - x} \left( a \gt 0 \right)\)是奇函数，
所以\(f \left( - x \right) + f \left( x \right) = 0\)恒成立，
所以\(lo {g}_{3} \dfrac{5 - x}{a + x} + l o {g}_{3} \dfrac{5 + x}{a - x} = 0\)，
即\(lo {g}_{3} \dfrac{2 5 - {x}^{2}}{{a}^{2} - {x}^{2}} = l o {g}_{3} 1\)，
所以\(\dfrac{2 5 - {x}^{2}}{{a}^{2} - {x}^{2}} = 1\)，
所以\(2 5 - {x}^{2} = {a}^{2} - {x}^{2}\)，
所以\({a}^{2} = 2 5\)，
因为\(a \gt 0\)，
所以\(a = 5\)，
所以\(f \left( x \right) = l o {g}_{3} \dfrac{5 + x}{5 - x}\)，
所以\(\dfrac{5 + x}{5 - x} \gt 0\)，
所以\(\left( x + 5 \right) \left( x - 5 \right) \lt 0\)，
所以\(- 5 \lt x \lt 5\)，
所以函数\(f \left( x \right) = l o {g}_{3} \dfrac{5 + x}{5 - x}\)的定义域为\(\left( - 5 , 5 \right)\)；
\(\left( 2 \right)\)函数\(f \left( x \right) = l o {g}_{3} \dfrac{5 + x}{5 - x}\)在\(\left( - 5 , 5 \right)\)上单调递增；
证明：\(\forall{x}_{1} , {x}_{2} \left( - 5 , 5 \right)\)，且\({x}_{1} \lt{x}_{2}\)，
\(f \left( {x}_{1} \right) - f \left( {x}_{2} \right) = l o {g}_{3} \dfrac{5 + {x}_{1}}{5 - {x}_{1}} - l o {g}_{3} \dfrac{5 + {x}_{2}}{5 - {x}_{2}} = l o {g}_{3} \dfrac{\left( 5 + {x}_{1} \right) \left( 5 - {x}_{2} \right)}{\left( 5 - {x}_{1} \right) \left( 5 + {x}_{2} \right)} = l o {g}_{3} \dfrac{2 5 + 5 \left( {x}_{1} - {x}_{2} \right) - {x}_{1} {x}_{2}}{2 5 - 5 \left( {x}_{1} - {x}_{2} \right) - {x}_{1} {x}_{2}}\)，
因为\({x}_{1} \lt{x}_{2}\)，
所以\({x}_{1} - {x}_{2} \lt 0\)，
所以\(5 \left( {x}_{1} - {x}_{2} \right) \lt - 5 \left( {x}_{1} - {x}_{2} \right)\)，
所以\(2 5 + 5 \left( {x}_{1} - {x}_{2} \right) - {x}_{1} {x}_{2} \lt 2 5 - 5 \left( {x}_{1} - {x}_{2} \right) - {x}_{1} {x}_{2}\)，
所以\(0 \lt\dfrac{2 5 + 5 \left( {x}_{1} - {x}_{2} \right) - {x}_{1} {x}_{2}}{2 5 - 5 \left( {x}_{1} - {x}_{2} \right) - {x}_{1} {x}_{2}} \lt 1\)，
所以\(f \left( {x}_{1} \right) - f \left( {x}_{2} \right) \lt 0\)，
即\(f \left( {x}_{1} \right) \lt f \left( {x}_{2} \right)\)，
所以\(f \left( x \right)\)在\(\left( - 5 , 5 \right)\)上单调递增；
\(\left( 3 \right)\)因为\(f \left( 2 x - 3 \right) + f \left( x - 3 \right) \geqslant 0\)，
所以\(f \left( 2 x - 3 \right) \geqslant - f \left( x - 3 \right) = f \left( 3 - x \right)\)，
因为\(f \left( x \right)\)在\(\left( - 5 , 5 \right)\)上单调递增，
所以\(\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 2 x - 3 \geqslant 3 - x \\ - 5 \lt 2 x - 3 \lt 5 \\ - 5 \lt x - 3 \lt 5 \end{array} \right. ,\)
所以\(2 \leqslant x \lt 4\)，
所以不等式\(f \left( 2 x - 3 \right) + f \left( x - 3 \right) \geqslant 0\)的解集为\(\left[ 2,4 \right)\)．
explanation: 详细答案和解析过程见【答案】

content: This new app [[_]] over ten million downloads (下载) since last year.
explanation:
句意：自去年以来，这款新应用已经拥有超过一千万次下载。

考查现在完成时。had一般过去时；has第三人称单数，一般现在时；has had现在完成时。根据“since last year”可知表示“自去年以来”，强调从过去持续到现在的动作或状态，需用现在完成时（have/has + 过去分词）。主语“This new app”为单数，因此用has had。故选C。

content: [[_]] it was raining heavily, they still went on hiking.
explanation:
句意：尽管雨下得很大，他们仍然继续徒步旅行。

考查连词辨析。Because因为，表原因；If如果，表条件；Although尽管，表让步。根据“it was raining heavily”和“they still went on hiking”可知，此处是转折让步关系，即“虽然下雨，但仍继续徒步”，“Although”符合语境。故选C。

content: [[_]] wonderful AI painting it is! It looks just like a real photo.
explanation:
句意：多么奇妙的一幅AI绘画啊！它看起来就像一张真实的照片。

考查感叹句结构。What多么；What a多么……啊；How多么。感叹句通常由“What”或“How”引导，其中“What”修饰名词（短语），“How”修饰形容词或副词。本句中“wonderful AI painting”是一个可数名词单数短语，中心词是名词“painting”，因此应使用“What a + 形容词 + 可数名词单数”的结构。根据句意和感叹句规则，应选择“What a”。故选B。

content: To reduce cyber risks (网络风险), personal information online will [[_]] carefully.
explanation:
句意：为了降低网络风险，网上的个人信息将被谨慎保护。

考查一般将来时的被动语态。protect为动词，意为“保护”。根据语境“个人信息”是“被保护”的对象，句子主语personal information online与动词protect之间为被动关系，且本句描述将来的情况，应用一般将来时的被动语态，结构为“will be done”。故选B。

content: He was so tired that he [[_]] down on the bed and fell asleep quickly.
explanation:
句意：他太累了，以至于他躺在床上很快就睡着了。

考查动词时态和动词辨析。lies躺，现在时第三人称单数；lay躺，lie的过去式；laid放置，lay的过去式。根据“and fell asleep quickly”可知，此处应用动词的过去式与fell并列，根据“down on the bed”，可知此处表示躺下，应用lay。故选B。

content: Many students are discussing what AI can do for their study. Do you know [[_]]?
options: how it helps them plan time
explanation:
句意：许多学生正在讨论AI能为他们的学习做什么。你知道它如何帮助他们规划时间吗？

考查宾语从句的语序。A项where does it help most和B项what does it help均为疑问句语序（助动词提前），但宾语从句需使用陈述句语序（主语在前，谓语在后）。C项how it helps them plan time为陈述句语序，符合宾语从句规则。故选C。

content: This is the popular science video [[_]] I watched yesterday about the Deepseek.
explanation:
句意：这就是我昨天看的关于深度求索的那个科普视频。

考查定语从句关系代词。先行词“the popular science video”为物，在定语从句中作宾语，应用关系代词that或which引导；what不引导定语从句；who用于指人。故选A。

content: The movie named “Dead To Rights” is worth [[_]] twice.
explanation:
句意：电影《南京照相馆》值得看两遍。

考查非谓语动词。be worth doing sth.表示“值得做某事”，其中doing用主动形式表被动含义。故选B。

content: Pre-made (预制) dishes [[_]] more and more popular in cities because they save time.
explanation:
句意：预制菜在城市里变得越来越受欢迎，因为它们节省时间。

考查动词时态。become变得，动词原形；became变得，过去式；are becoming正在变得，现在进行时。根据“Pre-made dishes...more and more popular in cities because they save time.”可知，预制菜在城市里变得越来越受欢迎，描述的是一个正在发生的变化趋势，应该用现在进行时表示现阶段持续的状态。故选C。

content: It’s important to remember that it’s okay not to feel [[_]] all the time.
explanation:
句意：重要的是要记住，不必一直都保持开心的状态。

考查形容词作表语。happily快乐地，副词；happiness快乐，名词；happy快乐的，形容词。根据“feel”可知，此处feel是系动词，意为“感到”，其后应接形容词作表语。故选C。

content: Though Confucius has been dead for many years, we [[_]] still [[_]] by his ideas today.
explanation:
句意：尽管孔子已经去世多年，我们今天仍然受他的思想影响。

考查一般现在时的被动语态。分析句子结构，主语“we”是谓语动词“influence”的承受者，即“我们被他的思想影响”，因此应用被动语态结构“be+过去分词”，“influence”的过去分词是“influenced”。时间状语“today”表明为现在时态，主语 “we” 对应的 be 动词是 “are”；因此正确结构是 “are influenced”。故选C。

content: Li Fang didn’t go to school yesterday [[_]] she was ill.
explanation:
句意：李芳昨天没去上学，因为她病了。

考查连词辨析。until直到……才；but但是；because因为；though尽管。根据主句“didn’t go to school”和从句“she was ill”的逻辑关系可知，生病是没去上学的原因。because“因为”，引导原因状语从句，符合此因果关系。故选C。

content:
—Excuse me, can you tell me [[_]]?

—It’s a little far from here. You’d better take the subway.
options: how I can get to the nearest bookstore
how can I get to the nearest bookstore
when can I get to the nearest bookstore
when I can get to the nearest bookstore
explanation:
句意：——打扰一下，你能告诉我怎么去最近的书店吗？——它离这里有点远。你最好坐地铁去。

考查宾语从句语序。how I can get to the nearest bookstore我怎样才能到达最近的书店，陈述语序；how can I get to the nearest bookstore我怎样才能到达最近的书店，疑问语序；when can I get to the nearest bookstore我什么时候能到达最近的书店，疑问语序；when I can get to the nearest bookstore我什么时候能到达最近的书店，陈述语序。空格位于动词“tell me”之后，是宾语从句，需用陈述语序（引导词+主语+谓语）。根据答语“It’s a little far from here.”可知，问句询问的是“如何去”，即方式，应用“how”引导。故选A。

content:
—I am going to visit Mount Pan during the winter holiday.

—Really? [[_]]
explanation:
句意：——我打算寒假去盘山游览。——真的吗？玩得开心！

考查情景交际用语。What a pity真遗憾；Have fun玩得开心；Bad luck真倒霉；It’s nice of you你真好。根据前句“I am going to visit Mount Pan during the winter holiday”可知，对方应表达祝愿，希望对方“玩得开心”，因此“Have fun!”符合语境。故选B。

content: “高粱叶子青又青，九月十八来了日本兵！先占火药库，后占北大营……”小调反映的史实（　　）
options: 揭开了世界反法西斯战争序幕
在国内外产生了积极影响
使抗日战争达到最大规模
explanation: 根据材料“九月十八来了日本兵”“后占北大营”并结合所学知识可知，1931年9月18日夜，日本关东军炸毁沈阳北郊柳条湖附近南满铁路的一段路轨，反诬中国军队破坏，并以此为借口，突然袭击中国东北军驻地北大营，炮轰沈阳城，次日清晨占领沈阳，这就是九一八事变，揭开了世界反法西斯战争的序幕，A项正确；“在国内外产生了积极影响”这一表述较为宽泛。在抗日战争中，如第三次长沙会战等战役给日军以沉重打击，在国内外产生了积极影响。但九一八事变本身是日本侵华的开始，其直接结果是中国东北的沦陷，并非积极影响，排除B项；九一八事变是中国抗日战争的起点，而不是抗日战争达到最大规模。排除C项；1946年6月，国民党军队大举进攻中原解放区，全面内战爆发，与九一八事变无关，排除D项。故选A项。

content:
日本自明治维新后确立了“大陆政策”，企图通过侵略中国实现扩张，于是在1931年对中国发动侵华战争。下列事件均发生于抗日战争期间，其发生的先后顺序是（　　）

①西安事变 ②七七事变 ③九一八事变 ④一二·九运动
explanation: 结合所学知识，1931年9月18日，九一八事变是日本发动侵华战争的起点，标志着局部抗战的开始，1935年12月9日，一二·九运动是北平学生发起的抗日救国示威运动，1936年12月12日，张学良和杨虎城扣押蒋介石，发动西安事变，逼蒋抗日，促成了国共合作，1937年7月7日，七七事变标志着全面抗战的爆发，根据历史事件的时间顺序为③④①②，C项正确；根据事件的时间顺序，分别排除ABD项。故选C项。

content:
具备基本的化学实验技能是学习化学和进行探究活动的基础和保证。下列图示操作规范的是（　　）

A. 读取液体体积

B. 点燃酒精灯

C. 滴加液体

D. 倾倒液体

下列实验方法一定能达到实验目的的是（　　）

选项

content: 材料三、材料四中对于汉武帝的评价，有以下观点：第一种，汉武帝是封建统治阶级中的一个杰出帝王；第二种，汉武帝有暴秦之恶而没遇到亡秦之祸。你认为哪种观点更准确，请简要说明理由。亦可提出你自己的观点并进行说明。（要求：明确写出自己的观点；说明理由要有史实依据）
answer:
观点：汉武帝是封建统治阶级中的一个杰出帝王。
理由：为巩固皇权，汉武帝建立了中朝，在地方设置刺史，开创察举制选拔人才。采纳主父偃的建议，颁行推恩令，解决王国势力，并将盐铁和铸币权收归中央。文化上采用了董仲舒的建议，“罢黜百家，尊崇儒术”，结束先秦以来“师异道，人异论，百家殊方”的局面。汉武帝时期攘夷拓土、国威远扬，东并朝鲜、南吞百越、西征大宛、北破匈奴，奠定了汉地范围，首开丝绸之路、首创年号，兴太学。刘彻在各个领域均有建树，综上所述，汉武帝是封建统治阶级中的一个杰出帝王。

content: 喜马拉雅山脉位于乙[[_]]板块和丙[[_]]板块的交界地带，板块之间发生[[_]](碰撞挤压、张裂拉伸)运动，使其逐渐升高。
explanation: 喜马拉雅山脉位于乙印度洋板块和丙亚欧板块的交界地带，板块之间发生碰撞挤压运动，使得山脉逐渐升高。印度洋板块不全是海洋，还包括印度半岛、阿拉伯半岛和澳大利亚大陆等；亚欧板块上主要的大洲是亚洲和欧洲；碰撞挤压和张裂拉伸是板块运动的两种形式。

①学习防震知识②进行地震预报③熟悉避难场所④参加地震演习
explanation: 板块构造学说表明，板块内部地壳相对稳定，而板块与板块交界的地带，地壳运动比较活跃，这一区域也更容易发生火山、地震。学校可以组织学生开展的地震相关活动，①学习防震知识，可以让学生掌握基础的避险方法，是合理的活动；②进行地震预报，这是专业科研机构的工作，学校和学生不具备相关能力，不合理；③熟悉避难场所，能让学生在地震发生时快速找到安全区域，是合理的活动；④参加地震演习，可以提升学生应对地震的实际反应能力，是合理的活动；综上，在地震频发地区，学校可以组织学生①③④。

——张乾元《中国共产党自信的底气从何而来》

材料二 目前，中国人民的主要敌人，是日本帝国主义，所以把日本帝国主义与蒋介石同等看待是错误的，“抗日反蒋”的口号，也是不适当的。在日本帝国主义继续进攻，全国民族革命运动继续发展的条件下，国民党中央军全部或其大部有参加抗日的可能。我们的总方针应是逼蒋抗日。

——1936年9月1日《中共中央关于逼蒋抗日问题的指示》

材料三 全国抗战一开始，中国共产党就提出了实行全体人民参加战争、支援战争的全面抗战路线，积极建立和维护抗日民族统一战线；开辟敌后根据地，牵制大量日军，使敌后战场逐步上升为中国抗日战争的主战场。1938年毛泽东撰写《论持久战》论证了中国共产党的持久战理论，最终取得了抗日战争的胜利。

——摘编自黄浩涛《抗日战争胜利的历史启示》

Joining a club is a great way to meet new people，especially if you are new to the school.Joining a club forces you to communicate with people who have similar interests as you.Even if you are the shyest and quietest person，you are sure to develop a relationship with at least one person in the club that you decide to join.

Another really nice thing about joining a club is that doing activities looks good on college applications(申请)．Being known as outgoing is a highly important quality(品质)；it shows that you are determined and willing to try new things.Another nice thing is that it could help you develop skills that you could use during a college interview.

Many students struggle(斗争) with productivity.Most teens go to school and then come home and spend the rest of the day in front of the television or phone，but activities can prevent this.Teens are easily influenced and if they end up with the wrong group of people，they may face bad results such as problems with the law.Clubs provide a safe place to spend time with friends.

Maybe the most important reason why you should join a club is the long-term benefit(益处) it brings.The classroom isn’t the only learning environment in a school.Things such as meeting and speaking to new people，keeping an eye on the time，and being organized are things you will use every single day of your life.

options: A person who is not smart.
A person who is not accepted.

content:
语法填空

Lauren Parrino is a senior in high school.She is having a busy schedule this year.

Parrino [[1]](become) a captain of her school’s Cross-Country team at the start of the school year.She shared her enthusiasm(热情) for the coming season.“I’m really [[2]](excite) that I’ll be leading the race with other captains.”

However，the captain’s drive doesn’t end there.Parrino [[3]](accept) into a volunteer programme at Florida Hospital Wesley Chapel a few days ago.“It’s a six-month programme，” explained Parrino.“I work as the concierge(服务台职员) [[4]] Mondays and can go around the hospital and meet nurses and even doctors.It’s given me a closer look into the medical field.”

Besides，Parrino plays [[5]] active role in clubs around the school.She is the vice president of both French Honor Society and Key Club and plans on [[6]](join) another club this year.

Involving herself in several extra-curricular [[7]](activity)，Parrino manages her time to the best of her ability.[[8]] sometimes she has to take time away from one thing in order to have time for another，Parrino feels confident in her ability [[9]](succeed) in all of them.She said，“There’s never a perfect balance(平衡)，but I don’t let [[10]](I) stop until I’m in control of everything to the best that I’m able to be.”
answer: (1) became；(2) excited；(3) was accepted；(4) on；(5) an；(6) joining；(7) activities；(8) Although/Though/While；(9) to succeed；(10) myself
explanation:
考查动词时态。根据at the start of the school year可知，本句描述过去的动作，故时态用一般过去时，谓语用become“成为”的过去式。故填became。

考查形容词。本空用形容词excited“兴奋的”，作表语。故填excited。

考查动词时态、语态和主谓一致。根据a few days ago可知，本句描述过去的动作，故时态用一般过去时，且Parrino与accept“接纳”为被动关系，应用一般过去时的被动语态，主语为第三人称单数，be动词用was。故填was accepted。

考查介词。本空用on，表示在具体的某一天。故填on。

考查冠词。此处泛指“一个积极的角色”，且active的发音以元音音素开头，应用不定冠词an。故填an。

考查非谓语动词。本空用join“加入”的动名词joining，作plan on的宾语。故填joining。

考查名词复数。根据several可知，本空用名词activity“活动”的复数形式，作in的宾语。故填activities。

考查让步状语从句。分析句子可知，前后句意存在转折让步关系，应用although/though/while“虽然”引导让步状语从句，位于句首，首字母大写。故填Although/Though/While。

考查非谓语动词。本句谓语为feels，此处为非谓语动词，one’s ability to do sth意为“某人做某事的能力”，本空用succeed“成功”的不定式，作ability的后置定语。故填to succeed。

考查代词。分析句意可知，本空用myself，表示“我自己”，作don’t let的宾语。故填myself。

material:
How to Set up a Student Club

Starting a club is a great way to meet new people，explore your interests，and show leadership on college applications.[[1]]

Identify(确定) a need.What type of club you’re interested in creating？[[2]] Then，try to consider club themes and projects where you can share your interest with other people and have a positive influence on your community.For example，to gain a skill (e.g.photography club)，to explore art (e.g.drama club)，to enjoy your hobbies (e.g.calligraphy club) and so on.

[[3]] Once you have identified the club’s purpose，map out a clearer picture of how the club will be organized.And try to answer these questions：Will the club be centered around certain milestones? For example，if it’s a Ski Club，perhaps it concentrates on two ski trips every year.Will members have their own responsibilities? Will the club be workshop-based or event-based? What will be the rules of the club?

Register the club.Don’t forget to apply to register your new club with your school.Depending on its process for the creation of new clubs，you can fill in the club application forms.[[4]] He or she should have experience or interest in the subject of the club you are creating.Some schools also require you to write a proposal explaining the club’s purpose，how people can join and its rules.

Publicize.Once your club application has been accepted，you will need to recruit(招募) some members to join your club.Put up posters which are eye-catching and easy to read or advertise the club on the school’s website.[[5]]
options: Choosing a club advisor is also a key step.
You’ll find them effective to market the club.
These ways are key to run your club smoothly.
Choose the subjects you love and want to explore further.
Here are the four steps to create a brand-new one at your school.
explanation: 上文“Starting a club is a great way to meet new people，explore your interests，and show leadership on college applications.”提到成立一个社团带给高中生的好处，下文是成立社团的四个步骤，G项“这里有四个步骤来在你的学校创建一个全新的社团”承上启下，符合语境，故选G。

content:
语法填空

(2025·山东威海高一上期中)

It might seem that [[1]](enter) senior high school is the end of the carefree，light-hearted days.But that isn’t the way to think about your new journey.For every late night completing schoolwork ahead of you，there’s also [[2]] chance.There may be less of the fun your younger self enjoyed，but different pleasures lie ahead.

You will find people start to treat you [[3]](different)．Adults will give you more respect because they’ll consider you [[4]] one of them.As you grow，your sense of what is [[5]](value) will change.In senior high，you’ll have the chance [[6]](develop) your new interest.The clubs that you can join will suit the fact that you are [[7]](old) than before.You’ll build new friendships and the friends you make in high school can last a lifetime.There will be hard work and pressure ahead，but you’ve reached a turning point in life [[8]] you will achieve more.

You are an [[9]](adventure)—a modern-day Xuan Zang or Marco Polo who had dreams—they needed to be strong，and they both faced challenges.But they succeeded，and [[10]](win) glory(荣誉)．Now it’s your turn to begin YOUR own great adventure.
explanation:
考查非谓语动词。此处为动名词作主语，故填entering。

考查冠词。此处chance为泛指，且是发音以辅音音素开头的单词。故填a。

考查副词。修饰动词treat应用副词differently，故填differently。

考查介词。短语consider sb as...表示“把某人看作……”。故填as。

考查形容词。作表语用形容词valuable。故填valuable。

考查非谓语动词。名词chance后跟不定式作后置定语。故填to develop。

考查形容词比较级。根据后文than before可知为形容词比较级。故填older。

考查定语从句。此处为定语从句修饰先行词a turning point，在从句作抽象地点状语，故填where。

考查名词。根据不定冠词可知，用单数名词adventurer，表示“冒险家”，作表语。故填adventurer。

考查动词时态。根据上文succeeded可知为一般过去时。故填won。

material:
Australian teenagers are missing important，basic kitchen skills and it’s having a negative(消极的) influence on their health.It’s also leading our next generation towards increased rates of obesity(肥胖)，according to the findings of a new survey.

A national survey of 1,006 parents found that close to half of all 12 to 18 years old teenagers can’t boil an egg；1 in 5 only have kitchen skills that allow them to pour milk on cereal；42% can’t boil noodles；83.9% don’t know how to roast a chicken；60.1 percent can’t bake a potato.

Research company Pureprofile asked parents to judge(评判) how well their kids could perform in the kitchen across some tasks.More than half (67.3%) of parents believe their children could do better when it comes to healthy food and lifestyle knowledge.Close to half of parents (42.5%) believe poor food choices are caused by lack of education at middle school，with 9 in 10 parents in support of schools doing more to encourage a healthy lifestyle.

Miriam Raleigh，an expert on the relationship between food and health，said she was already seeing a generation of young parents who had “no idea how to cook”．“They depend on convenience(方便) meals and easy snacks，and those foods often have a higher fat and salt content which can lead to obesity and a lot of health problems，” Ms Raleigh said.

The school’s Kitchen Garden program founder，Stephanie Alexander，said that if more was not done to improve the situation we would be heading towards a generation of fatter and more unhealthy kids.Ms Alexander also said she would introduce her Kitchen Garden program into middle schools so teenagers can learn the art of cooking food.“I’m so proud of what we have achieved in the primary school and I really believe we can have the same success in middle schools，” she said.

material:
(2025·山东济宁高一上期中)

Math is everywhere in our life，from working out the bill after dinner to your personal costs.While some people enjoy solving math problems，many others are afraid of the moment when they have to deal with numbers and feel really anxious.It might seem discouraging(使人沮丧的)，but this “math anxiety” is quite common，and you’re far from being the only one who feels this way.Besides，our worries and fears don’t always show how able we are.

The reason for this problem often begins to appear in our childhood at school.Studies have shown that math teachers who feel nervous about teaching the subject can pass their anxiety to their students，and girls might be more affected by this anxiety.According to the Program for International Student Assessment，around 31% of 15 and 16-year-olds in 34 countries said that they felt very nervous when solving math problems,33% said they got nervous doing math homework，and nearly 60% worried that math classes would be difficult.Shulamit Kahn，from Boston University’s Questrom School of Business，told the BBC that providing students，especially girls，with good role models ‘is important，especially at a young age.’She believes the key is to have people，especially women who love teaching math，educate younger kids.

David Robson，writing for BBC Future，mentioned，“It’s unclear why math causes so much fear compared to other subjects like geography.But knowing there’s a right or wrong answer might make you more anxious about not doing well.”

And if we believe that we’re not “math people”，we may question about ourselves and avoid solving problems that we could deal with.

Researchers have been trying to work out why mental math can make us nervous.This fear might come from all kinds of sources，but some suggest that openly expressing your fears can weaken their control on you and encourage children to see math tests as challenges rather than threats(威胁)．We need to have a positive view(有积极的看法) on math and give it another try.
content: What’s the main idea of paragraph 2?
options: Girls are better at math than boys.
Math classes are difficult for everyone.
Students’ anxiety only comes from teachers.
Math anxiety in childhood affect students’ confidence.
explanation: 段落大意题。根据第二段“The reason for this problem often begins to appear in our childhood at school.Studies have shown that math teachers who feel nervous about teaching the subject can pass their anxiety to their students...providing students，especially girls，with good role models ‘is important，especially at a young age.’ She believes the key is to have people，especially women who love teaching math，educate younger kids.”可知，本段的主旨是童年数学焦虑影响学生的自信心。故选D。

material:
(2025·安徽高一上期中)

School can be stressful unless you know how to manage your stress.

Learn to deal with your tasks.

[[1]] But the biggest one is the tasks and learning materials students need to deal with continually.This is why one of the simplest ways to reduce stress for students is to deal with some of the work.The best choice for students is the job writing service Edubirdie where students can find expert writers who will take over some of their tasks.

Make changes in your food.

Stress management for students starts with what they eat.This might come as a surprise.[[2]] What you need to manage stress and keep yourself focused on your school tasks is a proper diet.We are talking about food rich in vegetables，fruits，meat and whole grains.

Find a way to exercise properly.

When asked why they aren’t exercising often，most students say that they don’t have the time or energy for it.[[3]] And the best part is，you don’t need to exercise for hours every day.You can try easier activities.For example，after a long day of study，taking a walk at night can make up your energy.Take the stairs instead of the lift every day.[[4]]

Don’t cut down on your sleep.

When you are too worried，you cannot act at your best.The tasks have taken you more time than they should，and you simply have no time left to study or write.When this happens，most students will reduce their sleep to focus on their duties.[[5]] If you keep reducing sleep，this will make you more worried.
options: Walk to school or other places.
Try to avoid fatty food and sugar.
School is stressful for a number of reasons.
But your food is one of the keys to your energy levels.
But exercise is what will actually raise your energy levels.
In this way，you can have enough time to party with friends.
explanation: 根据下文“But the biggest one is the tasks and learning materials students need to deal with continually.”可知，下文指出了造成学校压力的最重要的原因，D选项“学校造成的压力有很多原因”引出下文，故选D。

content:
语法填空

(2025·河北保定高一上期中)

Pre-made dishes，also known as precooked food，have been gaining increasing [[1]](popular) in recent years.These are meals that are partially or fully prepared in a factory or commercial kitchen before being sold to consumers.

One of the main [[2]](advantage) of pre-made dishes is convenience(方便)．People with busy lifestyles prefer to buy them instead of cooking from scratch.Pre-made dishes can [[3]](place) in the refrigerator and heated up quickly when needed.

The variety of pre-made dishes is also increasing.There are different dishes [[4]] can satisfy different tastes.For example，you can find Italian-style pasta dishes，Chinese stir-fries and American-style burgers.

[[5]]，there are also some concerns.Some pre-made dishes are high [[6]] salt and fat.The long-term consumption may lead to health problems.In addition，some pre-made dishes contain additives(添加剂)．Although these additives are used [[7]](keep) the food fresh，they may cause concerns among consumers.Some pre-made dishes lack the freshness of home-cooked meals.When [[8]](cook) at home，we can choose fresh ingredients.But for pre-made dishes，we don’t know [[9]](exact) how long the ingredients have been stored.

In conclusion，pre-made dishes are convenient but have some problems that we should consider.We should make [[10]] wise choice according to our own needs.
answer: (1) popularity；(2) advantages；(3) be placed；(4) that/which；(5) However/Nevertheless；(6) in；(7) to keep；(8) cooking；(9) exactly；(10) a
explanation:
考查名词。根据空格前的动词gaining可知，空格处应该用名词popularity作宾语。故填popularity。

考查名词复数。根据空格前的one of the可知，空格处应该用名词复数形式advantages。故填advantages。

考查被动语态。动词place与句子的主语pre-made dishes之间是被动关系，应该用被动语态，空格前有can，be动词用原形。故填be placed。

考查定语从句。空格处引导限制性定语从句，对先行词dishes进行限定说明，从句中缺少主语，先行词指物，所以应该用关系代词that或which引导。故填that/which。

As kids grow up，there’s a good chance that—if you’re a parent—you have a surplus of toys in your home.There are plenty of children，however，who do not have their own toy collection.This is where you can make a difference by doing your part to support children in need.To make this easier，we’ve rounded up a list of organizations that are always on the lookout for toy donations(捐赠)．

Second Chance Toys

Founded in 2006，Second Chance Toys recycles plastic toys and donates them to community organizations that service children in need.

The organization partners with a number of drop-off locations across the U．S.You can find a location near you，register as a donor(捐赠人)，sign up for a time to drop off your toys，and you’re good to go!

The organization only accepts clean plastic toys with no small or missing parts.

Ronald McDonald House

The Ronald McDonald House houses thousands of children and families who experience severe medical care.

The organization does not accept used toys，but if you have any new and unopened toys，you can donate them to one of hundreds of locations across the U．S.

Stuffed Animals for Emergencies

Stuffed Animals for Emergencies(SAFE) accepts stuffed animal donations and gives them to children in need who have faced difficult times.

SAFE accepts new and used toys，no matter how old they are.The organization also accepts donations of old items like blankets，books and kids clothes.

You can find a chapter in your area and sign up to host a stuffed animal drive.
content: How can people donate toys to Second Chance Toys?
options: By mailing toys directly to a location.
By scheduling a drop-off time for toys.
By donating toys at an organized event.
By finding a partner at a nearby location.
explanation: 细节理解题。根据Second Chance Toys部分中的“You can find a location near you，register as a donor(捐赠人)，sign up for a time to drop off your toys，and you’re good to go！”可知，给Second Chance Toys组织捐赠玩具需要提前约定好时间。故选B。

Tom Turcich，an adventurer from New Jersey，returned to his hometown with his dog，Savannah，after traveling around the world for seven years.They were greeted by a huge homecoming celebration in Haddon Township with Turcich officially(正式地) becoming the 10th person on record to walk around the world，and Savannah the first dog to do so.While he was thrilled to have won the honour，Turcich stressed that this was never really his goal.

The journey had seen the pair walk across 38 countries，including Chile，Panama and Kazakhstan，together.Turcich remained extremely happy for the next three months as he took in his unbelievable achievement.“Crossing the finish line felt like paradise，” he said.“And everything was perfect.”

However，as that real high began to fade(消退)，he faced a difficult reality.“Life goes on，” he noted，realizing how hard it was to adjust to life without the focus of his journey.“I had this realization when I was walking to the park with Savannah，” he said.“This thing that had been my life forever was over.But then life kept going on，and you can just live life without this greater purpose.And then it became really difficult.”

Things came to a head when he moved to Seattle with Savannah.Since completing the challenge，he’s been contacted(联系) by others who hope to achieve the same thing.So Turcich wrote the book The World Walk about his experiences during the amazing trip.Turcich said his main goal was to encourage people to be a little more curious about places and a little more trusting of the world.“I just create a book that readers would enjoy，” he added.“Just tell a good story about a man and his dog walking around the world.”
content: What can be learned about Turcich and his dog?
options: They got first pick of the prizes.
They remained in Chile for nine months.
They set a record on a world tour.
They were the first to journey to Haddon.
explanation: 细节理解题。根据第一段中“They were greeted...with Turcich officially(正式地) becoming the 10th person on record to walk around the world，and Savannah the first dog to do so.”可知，Turcich和他的小狗创造了环游世界的纪录。故选C。

(2025·安徽皖豫名校联盟高一上期中)

Ma Myung-sun didn’t expect much from the bananas he planted on a farm in Seoul.He must use a greenhouse for part of the year to protect the bananas from South Korea’s cold winters.But warmer temperatures because of climate(气候) change have produced a welcome surprise in the form of flowers and fruit.

The land area where tropical crops(热带作物) are grown in South Korea has increased from about 295 hectares(公顷) in 2021 to 3,306 hectares in 2023.There are 67 banana farms in the south.And Ma is among a growing number of farmers experimenting with crops usually grown in a warmer climate.

“I want to try growing other tropical crops too.So，as you can see here，I have planted these papaya trees as well，” Ma said，pointing to a small papaya plant.

Ma opened up part of his family’s farm to people from the city in 2006.He is happy about his small success but he worries about what it means for the climate.“I feel that the climate problem has become very serious，” said Ma，who has been a farmer for 25 years.

South Korea lies in the temperate zone and has four seasons.But its climate appears to be getting warmer and wetter throughout the year.The average(平均的) yearly temperature has been continually rising.The average temperature of 13.7 degrees Celsius last year was the highest since its records began in 1973.

Rainfall during last year’s rainy season was 660.2mm nationwide，nearly two times the 356.7 mm annual average figure.South Korea’s climate conditions are becoming more like those of tropical areas，so farming experts say it is important for farmers to find the right crop types for the climate.

Tropical fruits are usually expensive in South Korea，so shoppers should welcome the less costly local produce.“My kids love bananas.So，it would be good if we can buy bananas grown in our own country，” said Kim Ji-youn，who was buying imported(进口的) bananas in a Seoul supermarket.
content: What’s the influence of climate change on Ma’s farm?
options: It has made it possible to grow some tropical crops.
It has required him to water the crops more often.
The area where crops can be planted has become smaller.
The farm’s production of traditional crops has dropped.
explanation: 细节理解题。根据第一段中“But warmer temperatures because of climate(气候) change have produced a welcome surprise in the form of flowers and fruit.”和第二段“The land area where tropical crops(热带作物) are grown in South Korea has increased...And Ma is among a growing number of farmers experimenting with crops usually grown in a warmer climate.”可知，气候变化使他在农场种植一些热带作物成为可能。故选A。

(2025·山东名校考试联盟高一上期中)

Whether it’s biting(咬) your nails(指甲)，or going to bed at 2 a．m.，we all have those annoying habits we just can’t seem to kick.But have you ever wondered why these bad habits keep winning the battle against your best efforts and intentions?

Humans are creatures of habit，and our brains love doing things the same way.That’s why bad habits grow easily in the repeated actions.Another reason why your bad habits keep winning is that they often provide a quick dopamine(多巴胺) fix，creating a desire that keeps you coming back for more.Think of the immediate relaxation from mindless snacking.The reward(回报) for doing such things is quick and easy，which is exactly what makes them so hard to resist(抵抗)．

So what can you do? There are two main problems with breaking bad habits.First，it’s not as enjoyable as giving in to them.When we try to resist，there’s no pleasure，no dopamine and therefore no encouragement to keep doing so.Rather than trying to remove them completely，try to replace them with something healthier instead，or create a reward system for yourself to introduce the positive(积极的) behaviour.

Second，a habit is often an unconscious action，so making it conscious changes it into a choice.You’d better start with an intentional action.Accepting your actions without judgement helps you stay apart from the feelings that keep you tied to those habits，like guilt，shame and dissatisfaction.This increased awareness(意识) will lead you to make more intentional(有意的) choices and break the cycle of bad habits.

Knowing the psychology behind why your bad habits keep winning hopefully gets you to make more conscious，positive choices，and change，and build the foundation for lasting behavioural change.
content: How does the writer introduce the topic?
options: By coming up with a question.
explanation: 推理判断题。根据第一段中“But have you ever wondered why these bad habits keep winning the battle against your best efforts and intentions？”以及下文的分析可知，作者通过提出问题来引入话题，即为什么坏习惯总能战胜我们的努力和意图。故选D。

Humans are creatures of habit，and our brains love doing things the same way.That’s why bad habits grow easily in the repeated actions.Another reason why your bad habits keep winning is that they often provide a quick dopamine(多巴胺) fix，creating a desire that keeps you coming back for more.Think of the immediate relaxation from mindless snacking.The reward(回报) for doing such things is quick and easy，which is exactly what makes them so hard to resist(抵抗)．

So what can you do? There are two main problems with breaking bad habits.First，it’s not as enjoyable as giving in to them.When we try to resist，there’s no pleasure，no dopamine and therefore no encouragement to keep doing so.Rather than trying to remove them completely，try to replace them with something healthier instead，or create a reward system for yourself to introduce the positive(积极的) behaviour.

Second，a habit is often an unconscious action，so making it conscious changes it into a choice.You’d better start with an intentional action.Accepting your actions without judgement helps you stay apart from the feelings that keep you tied to those habits，like guilt，shame and dissatisfaction.This increased awareness(意识) will lead you to make more intentional(有意的) choices and break the cycle of bad habits.

Knowing the psychology behind why your bad habits keep winning hopefully gets you to make more conscious，positive choices，and change，and build the foundation for lasting behavioural change.

Family meetings are a good way to improve communication among all family members.To hold a successful family meeting，you need to avoid the following common mistakes.

Giving up too soon.[[36]] It may take some time for everyone to grow comfortable with family meetings.But if you hold them regularly(定期) and try to make them better，your meetings can become helpful to everyone in the family.

[[37]] Don’t use your meetings to single out one person for creating a problem and don’t lecture(说教) the kids about the way they act.You might take a problem-solving approach(方法) by saying，“The house has been pretty messy lately.What can we do about that？”

Letting kids have too much power.While you want to ask for the kids’ opinions，make it clear that they don’t have equal say(平等的发言权) in important family matters，like whether you’re going to move.[[38]] Then they know you are interested in hearing their thoughts on the matters.

Going too far off the topic.Your kids may begin to get off the topic and if you don’t bring the conversation back to the task at hand，you may feel the meeting is pointless.[[39]]

Getting into arguments(争吵)．[[40]] Family meetings are a great time to introduce socially proper ways to deal with disagreements.If the kids start to argue noisily or someone crosses the line，stop them at once.
options: Turning a meeting into a lecture.
They always get the better of an argument.
If your first meeting doesn’t go well，don’t give up.
Lecturing your children about making too much noise.
In this case，step in and tell them to get to the main topic.
Even so，let them know the adults are open to their opinions.
At times，a family meeting ends up with an endless argument.
explanation: 由上文“Giving up too soon.”可知，本段要说的错误做法跟“太快放弃”有关，由下文“It may take some time for everyone to grow comfortable with family meetings.But if you hold them regularly(定期) and try to make them better，your meetings can become helpful to everyone in the family.”可知，大家适应家庭会议需要时间，所以即使第一次家庭会议不成功，也不要放弃，C选项能承上启下，符合题意。故选C。

(2025·江苏南京六校高一上期中联考)

China，the birthplace of tea，[[56]](hold) a deep-rooted(根深蒂固的) relationship with this beloved drink since ancient times.Tea has become a part of Chinese culture，appearing in poems and [[57]](tradition) customs.For many，the joy of tea comes not just from its taste，[[58]] from the beauty of tea ceremonies.

In spring，[[59]](pick) tea leaves is a valued activity in South China.Before Qingming in early April，[[60]] the weather warms up and rain comes more often，the first tea leaves are ready to be harvested(收获)．This early tea，called Mingqian tea，is [[61]](high) praised for its quality.

Zhejiang Province in East China is [[62]] major(主要的) tea-producing area.Famous types include White Tea from Anji county and West Lake Longjing Tea from Hangzhou，both of which [[63]](know) in China and abroad.During spring，the hills in these areas are covered with tea workers taking care of their plants.Many [[64]](tourist) visit these areas to enjoy the beautiful tea farms and taste freshly brewed tea.

Thousands of years ago，Chinese people turned a simple leaf [[65]] a delicious drink.Over time，tea has continued to play an important role in Chinese culture，enriching lives and preserving(保存) traditions.
explanation:
考查动词时态和主谓一致。空处作句子的谓语，结合时间状语“since ancient times”可知，时态应用现在完成时，且主语China为单数，助动词用has。故填has held。

考查形容词。空处作customs的定语，应用形容词traditional，意为“传统的”。故填traditional。

考查连词。固定结构not just...but...表示“不仅……还……”。故填but。

考查非谓语动词。空处和空后的tea leaves搭配，作句子的主语，是非谓语动词，且此处指普通的、一般的行为，因此应用pick“采摘”的动名词形式。故填picking。

考查定语从句。空处引导非限制性定语从句，修饰先行词Qingming in early April，在从句中作时间状语，应用关系副词when。故填when。

考查副词。空处修饰动词praised，应用high的副词形式highly，意为“高度地，非常”。故填highly。

考查冠词。此处表示“一个主要的产茶区”，应用不定冠词表示泛指，且空后major的发音以辅音音素开头，应用a。故填a。

考查动词时态、语态和主谓一致。空处作非限制性定语从句的谓语，此处在描述通常性的事实，时态应用一般现在时，know“知晓”和主语both of which之间是被动关系，应用被动语态，且主语是复数，be动词应用are。故填are known。

考查名词复数。空处作主语，根据空前的“Many”可知，tourist“游客”应用复数形式。故填tourists。

考查介词。动词短语turn...into...意为“把……变为……”。故填into。

(2025·河南南阳高一上期中)

One sunny day，Alex，a young boy，was walking home from school when he noticed something unusual.A small，scruffy(邋遢的) dog was sitting alone by the side of the road，its eyes full of fear and confusion.The poor dog looked lost and hungry.Alex felt a sense of empathy in his heart as he walked towards the dog slowly，offering it a piece of his sandwich.

The moment the dog cautiously took the food from his hand，Alex’s heart melted.He could see that the dog was alone and scared，and he knew he couldn’t just leave it there.Without a second thought，Alex decided to take the dog home.He carefully hid the dog in the garage，hoping his father wouldn’t find out.

For days，Alex spent all his spare time in the garage，playing with the dog.He named the dog Max，and they quickly became close friends.Their bond grew stronger day by day as they shared countless adventures together.Max brought so much joy into Alex’s life.

One day，Alex’s father discovered their secret.He was surprised and told the boy to put Max back on the street，thinking it was for the best.With a heavy heart，Alex did as he was told.He left Max at a park，hoping that someone else would find him and give him a loving home.But as he walked away，his heart ached with sadness，tears welling up in his eyes.

Alex was heartbroken.He missed Max terribly and found it hard to focus on anything else.His grades started to slip(下滑)，and he became quiet.His usual cheerfulness had disappeared，replaced by deep sadness that seemed to swallow him whole.Seeing this，his father realized how much Max meant to Alex.

注意：1.续写词数应为150个左右；

2．请按如下格式在答题纸的相应位置作答。

The father decided to bring Max back.                                       

                                                                        

                                                                        

The boy took full responsibility for Max.
answer:
[参考范文]
The father decided to bring Max back.He went to extraordinary lengths to search for the dog in the nearby blocks but in vain.It suddenly crossed his mind that maybe Max would have returned to the park.He breathed a sigh of relief the moment he saw Max wandering in the park.The setting sun cast an orange glow over them.Exhausted but joyful，the father brought Max home.At the sight of Max，so amazed was Alex that he rushed forward，knelt down and hugged Max tight，his eyes twinkling with excitement.From then on，Max became an integral part of their family.
The boy took full responsibility for Max.Tiring as feeding，bathing and walking Max were，he gained a great sense of accomplishment from these puppy care chores.The days of Max’s company witnessed Alex’s heartier laughter and gradual academic progress.It dawned on the father that Max helped Alex build confidence and taught him about responsibility and compassion.Had it not been for this experience，Alex would have never known the bond between humans and animals is built on love，trust and mutual respect，enriching both lives.

Earth Day at Nestwood Forest

—April 22nd,2025

Celebrate Earth Day by caring for the land with Columbia Land Trust！We’ll be gathering in a conserved forest near Corbett，Oregon where we will dig up invasive(侵入的) blackberry to prevent its spread and make room for native plants.

Our work will take place in the Big Creek area of Nestwood Forest，an 800-acre woodland area conserved by Columbia Land Trust and the Wiancko family in 2022.This special place features：

·Habitat for diverse wildlife such as black bear，deer and countless birds.

·Forested slopes(斜坡) protecting the headwaters of Big Creek，a branch of the Sandy River.

·A network of forest roads and trails which create opportunities for community engagement，management，and recreation.

Click here to join：https：//host.nxt.blackbaud.com/

When：Tuesday，April 22nd,2025,9：00 am－12：00 pm(Earth Day！)

Where：Meet at the parking lot of the Portland Women’s Forum on highway 30 near Corbett.From there we will carpool to our work site，just a few miles away.Please gather on time so you don’t miss our group departure!

What to Expect：We will work for two full hours，rain or shine，before breaking and enjoying an optional walk through the surrounding forest trails.Protective work gloves and tools will all be provided for our work，which will involve digging and crossing sloping，uneven area.We will provide water，light snacks，and access to a portable toilet.

We recommend participants dress in tough boots and in protective clothes that may guard against blackberry thorns(刺)．Also recommended to pack is a water bottle，sunscreen，and whatever snacks will keep you comfortable.

Contact：For any question，please contact Peter Condra at events @columbialandtrust.org.

(2025·安徽马鞍山二模)

When handball was introduced to Sri Lankan schools in 2010，I wanted to bring it to my school，St Anthony’s，in the remote village of Wasalakotte.This became a challenging task as the sports teacher was unwilling to initiate anything other than traditional sports，such as cricket and rugby.

However，I decided to start this game.Handball is a fascinating game which combines speed，technical precision，skill and teamwork.The boys were immediately interested and 40 students aged between 13 and 19 signed up to play.And I had the support of their parents.

Heshan Pradeep，a St Anthony’s graduate who was a member of the Air Force handball team，volunteered to coach the team.Although handball is an indoor game，we trained outdoors as our school had limited facilities.“It will ruin their studies！” complained some of the teachers.But I managed to get the game going.

After three months of hard training，we were able to send an under-19s boys’ team to compete with 50 other schools at the first three-day，all-island school handball tournament held in Colombo—the country’s most populous city.Our boys played remarkably well and reached the final.

And that was when the real game started.Students，parents，teachers and old boys from Colombo schools joined forces against us，saying they wouldn’t allow the cup to be taken out of Colombo.Some Colombo students waved leaves and danced and sang their songs to intimidate our boys.Even the referees(裁判) favored the Colombo schools.Defeated，the boys fell to the ground，sad and disappointed.

A few weeks after the defeat，I turned to Vonho，Heshan’s coach.Vonho agreed to coach the team in his free time.The following year，the boys claimed the victory they deserved.

options: The teachers were opposed to it.
The parents were resistant to it.
explanation: 细节理解题。根据第一段中的“This became a challenging task as the sports teacher was unwilling to initiate anything other than traditional sports，such as cricket and rugby.”可知，在圣安东尼开始手球很难是因为老师们反对它。故选B。

material:
(2025·河南安阳二模)

For hundreds of years，the island of Santiago has been home to a unique population of free-ranging monkeys，creating a popular natural laboratory for researchers.In 2017，a hurricane significantly impacted the island，destroying more than two-thirds of plants.

Even now，tree cover remains far below pre-hurricane levels，which makes shade a precious resource for the monkeys.In response to the violent changes caused by the hurricane，they increased tolerance and decreased attacks towards each other，a new study found.

The researchers were motivated by a finding in their previous work on the same monkey population：The animals became more accepting of one another and built new relationships despite insufficient resource availability.But this time，the team wanted to explore whether the monkeys were simply passively engaging in these shade-sharing behaviors due to the fact that they were being “forced” into limited space.

For 10 years in a row，the researchers collected behavioral data across seven social groups.They constructed networks for each group to draw comparisons before and after the hurricane.“Before the hurricane，tolerating others had no impact on the risk of death，” first author Testard says.“Afterwards，the monkeys that displayed more than average social tolerance and were therefore better able to share shade，were 42% less likely to die than those that were less tolerant.”

This represents a sudden change in “selection pressure”，the evolutionary benefits or costs of different characteristics or behaviors.“To access shade，they need to tolerate and be tolerated by others，and we found that this tolerance influences other daily interactions，” says Testard.“Monkeys that began sharing shade also spent time together in the mornings，before the day’s heat forces them to seek shade.”

Professor Brent adds that “monkeys are known for living in an aggressive and highly competitive society.But in the heat caused by ecological changes，they cooperatively coped with disturbances in the environment.We were surprised that the monkeys’ social behavior was so flexible，making them quickly adjust to this environmental change.”
content: How did the hurricane affect the monkeys?
options: They had a higher death rate.
They were more friendly to companions.
They moved to places with more shade.
explanation: 细节理解题。根据第二段中的“In response to the...by the hurricane，they increased tolerance and decreased attacks towards each other，a new study found.”可知，飓风使得猴子们对彼此的容忍度提高，攻击行为也减少了，即它们对同伴更友好了。故选B。

material:
(2025·山西晋城二模)

In recent years，some experts suggest that reading on screens has led to more and more skim reading，since most digital texts tend to be relatively short.Some of them are even worried about the loss of our ability to engage more deeply with long texts.

So is there a “right” way to read?

“There’s a lot of discussion whether social media has sort of destroyed our ability to pay attention，” says Daniel Willingham，a psychologist at the University of Virginia.“None of us knows，because this is a very difficult research problem.”

Willingham theorizes that our changing reading habits are likely not because our attention is degraded.Otherwise，that would have huge effects on our other abilities，like memory.But because the Internet provides an opportunity for endless entertainment，our willingness to focus on a text might be decreasing.He is optimistic that most people can learn these close reading skills with practice.

“In some ways，focusing on the same thing for a long time is not necessarily a natural state，” Willingham explains.“Our mind wants to sample different things and see what’s going on in our environment.Therefore，it might not be helpful to put skimming and close reading against each other，but rather to understand that both are important to learn，especially when we have huge amounts of information available at our fingertips.”

Skimming—where we skip over words and sections to grasp the main idea of a text—is a common reading strategy.Skimming is sufficient for most beach reads，for example，which don’t require us to recall details of a scene.

Our familiarity with the type of text also influences the strategy we use to read.If we have read a lot of mystery novels，we may get used to the structure of the text and thus be able to skim sections and still get what’s going on.
content: Why have our reading habits changed，according to some experts?
options: We can’t concentrate on long texts any more.
Our opportunity for entertainment is endless.
We have too much information to absorb.
Our willingness to focus on a text is decreasing.
explanation: 细节理解题。根据第一段中的“Some of them are even worried about the loss of our ability to engage more deeply with long texts.”可知，根据一些专家的说法，我们的阅读习惯改变是因为我们无法再专注于长篇文本。故选A。

Identify what makes your missing object stand out in its environment.It might be its size，color，texture or shape.[[37]] It will make the process faster and more efficient.Instead of looking at everything in a space，this approach helps you focus your attention only on objects with that distinction.

Look in places where you’ve lost this item before.Do you tend to lose your keys or student cards often？If so，it may have ended up in a similar place as before.Think about where your common lost objects tend to be lost.For example，maybe you have a habit of leaving your keys in the lock or your bag in the car.[[38]]

Try looking at the room from a new angle.If you’ve retraced your steps，gone through all the motions，and still haven’t found anything，change your perspective.Crawl instead of walking down the hall.[[39]] Seeing things from a different point of view can help you notice details you may have missed before.

[[40]] Scattered and crowded areas make it easier to lose objects，as things can fall under other things or get buried beneath piles.Regularly clean and tidy up living spaces，so you won’t have to spend more time looking for things later on.

In his article penned in 1934，painter Feng Zikai(1898－1975) recalled his childhood enlightenment(启蒙) as he learned about painting.When he studied Chinese poetry and the Three Character Classic,[[56]] 13th-century text for children on Confucian philosophy，he found [[57]](he)，instead of being attracted by the text，seized by the illustrations.These images [[58]](attract) him so much that he began coloring them [[59]](use) pigment(颜料) from his family’s dyehouse.

“The children new [[60]] school enjoy coloring illustrations in textbooks，” says Li Hongbo，an art professor at Jilin Normal University.“They may have limited understanding of colors,[[61]] they often take pride in their creations and find [[62]](end) pleasure from such activities.”

Feng’s story is shown in the ongoing Mirror to the Future：Chinese Basic Art Education Literature Exhibition,[[63]] highlights the development of the country’s fundamental fine arts education since 1904，at The First Historical Archives(档案) of China in Beijing.

[[64]](organize) by the archives and Beijing Normal University，the exhibition follows the 120-year history of the development of basic fine arts education in China，through 1,359 items，including files，textbooks and teaching aids.

This exhibition shows the rich value of fine arts education in enhancing the ability [[65]](appreciate) beauty，nurture the soul，and stimulate innovative vitality.It also enables the rich archival resources containing historical，cultural and aesthetic value to integrate into the field of education，giving full play to their roles of preserving history and educating people.
answer: (1) a；(2) himself；(3) attracted；(4) using；(5) to；(6) but/yet；(7) endless；(8) which；(9) Organized；(10) to appreciate
explanation:
考查冠词。分析句子可知，“[[_]] 13th-century text”是对the Three Character Classic的解释，这里表示“一本”，用不定冠词，且13th-century的发音以辅音音素开头。故填a。

考查反身代词。根据句意可知，这里指“他自己”，用反身代词himself作found的宾语。故填himself。

考查动词时态。分析句子可知，设空处是句子的谓语动词，再根据上下文可知，这里描述的是过去的事情，用一般过去时，attract的过去式是 attracted。故填attracted。

考查非谓语动词。分析句子可知，设空处应填非谓语动词，he与use之间是逻辑上的主动关系，用现在分词形式using作状语。故填using。

考查介词。(be)new to...是固定搭配，意为“刚接触……，刚到……”，此处指“刚上学的孩子”。故填to。

考查连词。根据句意可知，此空前后句是转折关系，用but或者yet连接。故填but/yet。

考查形容词。此处修饰名词pleasure，根据句意应用形容词形式endless，表示“无尽的”。故填endless。

考查定语从句。分析句子可知，设空处引导非限制性定语从句，先行词Mirror to the Future：Chinese Basic Art Education Literature Exhibition表示事物，在从句中作主语，应用which。故填which。

考查非谓语动词。分析句子可知，设空处应填非谓语动词，exhibition与organize之间是逻辑上的被动关系，所以应用过去分词organized，且位于句首时首字母应大写。故填Organized。

考查非谓语动词。固定搭配“the ability to do sth”意为“做某事的能力”。故填to appreciate。

One sunny afternoon，Jamie and his friend Ethan gathered at their favorite spot，the old oak tree in the park.As they sat together，exchanging plans for the coming weekend，Jamie felt a familiar knot of anxiety forming in his stomach.This was the day he had to present his science project，and the thought of speaking in front of everyone made his palms sweat.“What’s wrong，Jamie？” Ethan asked，noticing the change in his friend’s behavior.“I...I have to present my project about renewable energy tomorrow，and I’m really nervous.I don’t think I can explain it well.What if they laugh at me？” Jamie admitted.Ethan leaned in closer，“Listen，Jamie，everyone gets nervous.But if you believe in what you’re saying，others will too.Just think of it as telling a story.” Jamie sighed，considering his friend’s words，but the fear of failure still overwhelmed him.

That evening，Jamie sat at his desk，on which lay the papers and diagrams of his project.He had spent weeks researching solar panels，wind turbines(风力涡轮机)，and the importance of conserving energy.Yet，despite his hard work，the doubts crept back in like shadows in the night.“What if I forget everything？What if I trip over my words？” he murmured(低语) to himself.

His mother，hearing his murmurs from the hallway，comforted him with a warm smile，“Jamie，remember，it’s not about being perfect.It’s about sharing what you’ve learned.You’re passionate about this topic，and that passion will shine through.” As Jamie lay in bed that night，he thought about his mother’s words.Slowly，the knot in his stomach began to loosen，replaced by a flicker of determination.

The next morning，after a quick breakfast，he grabbed his project materials and headed to school.As the bell rang，one by one，students presented their projects.Jamie’s heart raced as he watched his classmates speak confidently，their voices steady and strong.

注意：1.续写词数应为150个左右；

2．请按如下格式在答题纸的相应位置作答。

Finally，it was Jamie’s turn.____________________________________________

________________________________________________________________________

After the presentations，Jamie’s classmates came over to congratulate him._______

________________________________________________________________________
answer:
【参考范文】
Finally，it was Jamie’s turn.He stood up，trembling slightly，but took a deep breath as Ethan’s advice echoed in his mind：“Think of it as telling a story.” Gripping his notes，Jamie began explaining solar panels，his voice shaky at first.Gradually，he focused on the diagrams he had worked so hard on.To his surprise，his classmates leaned forward，listening intently.When he mentioned wind turbines，he even gestured like spinning blades，drawing smiles.By the end，his voice grew steadier，and applause erupted.Relief washed over him—he had done it!
After the presentations，Jamie’s classmates came over to congratulate him.“Your passion really showed！” one exclaimed.Even the teacher praised his clear explanations.Ethan patted his shoulder，grinning，“See？They loved your story！” Jamie beamed，realizing his fear had faded once he shared his knowledge.That night，he felt proud—not because he was perfect，but because he had dared to try.As he walked home，the old oak tree seemed to whisper approval.The moonlight bathed the path in a gentle glow，making him feel lighter than ever.

材料　唐朝建立之初……关中地区久有“天府之国”的称号，但随着社会发展，“关中之地不能充分供给帝王宫卫百官俸食之需”，需通过隋唐运河调运各地粮食入关中。安史之乱后，从关中至整个黄河中下游“人烟断绝，千里萧条”。同时为征讨藩镇，唐朝军队扩张到了“兵额约九十九万，通计三户资一兵”的地步。这又导致了大量人民逃亡、匿户的频繁发生，朝廷只得将供应军粮的任务转向地方。“应须兵马、甲仗、器械、粮赐等，并于本路自供”。黄巢起义平定后，朝廷与淮南节度使闹翻。东南地区基本处于独立状态，唐朝廷就只能靠着关中的赋税苟延残喘。907年，唐亡。——摘编自李维才《唐朝粮食问题若干研究》等

思考　有学者认为“安史之乱后，唐朝亡于粮食危机”，据上述材料加以说明。

试答：________________________________________________________________________
answer: 关中地区是唐代粮食生产和供应的主要地区，但在安史之乱后，这些地区的经济遭到严重破坏；大量人口逃亡，影响粮食生产；均田制、租调制的瓦解，中央对人口、土地的控制减弱，影响粮食供应；军队急剧扩张、藩镇割据，都加剧了粮食危机；中央对东南地区控制力减弱，江淮漕运数量大大减少；关中平原粮食不能满足政府的需求，唐朝最终在缺粮的危机中走向灭亡。

material: (2025·安徽蚌埠联考)传统路灯在季节更替时如果不及时地调整开关时间，会出现“天黑灯不亮，天亮灯也亮”的情况。近年来，很多城市开始推广使用光控路灯，其优点是能够根据光线强度变化来实现自动开关灯，从而提升城市形象。如图“为我国某城市(约104°E)某商业街景观图”。据此完成以下各题。
content: 该商业街季节更替时传统路灯出现了“天黑灯不亮”的情况，最可能的时间段是(　　)
explanation: 路灯亮一般为日落之时，天黑灯不亮，说明昼变短，太阳直射点向南移。元旦到儿童节(1月1日至6月1日)，劳动节到儿童节(5月1日至6月1日)，清明节到劳动节(4月5日前后至5月1日)太阳直射点均向北移，A、B、D错误；建军节至国庆节，即8月1日到10月1日，太阳直射点向南移，C正确。

content: 如果该城市商业街路灯已经升级成了光控路灯，仅考虑季节更替影响，某日路灯熄灭的时间为北京时间6：00，该日的昼长约为(　　)
explanation: 路灯熄灭时为日出时刻，该日日出时，北京时间为6：00，该城市经度为104°E，可算出当地日出地方时为4：56，再根据昼长＝(12－日出地方时)×2，可求出当地昼长为14小时08分钟。故选B。

material: 春秋之末，至于战国，诸侯卿相皆争养士。自谋夫说客谈天雕龙坚白同异之流下至击剑扛鼎鸡鸣狗盗之徒，莫不宾礼。靡衣玉食以馆于上者，何可胜数。此皆奸民蠹国者，民何以支而国何以堪乎？苏子曰：此先王之所不能免也。国之有奸，犹鸟兽之有鸷猛，昆虫之有毒螫也。区处条理，使各安其处，则有之矣；锄而尽去之，则无是道也。吾考之世变，知六国之所以久存而秦之所以速亡者，盖出于此，不可不察也。（节选自苏轼《六国论》）

阅读下面的文段，翻译文中画横线的句子。

昌邑王既立，淫戏无度。昌邑官属皆征至长安，往往超擢拜官。大将军光忧懑，独以问所亲故吏大司农田延年。延年曰：“将军为国柱石，审此人不可，何不建白太后，更选贤而立之？”光曰：“今欲如是，于古尝有此不？”延年曰：“伊尹相殷，废太甲以安宗庙，后世称其忠。将军若能行此，亦汉之伊尹也。”光乃引延年给事中，阴与车骑将军张安世图计。

(节选自《通鉴纪事本末·霍光废立》，有删改)
answer: 大将军霍光内心忧愁烦闷，独自拿(这件事)去询问亲近的旧吏大司农田延年。(得分点：“忧懑”，忧愁烦闷；“独”，独自；“以问”，以(之)问，省略句；“所亲”，所字结构，亲近的)
